sp-01493.description_en: Subtracts 5 from elemental attack rolls against the target, and adds 5 to all of the target's RRs versus spells.

sp-01494.description_en: When the caster of this spell is a target of a spell from the realm of Channeling, the “incoming” spell must first make an RR before the caster makes an RR. For RR purposes, each spell uses a level equal to its caster's level. If the “incoming” spell passes the RR, it may target the caster of this spell normally; otherwise the incoming spell has no effect on this target.

sp-01495.description_en: As Protection I, except for duration and all beings within 10' of target get the benefits.

sp-01496.description_en: As Cancel Channeling, except the caster is protected from spells in the realm of Essence.

sp-01497.description_en: As Protection I, except bonuses are 10.

sp-01498.description_en: As Cancel Channeling, except the caster is protected from spells in the realm of Mentalism.

sp-01499.description_en: As Protection Sphere I, except bonuses are 10.

sp-01500.description_en: Any active spell from the realm of Channeling that is on the target must make an RR (use the level of that spell's caster as the spell's level). If the spell fails its RR, it is dispelled.

sp-01501.description_en: Creates a shimmering shield in front of the caster. This shield subtracts 10 from all frontal Channeling attack rolls on the caster (base and elemental). If the caster performs no other actions during a round, he can “parry” (as with a normal shield) one spell attack. The parry bonus is equal to the sum of all the bonuses that the caster would normally have for his spell's base attack roll.

sp-01502.description_en: As Protection I, except bonuses are 15.

sp-01503.description_en: As Channeling Shield, except is effective only against Essence spells.

sp-01504.description_en: As Dispel Channeling, except effects spells in the realm of Essence.

sp-01505.description_en: As Channeling Shield, except is effective only against Mentalism spells.

sp-01506.description_en: As Protection I, except bonuses are 20.

sp-01507.description_en: As Channeling Shield, except it is effective against two realms of the caster's choice.

sp-01508.description_en: As Dispel Channeling, except effects spells in the realm of Mentalism.

sp-01509.description_en: As Protection I, except bonuses are 25.

sp-01510.description_en: As Channeling Shield, except all three realms are affected.

sp-01511.description_en: Target gets +50 to all RRs against Channeling spells.

sp-01512.description_en: As Channeling Resistance, except is only effective against Essence spells.

sp-01753.description_en: Caster can read text written in an unknown language, but only understand basic concepts of it. This spell gives the caster the equivalent of rank 2 knowledge in a written language.

sp-01754.description_en: Gives nature and origin of natural stone, and when and how worked stone was obtained and worked.

sp-01755.description_en: As Stone Analysis, except metal may be examined.

sp-01756.description_en: As Stone Analysis, except gas may be examined.

sp-01757.description_en: As Text Analysis I, except gives a complete technical analysis (vocabulary and syntax) but not an understanding of idioms (jargon), implications, or cultural references.This spell gives the caster the equivalent of rank 5 knowledge in a written language.

sp-01758.description_en: As Stone Analysis, except liquid may be examined.

sp-01759.description_en: Gives significant details about an item's construction and purpose (not specific powers).

sp-01760.description_en: Provides analysis of an active spell; giving its duration, the list it was cast from, and its type (not its level or exactly what spell it is).

sp-01761.description_en: Gives information concerning a being's death (weapon, spell, time since, etc.); must be cast in place of death (within 24 hour) or in the presence of body (no time limit).

sp-01762.description_en: As Text Analysis II, except everything but implications is known (e.g., answers to riddles are not known automatically). This spell gives the caster the equivalent of rank 8 knowledge in a written language.

sp-01763.description_en: As Spell Analysis, except will work on abilities/powers that are not currently active. One item, person, or place may be examined to see if it has power, which realm the power is from, a general idea of its origin, and its basic configuration.

sp-01764.description_en: Caster's awareness leaves his body (which is inactive for the duration of the spell) and may travel at 1 mile per minute. However, it can only travel 10' per round when moving through solid material or when observing the world. If the spell expires before the caster returns to his body, he will return to his body at the fixed rate of 500' per round, and upon returning to his body, he must make a RR modified by -50 or die (the attack level is equal to the number of rounds overstayed).

sp-01765.description_en: As Death Analysis, except gives a visual image of the killer, and a vague reason for death (e.g., revenge, robbery, accident, etc.).

sp-01766.description_en: Any of the lower level spells may be used together on one item, person, or place (Conveyance is not included).

sp-01767.description_en: As Analysis, except one item per round may be examined.

sp-01768.description_en: As Power Analysis, except exact origin, creator, and detailed purpose are given; this includes exact spell (when appropriate).

sp-01769.description_en: As Conveyance, except rate is 10 mile per minute (50' per round through solid material and while observing).

sp-01770.description_en: Detects any active spell or item from the Essence realm. Caster can concentrate on a 5'R area each round.

sp-01771.description_en: As Detect Essence, except realm is Mentalism.

sp-01772.description_en: As Detect Essence, except realm is Channeling.

sp-01773.description_en: As Detect Essence, except detects invisible things. All attacks against something so detected are modified by -50.

sp-01774.description_en: As Detect Essence, except it gives a 75% chance of detecting a trap (trap sophistication may modify this chance).

sp-01775.description_en: As Detect Essence, except detects if a being is evil or an item created by evil or long used by a very evil person.

sp-01776.description_en: Gives the direction and distance to any specific object or place that the caster is familiar with or has had described in detail.

sp-01777.description_en: As Detect Essence, except it will give an estimate of the power of the person (level) or item or spell examined.

sp-01778.description_en: As Detect Essence, except detects dead bodies and whether anything has died in the radius in the last 24 hours.

sp-01779.description_en: As Location I, except range is 300'.

sp-01780.description_en: As Detect Essence, except detects any spell that has been cast in the area examined. Gives exact spell that was cast.

sp-01781.description_en: As Location I, except range is 500'.

sp-01782.description_en: As Perceive Power I, except range is 300'.

sp-01783.description_en: As Location I, except range is 1 mile.

sp-01784.description_en: As Detect Essence, except detects any type of detection spell that is operating in the area examined (gives exact spell detected).

sp-01785.description_en: Any of the lower level Detect spells can be used once per round.

sp-01786.description_en: As Location I, except range is 1 mile per level.

sp-01787.description_en: Target is totally protected from all natural light (includes glare, sunburn, and temporary blinding; but not lightning); +10 to all RRs vs light (electricity); -10 to elemental electricity attacks.

sp-01788.description_en: As Resist Light, except protects against natural heat to 200˚ F and modifies spells involving heat by 10.

sp-01789.description_en: As Resist Light, except protects against natural cold to -20˚ F and modifies spells involving cold by 10.

sp-01790.description_en: As Resist Light, except all beings within 10'R of target are protected.

sp-01791.description_en: As Resist Heat, except all beings within 10'R of target are protected.

sp-01792.description_en: As Resist Cold, except all beings within 10'R of target are protected.

sp-01793.description_en: As Resist Light , except protects against all natural light and electricity and modifies spells involving light (electricity) by 20.

sp-01794.description_en: As Lightarmor, except protects against heat.

sp-01795.description_en: As Lightarmor, except protects against cold.

sp-01796.description_en: As Lightarmor, except protects all beings within 10'R.

sp-01797.description_en: As Heatarmor, except protects all beings within 10'R.

sp-01798.description_en: As Coldarmor, except protects all beings within 10'R.

sp-01799.description_en: As Lightarmor, except it also decreases all electrical concussion hits (e.g., from shock bolts and lightning bolts) by half, and decreases electrical critical strikes by one level (e.g., 'A's are ignored, 'B's become 'A's, 'C's become 'B's, etc.)

sp-01800.description_en: As Lightning Armor, except fire and heat spells are affected (e.g., fire bolts and fireballs).

sp-01801.description_en: As Lightning Armor, except cold and ice spells are affected (e.g., ice bolts and coldballs).

sp-01802.description_en: As Lightarmor, except as many targets as the caster's level can be affected.

sp-01803.description_en: As Heatarmor, except as many targets as the caster's level can be affected.

sp-01804.description_en: As Coldarmor , except as many targets as the caster's level can be affected.

sp-01805.description_en: Acts as Lightning Armor, Fire Armor, and Ice Armor all at the same time.

sp-01806.description_en: Causes an object of up to 1 pound mass to vibrate rapidly; if fragile it may break (roll a RR). If it is an object held by a being the being must make a RR or fumble it (each round).

sp-01807.description_en: Exerts 1 pound of pressure on a person or object. Object cannot be moved by staying alone, and pressure can only be in one direction.

sp-01808.description_en: I — Can move one object, up to 1 pound in mass, up to 1' per second (with no acceleration). If the caster stops concentration before the duration is up, the object remains stationary as if it had a Staying spell of an equal weight limit cast upon it.

sp-01809.description_en: As Vibrations I, except mass limit is 5 pounds.

sp-01810.description_en: As Staying I, except mass limit is 5 pounds.

sp-01811.description_en: As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 5 pounds.

sp-01812.description_en: As Vibrations I, except mass limit is 25 pounds.

sp-01813.description_en: As Staying I, except mass limit is 25 pounds.

sp-01814.description_en: As Vibrations I, except mass limit is 50 pounds.

sp-01815.description_en: By concentrating on the mind of a missile firer and the flight of the missile, the caster causes +50 to be added to the attack roll of the missile. The caster must concentrate, touch the firer and see the missile for the entire round that the missile is fired.

sp-01816.description_en: As Telekinesis I, except the mass limit is 25 pounds.

sp-01817.description_en: As Staying I, except the mass limit is 50 pounds.

sp-01818.description_en: I — As Vibrations I, except as many objects (up to 5 pounds each) as the caster's level can be vibrated (they must all be within the field of vision of the caster).

sp-01819.description_en: As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 50 pounds.

sp-01820.description_en: As Staying I, except mass limit is 100 pounds.

sp-01821.description_en: Caster may “hurl” one object (that starts within 10' of him) of 1 pound or less with sufficient force to deliver an attack. Attacks are resolved on the Sling Attack Table with a maximum range of 300'. The OB of the attack is the caster's directed spell skill with this spell. If Arms Law is not available, use the Shock Bolt Attack Table (with a maximum range of 300') delivering Impact criticals.

sp-01822.description_en: V — As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 100 pounds.

sp-01823.description_en: As Mass Vibrations, except objects may be up to 25 pounds in mass.

sp-01824.description_en: As Aiming, except missile attack bonus is 100.

sp-01825.description_en: As Staying I, except mass limit is 10 pounds per level.

sp-01826.description_en: As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 10 pounds per level.

sp-01827.description_en: As Aiming, except missile attack automatically does maximum damage. If the target is a Large or Super Large creature, the attack is treated as a Slaying attack.

sp-01828.description_en: Caster is aware of the presence of all sentient/ thinking beings within 20'.

sp-01829.description_en: Caster can pick a point up to 10' away and he will hear as if he were at that point (there can be intervening objects such as walls).

sp-01830.description_en: Caster's point of hearing may be moved independently up to 100' away (moves at the rate of 10' per round). He must physically be able to go there (e.g., he could not send his point of hearing thourough walls or closed doors).

sp-01831.description_en: As Listen I, except the caster sees from the fixed point (it can rotate).

sp-01832.description_en: As Long Ear I, except the caster sees from the moving point (it can rotate).

sp-01833.description_en: As Listen I, except the range is 100'.

sp-01834.description_en: Caster can read the surface thoughts of one target.

sp-01835.description_en: As Watch I, except the range is 100'.

sp-01836.description_en: As Long Ear I, except the range is 300'.

sp-01837.description_en: As Listen I, except the range is 500'.

sp-01838.description_en: As Long Eye I, except the range is 300'.

sp-01839.description_en: As Watch I, except range is 500'.

sp-01840.description_en: As Listen I, except the range is 1 mile/level.

sp-01841.description_en: As Watch I, except the range is 1 mile/level.

sp-01842.description_en: As Listen, except the range is unlimited (the caster must be able to locate the desired point in terms of direction and distance).

sp-01866.description_en: Caster can speak and his voice will appear to come from any point that he wants within 100' (point must be in his field of vision).

sp-01867.description_en: Creates any simple, immobile image, scene, or sounds in an area up to 10'R, or creates a set of immobile sounds in an area up to 10'R.

sp-01868.description_en: As Sound/Light Mirage, except creates a set of immobile smells in the area of effect, or a set of immobile tastes in the area of effect.

sp-01869.description_en: Creates a simple, immobile image or scene up to an area of 10'R. One of the following options may also be chosen: a) an extra sense can be added (not the tactile or Presence senses), b) the duration can be doubled, c) the range can be doubled, or d) the radius of the area of effect can be doubled. All parts of the area of effect must be within the range of the spell (and all parts of the range must be in the caster's field of vision).

sp-01870.description_en: Creates the image of one object or being that will move however the caster wants (as long as the caster concentrates). When the caster stops concentrating, the image remains but stops moving. The caster may resume concentration again later and make the image move again (presuming that the duration has not expired). The image can be of any size that would fit in a 10'R.

sp-01871.description_en: Changes the visual appearance of one object. The target can be no larger than 10 pounds per level.

sp-01872.description_en: As Illusion II, except it can be delayed up to 24 hours. At the time of casting, the caster must decide upon the trigger for the spell. The caster can choose one of the following: a) time period, b) specified movements, c) specified sounds, d) specified smells, e) specified tastes. If a sense is used to trigger the spell, that sense must be included in the illusion.

sp-01873.description_en: As Illusion II, except two options may be chosen. See the notes below for guidelines on how to combine the options.

sp-01874.description_en: As Phantasm I, except one of the following options may also be chosen: a) an extra sense can be added (not the tactile or Presence senses), b) the duration can be doubled, c) the range can be doubled, d) the radius of the area of effect can be doubled, e) another image can be created and moved independently of the first (all separate images must be within the caster's field of vision and within range of the spell), or f) limited repetitious sounds, movements, etc can be added that do not require concentration of the caster (the proper senses involved must also be included with the illusion).

sp-01875.description_en: As Phantasm II, except it can be delayed as in Waiting Illusion II. The phantasm will move and act if given a simple command (at the time of casting), or it can deliver a short speech (if sound was one of the included senses).

sp-01876.description_en: As Waiting Illusion II, except two options may be chosen. See the notes below for guidelines on how to combine the options.

sp-01877.description_en: As Phantasm II, except two options may be chosen. See the notes below for guidelines on how to combine the options.

sp-01878.description_en: As Illusions III, except four options may be chosen.

sp-01879.description_en: As Waiting Illusion III, except three options may be chosen.

sp-01880.description_en: As Waiting Phantasm III, except two options may be chosen.

sp-01881.description_en: As Waiting Illusion III, except four options may be chosen.

sp-01882.description_en: As Phantasm III, except three options may be chosen.

sp-01883.description_en: As Waiting Phantasm III, except three options may be chosen.

sp-01884.description_en: As Illusions III, except six options may be chosen.

sp-01885.description_en: As Waiting Illusion III, except five options may be chosen.

sp-01886.description_en: As Phantasm III, except four options may be chosen.

sp-01887.description_en: As Illusion III, except nine options may be chosen.

sp-01888.description_en: As Phantasm III, except nine options may be chosen.

sp-01889.description_en: Caster can tell the exact dimensions, mass, and/or weight of one object.

sp-01890.description_en: Target gains double normal hearing. The results in +50 to Perception involving only hearing, +25 to Perception involving hearing and other senses.

sp-01891.description_en: Target may add +50 to any manuever rolls for one slow maneuver (e.g., walking a 3" beam).

sp-01892.description_en: Target can see 100' on a normal night as if it were daylight. See Section 7.1.19.

sp-01893.description_en: Target has a 300˚ field of vision. The flank bonus for attacks against the target is lowered to +5 and the rear bonus is lowered to +15.

sp-01894.description_en: Target's voice has its loudness tripled. This has no effect on spell casting capabilities (it simply allows the caster to make himself heard without difficulty over long distances).

sp-01895.description_en: As Nightvision, except target can see 100' in even murky water.

sp-01896.description_en: Target can breathe water but not air.

sp-01897.description_en: As Nightvision, except target can see varying degrees of heat on the surfaces of objects. This spell does not allow the caster to see “through” things. While this vision is sufficient for moving around, it is not sufficient at all for reading or mapping.

sp-01898.description_en: As Waterlungs, except target can breathe any gas as normal air.

sp-01899.description_en: Delays the effect of a poison on a target. If poison is not eliminated before the spell expires, the target will be affected by the poison at that time.

sp-01900.description_en: As Nightvision, except any darkness can be seen through. Also, no light is needed at all for this spell to work.

sp-01901.description_en: As Waterlungs, except target can breathe water, air, and/or any gas at will.

sp-01902.description_en: As Balance, except can affect one target per level of caster.

sp-01903.description_en: As Nightvision, except can affect one target per level of caster.

sp-01904.description_en: As Watervision, except can affect one target/level of caster.

sp-01905.description_en: As all “vision” spells below 15th level functioning at the same time.

sp-01906.description_en: As Waterlungs, except can affect 1 target per level of caster.

sp-01907.description_en: As Gaslungs, except can affect 1 target per level of caster.

sp-01908.description_en: As Vision, except can affect 1 target per level of caster.

sp-01909.description_en: Caster may cast this spell with any spell he wants to store. The spell to be stored must be cast within one minute after the Spell Store is cast. The stored spell may then be cast later as an instantatneous spell. The Spell Store spell costs the same number of PPs as the spell that is stored. No other spell may be cast while a spell is stored.

sp-01910.description_en: This spell inscribes a spell on a specially prepared piece of paper. The rune can then be used to cast the inscribed spell once. Spell to be inscribed must be cast within one minute after the Rune # spell is cast. Rune I can only inscribe 1st level spells. The rune can be set to affect reader.

sp-01911.description_en: As Rune I, except up to 2nd level spells can be inscribed.

sp-01912.description_en: As Rune I, except up to 3rd level spells can be inscribed.

sp-01913.description_en: As Rune I, except up to 5th level spells can be inscribed.

sp-01914.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] A Sign can be inscribed on any “non-mobile” surface and affects the triggering being. A Sign can be triggered by one of the following (decided by caster at the time of casting): a) specified time has passed, b) specified movements within 20', c) specified sounds within 20', d) touch, or e) reading. The Sign is cancelled when a being fails a RR against it. Sign of Shock puts the target in a state of shock for 10 minutes per 10 failure (treat as if target is stunned, except target will never pass out due to this shock).

sp-01915.description_en: As Rune I, except up to 6th level spells can be inscribed.

sp-01916.description_en: As Sign of Stunning, except target will flee the location of the Sign for 1 minute per 5 failure. The target must make his RR based upon his resistance to Essence, not his resistance to Fear.

sp-01917.description_en: As Rune I, except up to 7th level spells can be inscribed.

sp-01918.description_en: As Sign of Stunning, except target falls into a magical sleep from which he cannot be awakened for 10 minute per 10 failure.

sp-01919.description_en: As Rune I, except up to 8th level spells can be inscribed.

sp-01920.description_en: As Sign of Stunning, except target is blinded for 1 hour per 10 failure.

sp-01921.description_en: As Rune I, except up to 9th level spells can be inscribed.

sp-01922.description_en: As Sign of Stunning, except target is paralyzed for 1 hour per 10 failure.

sp-01923.description_en: As Rune I, except up to 10th level spells can be inscribed.

sp-01925.description_en: As Rune I, except up to 20th level spells can be inscribed.

sp-01926.description_en: As any Sign spell desired, except that it can affect a number of targets up to the level of the caster before it is canceled.

sp-01969.description_en: Subtracts 5 from elemental attack rolls against the target and adds 5 to all of the target's RRs versus spells.

sp-01970.description_en: When the caster of this spell is a target of a spell from the realm of Essence, the “incoming” spell must first make an RR before the caster makes an RR. For RR purposes, each spell uses a level equal to its caster's level. If the “incoming” spell passes the RR, it may target the caster of this spell normally; otherwise the incoming spell has no effect on this target.

sp-01971.description_en: As Protection I, except all beings within 10'R of target get the benefits.

sp-01972.description_en: As Cancel Essence except affects spells from the realm of Mentalism.

sp-01973.description_en: As Protection I, except bonuses are 10.

sp-01974.description_en: as Cancel Essence, except affects spells from the realm of Channeling.

sp-01975.description_en: As Protection II, except it has a 10'R as in Protection Sphere I.

sp-01977.description_en: Creates a shimmering shield in front of the caster. This shield subtracts 10 from all frontal Essence attack rolls on the caster (base and elemental). If the caster performs no other actions during a round, he can “parry” (as with a normal shield) one spell attack. The parry bonus is equal to the sum of all the bonuses that the caster would normally have for his spell's base attack roll.

sp-01978.description_en: As Essence Shield, except is effective only against Mentalism spells.

sp-01979.description_en: As Protection I, except bonuses are 15.

sp-01981.description_en: As Essence Shield, except it is effective only against Channeling spells.

sp-01982.description_en: As Essence Shield, except it is effective against any two of the three realms.

sp-01983.description_en: As Protection I, except bonuses are 20.

sp-01985.description_en: As Essence Shield, except is effective against all three realms.

sp-01986.description_en: As Protection I, except bonuses are 25.

sp-01987.description_en: Target gets a +50 bonus for all RRs versus Essence spells.

sp-01988.description_en: As Essence Resistance, except is only effective against Mentalism spells.

sp-01989.description_en: As Essence Resistance, except is only effective against Channeling spells.

sp-01990.description_en: As Essence Resistance, except all three realms are affected.

sp-02012.description_en: Caster can cause any lock he can see within 100' to be locked (the lock is just normally locked and can be opened normally).

sp-02013.description_en: A door (or container) can be magically “locked.” The door can be broken down normally or the spell can be dispelled. Otherwise, the door cannot be opened for the duration of the spell.

sp-02014.description_en: Gives the caster a +20 bonus for picking the lock analyzed. If the caster describes the information gained from this spell, that person will get a +10 bonus to picking the lock analyzed.

sp-02015.description_en: When cast upon a lock, there is a 20% chance a normal lock will open, and a 45% chance that a Magic Lock will open. There is a 10% chance that any associated traps are set off. Rolls are open-ended, and the sophistication of the lock may modify the roll (see Section 7.1.29).

sp-02016.description_en: As Locklore, except applies to disarming traps.

sp-02017.description_en: As Opening I, except its chances concern disarming traps (see Section 7.1.29).

sp-02018.description_en: Causes a door to expand and jam into its frame. Roll d100 to determine the severity of the jam (a 01 means the door is only slightly stuck; a 100 means that the door is unopenable).

sp-02019.description_en: Reduces the inherent strength of a door by 50%. All attempts to break down the door get a +50 bonus.

sp-02020.description_en: When cast, there is a 20% chance that all locks within the area of effect are unlocked (45% chance for Magic Locks). Roll separately for each lock in the area of effect. Rolls are open-ended, and the sophistication of the lock may modify the roll (see Section 7.1.29).

sp-02021.description_en: As Opening I, except chance is 40% (90% for Magic Locks).

sp-02022.description_en: Will vaporize a nonmagic door up to 6" thick, 10' high and 10' wide (if the door is thicker than 6" it will vaporize the closest 6 inches). This will only work on an object that is used as a door (i.e., a caster cannot Undoor a section of wall).

sp-02023.description_en: As Disarm I, except chance is 40% (90% for magical traps).

sp-02024.description_en: As Magic Lock, except duration is 1 hr/lvl and the chance that an Opening spell (or Open Prison) will work is reduced by 20%.

sp-02025.description_en: As Magic Lock, except door is unbreakable by normal means.

sp-02026.description_en: As Undoor I, except door can be up to 2'x20'x20'.

sp-02027.description_en: As Open Prison I, except chance is 40% (90% for Magic Locks).

sp-02028.description_en: As Undoor I, except door can be up to 3'x50'x50'.

sp-02029.description_en: As Magic Lock, except duration is 1 day/lvl and the chance that an Opening spell (or Open Prison) will work is reduced by 40%.

sp-02030.description_en: As Undoor I, except any single door is vaporized.

sp-02031.description_en: A doorway (8'x5') is created in any wall up to 6" deep per level of the caster.

sp-02032.description_en: Gives the caster a 90% chance of opening a lock. The roll is open-ended and the sophistication of the lock may modify the roll.

sp-02033.description_en: As Lock Mastery, except its chances concern disarming traps.

sp-02034.description_en: Caster can utilize any one of the lower level spells on this list each round.

sp-02081.description_en: When the caster of this spell is a target of a spell from the realm of Essence, the “incoming” spell must first make an RR before the caster makes an RR. For RR purposes, each spell uses a level equal to the level of its caster. If the “incoming” spell passes the RR, it may target the caster normally; otherwise, the incoming spell has no effect on this target.

sp-02082.description_en: As Cancel Essence I, except affects spells from the realm of Mentalism.

sp-02083.description_en: As Cancel Essence I, except affects spells from the realm of Channeling.

sp-02084.description_en: Any active spell from the realm of Essence that is on the target must make are RR (use the level of that spell's caster as the spells level). If the spell fails its RR, it is dispelled.

sp-02085.description_en: As Dispel Essence I, except affects spells from the realm of Mentalism.

sp-02086.description_en: As Dispel Essence I, except affects spells from the realm of Channeling.

sp-02096.description_en: Target has no Essence power points (and thus can throw no Essence spells) for 24 hours (this includes spells cast using spell bonus items). This can also be cast against items which could normally cast spells. Hybrid spell casters who have Essence as one of their realms only have access to half their normal power points.

sp-02097.description_en: As Unessence, except Mentalism is affected.

sp-02098.description_en: As Unessence, except Channeling is affected.

sp-02099.description_en: As Cancel Essence I except all 3 realms are affected.

sp-02100.description_en: As Dispel Essence Sphere I, except radius is 300'.

sp-02101.description_en: As Dispel Essence I, except all 3 realms are affected.

sp-02102.description_en: As Dispel Essence Sphere V, except all 3 realms are affected.

sp-02189.description_en: The caster can attune himself to a small creature (of creature intelligence) to serve as his familiar. The caster must obtain the creature through normal means (can be no more than 10% of caster's own mass) and cast this spell on the creature once per day for 1 week (concentrating for 2 hours per day). The caster can then control the familiar and view the world through its senses by concentrating on it (though the familiar must be within 50' per level). If the creature is killed, the caster will have a -25 modification to all actions for 2 weeks.

sp-02190.description_en: Caster can instantly summon a first level, nonintelligent creature that he can control. If the creature can understand the caster's communication (e.g., Creature Tongues), the creature can be controlled by normal communication. Otherwise, control is only maintained through concentration of the caster. The general type of the creature can be specified by the caster but exactly what the creature is should be determined by the GM (selected from creatures commonly found in the area where the spell is cast). If the creature was summoned to be used for a task that is not dangerous to the creature, the duration for this spell is 10 minutes per level of the caster. However, if the creature is ever put into a dangerous situation, the duration drops to 1 round per level of the caster.

sp-02191.description_en: The caster can make a semi-intelligent being a companion. The companion can be no more than 50% of the caster's mass. The companion cannot be more intelligent than the caster. The relationship between the caster and the companion is not magical (and the caster must strive to maintain good relations with the companion or it will leave him). The relationship should be treated as a parent/child relationship. The companion will almost always obey a “do not” command (e.g., “Do not drink that potion”); but the companion may make an RR to resist a “do” command (e.g., “Go steal the eggs from the

sp-02192.description_en: As Summons I, except caster can also choose one of the following options: a) the level of a summoned creature is increased by one, b) an extra first level creature can be summoned, or c) the duration can be doubled.

sp-02193.description_en: Allows the caster to control a Type I demon for the duration of the spell. At the time of casting, there is a 2% chance per Type of the demon that the demon can ignore the control.

sp-02194.description_en: As Summons II, except 2 options can be chosen.

sp-02195.description_en: Caster summons a demon who gradually appears over the course of d10+1 rounds. The GM should roll d100 (not open-ended) to determine the type of the demon. A result of 1-60 summons a Type I demon. A result of 61-90 summons a Type II demon. A result of 91-100 summons a Type III demon. See Section 7.1.31 for results if demon is not “controlled” or “mastered” before it fully appears.

sp-02196.description_en: As Summons III, except 4 options can be chosen.

sp-02197.description_en: As Control Demon I, except Type I and Type II demons can be controlled.

sp-02198.description_en: As Summons III, except 9 options can be chosen.

sp-02199.description_en: After casting this spell, any nearby rural spirits or occupational spirits will visit the caster (exact time before the visit occurs may vary). The summoned folk will have the same nature as the caster. The exact results of their visit will vary (GM's discretion).

sp-02200.description_en: As Control Demon I, except Type I, Type II, and Type III demons can be controlled.

sp-02201.description_en: As Companion, except there is no size limitation on the companion.

sp-02202.description_en: As Summons X, except the arrival of the summoned creature(s) can be delayed up to 1 day per level of the caster or until triggered by one of the following (decided at the time of casting): specified movements, touch, or a specific action. The caster may specify (at the time of casting) a single task for the creature(s) to perform when it (they) arrives.

sp-02203.description_en: As Summons III, except 19 options may be chosen.

sp-02204.description_en: As Waiting Summons, except it functions as Lesser Demonic Gate.

sp-02205.description_en: As Lesser Demonic Gate, except Types III, IV, V, and VI can be summoned. Roll d100 (not openended) to determine the type: 1-60 results in a Type III demon, 61-85 results in a Type IV demon, 86-95 results in a Type V demon, and 96-100 results in a Type VI demon.

sp-02206.description_en: As Control Demon I, except Type I, Type II, Type III, and Type IV demons can be controlled.

sp-02207.description_en: As Summons III, except the caster can take as many options as he has levels.

sp-02208.description_en: As Control Demon II, except concentration is not required. There is a 5% chance per Type of the demon that the demon can ignore the mastery.

sp-02209.description_en: As Waiting Summons, except it functions as Greater Demonic Gate.

sp-02210.description_en: As Control Demon I, except Type I, Type II, Type III, Type IV, and Type V demons can be controlled.

sp-02211.description_en: A single object is made invisible (1 garment, 1 naked body, etc.); until 24 hrs pass or the object is struck by a violent blow (being hit by a weapon, falling, etc.) or the object makes a violent move (i.e., an attack).

sp-02212.description_en: As Unseen I, except everything within 1' of the target is invisible as long as it is within 1' and none of the Unseen I termination conditions occur. See Section 7.1.10.

sp-02213.description_en: As Invisibility I, except the radius can vary up to 1' (chosen at the time of casting). This makes the invisible target harder to see. See Section 7.1.10.

sp-02214.description_en: As Invisibility I, except the radius is 10'.

sp-02215.description_en: As Unseen I, except 3 objects can be affected.

sp-02216.description_en: As Invisibility Sphere I, except the radius can vary up to 10' (chosen at the time of casting).

sp-02217.description_en: As Unseen I, except 5 objects can be affected.

sp-02218.description_en: As Invisibility I, except two targets can be affected (with a separate radius for each).

sp-02219.description_en: As Unseen I, except up to 10 objects can be affected.

sp-02220.description_en: As Invisibility Split Sphere, except the two radii can vary up to 10' (chosen at the time of casting).

sp-02222.description_en: As Unseen I, except as many objects as the caster's level may be affected.

sp-02223.description_en: As Invisibility I, except as many targets as the caster's level can be affected. Each target gets its own radius.

sp-02224.description_en: As Invisibility II, except only affects the caster. If he attacks he is only visible for the round immediately following the attack. Violent blows do not affect this spell.

sp-02248.description_en: Caster may shrink by up to 50% his normal mass (height in most situations). The caster retains his previous strength.

sp-02249.description_en: As Shrink Self, except caster may increase his mass by 50% (height in most situations); there is no increase in his strength (except for movement purposes).

sp-02250.description_en: Allows caster to analyze the form of another being for future use with True Change.

sp-02251.description_en: Caster can alter the target's form to the form of any desired humanoid race. The form cannot be a specific form. For example, the target could take on the form of a Dwarf, but not the Dwarven king. Only physical form is gained (e.g., the target who becomes a Dwarf would not receive the dwarves ability to see in the dark). See Section 7.1.11.

sp-02252.description_en: As Shrink Self, except the maximum decrease is 10% of caster's mass per level (maximum of 90% of the target's mass) and it can be cast on any material that is living or was once living.

sp-02253.description_en: As Shrink, except it increases target's mass up to 10% of caster's mass per level.

sp-02254.description_en: As Change to Kind, except alteration can be to any organic form within 50% to 200% target's current mass. Target gains no special abilities from the change.

sp-02255.description_en: As Change, except altered form can be that of a specific being analyzed by Change Lore.

sp-02256.description_en: As True Change, except caster may assume a different form anytime during the spell, by concentrating for one round per change.

sp-02257.description_en: Target can merge into any solid, inanimate material. While merged, the target cannot move or perceive. When the target emerges from the material, he can emerge from any side or face of the material. The target cannot move “through” material greater in width than his own body size plus 2 feet. The caster can exit at any time up to 1hr/lvl; all other targets must emerge after a specified time (the caster specifies the time when the spell is cast, must be less than 1 hr/ lvl).

sp-02259.description_en: Target may pass through any inanimate material up to 1' per level; it takes one round to pass through 2'.

sp-02260.description_en: As Enlarge, except it simultaneously enlarges (by up to 50% of caster's mass) as many targets as the caster's level. All objects must enlarge the same percentage amount.

sp-02261.description_en: As Change, except affects up to the caster's level in targets (all targets must take the same type of form).

sp-02262.description_en: As Merging, except affects up to the caster's level in targets. All targets must exit after a set time. If the caster is one of the targets, he may exit ant any time and all other targets can exit with him.

sp-02263.description_en: Allows the target to leap 50' laterally or 20' vertically in the round that the spell is cast.

sp-02264.description_en: Allows the target to land safely after a fall up to 20' per level of the caster. In addition, the target may take that distance off the severity of any longer fall.

sp-02265.description_en: Caster teleports the target to a point up to 100' away. There can be no intervening “barriers” in a direct line between the target and the point. A “barrier” is defined as anything the target could not physically go through (e.g., a closed door is a barrier, a pit is not).

sp-02266.description_en: Allows target to move up and down vertically at a rate of 10' per round. The spell does not confer any ability to control horizontal movement.

sp-02267.description_en: I — Target can fly at a rate of 75' per round (approximately 5 mph). While Fly is active, normal movement (e.g., walking, running, etc.) is not allowed.

sp-02268.description_en: Opens a 3'x6'x3' portal in any solid surface. At the end of the duration, the surface is returned to its previous state. If anyone is in the area of effect when the spell effect ends, he is forced back to his point of entry

sp-02269.description_en: As Fly I, except rate is 150' per round.

sp-02270.description_en: As Leaving I, except target can pass through barriers by specifying exact distances. If the arrival point coincides with solid or liquid material, the target does not move; instead, he is stunned 1-10 rounds (the caster still expends the PPs for this spell).

sp-02271.description_en: As Leaving I, except movement range is 300'.

sp-02272.description_en: As Long Door I, except movement range is 10 miles per level. This can be very risky depending upon the caster's familiarity with the destination's locale. The following chances for failure exist: Never seen place (but has had described) = 50%; Been briefly (one hour or less) = 25%; Studied (been in for 24 hours) = 10%; Studied carefully (7 days) = 1%; Lived in (for at least one year) = .01%. In the case of failure, first determine the direction of the error (randomly). The amount of error is then determined by making a d100 (open-ended) to determine the distance of the error in feet.

sp-02273.description_en: As Fly I, except rate is 300' per round.

sp-02274.description_en: As Long Door I, except movement range is 300'.

sp-02275.description_en: As Teleport I, except up to 3 targets may be moved to same place.

sp-02276.description_en: As Portal, except portal is 3'x6' and up to 5' per level deep.

sp-02277.description_en: As Long Door I, except movement range is 500'.

sp-02278.description_en: As Teleport III, except 5 targets may be moved.

sp-02279.description_en: As Fly I, except rate is 450' per round.

sp-02280.description_en: As Teleport III, except 10 targets may be moved.

sp-02281.description_en: As Leaving, except as many targets as the caster's level may be moved.

sp-02282.description_en: As Teleport III, except 20 targets can be moved.

sp-02283.description_en: As Long Door, except as many targets as the caster's level may be moved up to 300'.

sp-02284.description_en: As Teleport III, except as many targets as the caster's level may be moved.

sp-02285.description_en: As Teleport I, except with an unlimited movement range.

sp-02376.description_en: Target may run at double his normal walking pace; he expends exhaustion points at the same rate he would if he were walking, once he stops or performs some other action the spell is canceled.

sp-02377.description_en: Target may act at twice his normal rate (i.e., 200% activity per round), but immediately afterwards must spend a number of rounds equal to the rounds speeded at half rate (i.e., only 50% normal activity per round). See 7.1.24 for more information.

sp-02378.description_en: Target reads at a rate of 10 pages per minute.

sp-02379.description_en: As Speed I, except duration is 2 rounds for one target or 1 round for each of 2 targets.

sp-02380.description_en: Target may run at triple his normal walking pace and only expends exhaustion points at the same rate he would if he were walking. Once he stops or performs some other action the spell is canceled.

sp-02381.description_en: Target may act at twice his normal rate (i.e., 200% activity). See Section 7.1.24 for more information.

sp-02382.description_en: As Speed I, except duration is 3 rounds split among one to three targets (in any combination).

sp-02383.description_en: As Haste I, except duration is 2 rounds for one target or 1 round for each of 2 targets.

sp-02384.description_en: Target may run at four times his normal walking pace and only expend exhaustion points at the same rate he would if he were walking, but once he stops or performs some other action the spell is canceled.

sp-02385.description_en: As Speed III, except duration is 5 rounds split among one to five targets (in any combination).

sp-02386.description_en: As Run I, except 3 targets may be affected.

sp-02387.description_en: As Haste I, except duration is 3 rounds split

sp-02388.description_en: As Sprint I, except 3 targets may be affected.

sp-02389.description_en: As Haste III, except duration is 5 rounds split among one to five targets (in any combination).

sp-02390.description_en: As Run I, except 5 targets may be affected.

sp-02391.description_en: As Speed III, except duration is 10 rounds split among one to ten targets (in any combination).

sp-02392.description_en: As Sprint I, except 5 targets may be affected.

sp-02393.description_en: As Haste III, except duration is 10 rounds split among one to ten targets (in any combination).

sp-02394.description_en: As Run I, except as many targets as the caster's level may be affected.

sp-02395.description_en: As Speed III, except duration is a number of rounds equal to the caster's level, split among any number of targets up to the caster's level (in any combination).

sp-02396.description_en: As Haste III, except duration is a number of rounds equal to the caster's level, split among any number of targets up to the caster's level (in any combination).

sp-02397.description_en: Caster temporarily enchants a nonmagic, non-metal shield with a +10 Defensive Bonus (DB).

sp-02398.description_en: Creates an invisible force shield in front of the caster. This functions as a normal shield (subtracting 25 from appropriate attacks, etc.), except it does not occupy a hand. This spell cannot be combined with a “real” shield.

sp-02399.description_en: Causes target to appear blurred to attackers. This subtracts 10 from all attacks.

sp-02400.description_en: Caster temporarily enchants one robe to confer a +10 DB.

sp-02401.description_en: Caster can deflect any one missile that passes within 100' of him (caster must be able to see the missile). This causes 100 to be subtracted from the missile's attack.

sp-02402.description_en: Caster temporarily enchants one nonmagic suit of leather (usually a shirt) with a +10 DB.

sp-02403.description_en: Caster can deflect any one melee attack that he can see (and is within range). This causes 50 to be subtracted from the attack.

sp-02404.description_en: As Deflections I, except 2 missiles may be affected.

sp-02405.description_en: Caster can deflect any one missile that passes within 100' of him (caster must be able to see the missile). This causes the missile to automatically miss its target.

sp-02406.description_en: As Bladeturn I, except 2 melee attacks may be affected.

sp-02407.description_en: As Deflections I, except 3 missiles may be affected.

sp-02408.description_en: As Aim Untrue I, except 2 missiles may be affected.

sp-02409.description_en: As Bladeturn I, except 3 melee attacks may be affected.

sp-02410.description_en: One missile passing within 100' of caster is reversed and make an attack on its source. For the attack on the missile's source, use an OB of +5 (no other OB or DB modifiers apply).

sp-02411.description_en: As Aim Untrue I, except 3 missiles may be affected.

sp-02412.description_en: As Deflections I, except as many missiles as the caster's level may be affected.

sp-02413.description_en: As Bladeturn I, except as many melee attacks as the caster's level may be affected.

sp-02414.description_en: As Mass Deflections, except missiles automatically miss.

sp-02415.description_en: As Re-aiming, except all missiles passing within 100' of caster are reversed. Each missile attacks its firer with a +20 OB.

sp-02416.description_en: Caster can add a minor smell, visual, or audio aspect to the next spell that he casts. This minor effect cannot increase or change the effects of the spell in any fashion.

sp-02417.description_en: Causes the next spell that the caster casts (within 1 minute) to have double the normal duration. This spell is not cumulative with any other Extension spells.

sp-02418.description_en: Causes the next spell that the caster casts (within 1 minute) to have its range increased by 50'. This spell is not cumulative with any other Ranging spells.

sp-02419.description_en: As Extension II, except duration is 3 times normal.

sp-02420.description_en: As Ranging I, except the casting time is instant.

sp-02421.description_en: Causes the next spell that the caster casts (within 1 minute) to have its area of effect increased by 5'. This spell is not cumulative with other Increased Radius spells.

sp-02422.description_en: As Ranging I, except range increase is 100'.

sp-02424.description_en: As Instant Ranging I, except range is increased by 100'.

sp-02425.description_en: As Increased Radius II, except area of effect is increased by 10'.

sp-02426.description_en: As Ranging I, except range increase is 200'.

sp-02427.description_en: As Extension II, except duration is 5 times normal.

sp-02428.description_en: As Instant Ranging I, except range is increased by 200'.

sp-02429.description_en: As Increased Radius II, except area of effect is increased by 15'.

sp-02430.description_en: As Ranging I, except range increase is 300'.

sp-02431.description_en: As Extension II, except duration is 10 times normal.

sp-02432.description_en: As Instant Ranging I, except range is increased by 300'.

sp-02433.description_en: As Increased Radius II, except area of effect is increased by 20'.

sp-02434.description_en: As Ranging I, except range increase is 500'.

sp-02435.description_en: As Extension II, except duration is increased by 12 hours.

sp-02436.description_en: As Extension II, except duration is increased by 24 hours.

sp-02437.description_en: As Extension II, except duration is permanent. Only one permanent spell can be in effect at a time for each spell caster.

sp-02461.description_en: Caster may cast this spell with any spell he wants to store. The spell to be stored must be cast within one minute after the Spell Store is cast. The stored spell may then be cast later as an instantaneous spell. The Spell Store costs the same number of PPs as the spell that is stored. No other spell may be cast while a spell is stored.

sp-02462.description_en: If the target of this spell is casting a spell, the caster will know what realm the spell is from and what type of spell the target is casting.

sp-02463.description_en: The attack spell that is targeted with this spell must make an RR (using its caster's level as its level). If the RR succeeds, it will attack its original target as intended; otherwise, the effects of that spell are delayed for the duration of this spell. At the end of the duration, if the target of the held spell has moved more than 20', the held spell may randomly affect another target within 10' of the original target point. Base attack spells will suffer a -20 modification if not cast upon the original target. Elemental attack spell suffer a -30 modification if not cast upon the original target.

sp-02464.description_en: Caster can deflect 1 elemental attack spell. The incoming spell must make an RR (using its caster's level as its level). If the RR succeeds, it will attack its target normally; otherwise, its attack roll is modified by -10 per 10 failure.

sp-02465.description_en: As Spell Hold I, except attack spells can be held up to 2 rounds.

sp-02466.description_en: As Spell Bending I, except attack roll is modified by -20 per 10 failure.

sp-02467.description_en: As Spell Hold I, except attack spells can be held up to 3 rounds.

sp-02468.description_en: The target elemental attack spell must make an RR (using its caster's level as its level) with a modification of +20 (in favor of the elemental attack spell). If the RR suceeds, it makes its attack as normal; otherwise, the elemental attack spell is reversed back on its caster. Resolve the attack with only a +0 OB.

sp-02469.description_en: As Spell Bending I, except attack roll is modified by -30 per 10 failure.

sp-02470.description_en: As Spell Hold I, except attack spells can be held up to 4 rounds.

sp-02471.description_en: The caster may “borrow” power points from the days to come. When this spell is cast, the caster regain all of his power points (up to his maximum). The PP cost for casting this spell may come from the “borrowed” PPs. Every time the caster casts this spell, he looses all PPs for the next two days (the normal duration of this spell). He also takes hits equal to 10% of his normal maximum hits. In addition, for the duration of this spell, he will cast spells as if he were one level lower than he actually is. This spell may be cast multiple times (borrowing PPs from many days to come), but all the effects are cumulative. For example, if cast twice, the caster will lose all PPs for the next 4 days, take 20% of his hits, and cast spells at 2 levels lower than normal. All penalties will remain in effect until the duration of the spell lapses. At the end of this spell's duration, the caster must sleep for a consecutive 10 hours for each time this spell was cast.

sp-02472.description_en: As Spell Bending I, except attack roll is modified by -40 per 10 failure.

sp-02473.description_en: As Spell Hold I, except attack spell is held up to 5 rounds.

sp-02474.description_en: As Reverse Spell I, except use an OB equal to half the original OB.

sp-02475.description_en: As Spell Bending I, except attack roll is modified by -50 per 10 failure.

sp-02476.description_en: As Spell Hold I, except attack spell is held up to 10 rounds.

sp-02477.description_en: As Spell Hold I, except attack spell is held for up to 20 rounds.

sp-02478.description_en: As Spell Bending I, except spell can be deflected up to 90˚ in any direction (caster of this spell may designate another target for the spell, use half of his appropriate

sp-02479.description_en: As Spell Hold I, except attack spell is held up to 1 round per level.

sp-02480.description_en: As Reverse Spells, except all spells within a 100'R of the caster are reversed.

sp-02438.description_en: Causes target(s) to fall into a natural sleep. This spell can affect a number of targets whose levels total up to 5. The caster must be able to see all the targets. At the time of casting, the caster should designate target priority (i.e., affect target A; if levels are left, affect target B; etc.). The first 2 rounds of sleep are magical (the target cannot be awakened through normal means).

sp-02439.description_en: Target humanoid believes the caster is a good friend.

sp-02440.description_en: As Sleep V, except a total of 7 levels can be affected.

sp-02441.description_en: Target is incapable of making decisions or initiating action. However, the target may continue to fight if already engaged; he may also fight in self defense.

sp-02442.description_en: Target will follow a single suggested act that is not completely alien to him (e.g., no suicide suggestions, no blinding himself suggestions, etc.).

sp-02443.description_en: As Sleep V, except a total of 10 levels may be affected.

sp-02444.description_en: Target humanoid is held to 25% activity per round.

sp-02445.description_en: Target humanoid must obey caster. However, he will not perform any act that is completely alien to him (e.g., no suicide suggestions, no blinding himself, etc.).

sp-02446.description_en: As Sleep V, except a total of 20 levels may be affected.

sp-02447.description_en: As Charm Kind, except any sentient creature may be affected.

sp-02448.description_en: Target is given one task, failure results in a penalty determined by the Gamemaster (task must be within capabilities of target). If the target ignores the quest, he will suffer the same effects as for failure.

sp-02449.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] Target is stunned for 1 round per 10 failure.

sp-02450.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] As Word of Stunning, except target takes 50% of remaining concussion hits upon failure.

sp-02451.description_en: As Hold Kind, except any sentient being can be affected.

sp-02452.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] As Word of Stunning, except target falls into a natural sleep. The first minute of sleep is magical;the target cannot be awakened through normal means.

sp-02453.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] As Word of Stunning, except target will not cooperate or agree with anyone for 1 day per 10 failure.

sp-02454.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] Target is forced to come and face the caster (fighting to get there if necessary). Once he faces the caster, he must remain immobile for 1 round per 10 failure. For the duration of this spell, the caster must remain immobile, or the spell is dispelled.

sp-02455.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] Any of the “Words” above can be set to go off at a specified time or if there is movement within a designated 10'R.

sp-02456.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] Target suffers the results of an 'E' critical strike; the caster chooses the critical type.

sp-02457.description_en: As Quest, except failure is punished by the target suffering five 'E' critical strikes (choose which critical types randomly).

sp-02458.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] As Word of Stunning, except any three different “Words” may be used on the same round (a separate RR roll must be made for each one). If all three words are the same, and all three RR's fail, the effect is permanent.

sp-02459.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] As Word of Stunning, except any “Word” may be used and it will affect a number of levels equal to the level of the caster (as Sleep).

sp-02460.description_en: Caster can use one spell/rnd on this list (10th level or lower).

sp-00001.description_en: Fills the area of effect with a set of immobile smells. The smells are real (no RR) and detecting that it is an illusion can normally only be accomplished through spells or the use of a sense other than sight.

sp-00002.description_en: Target is struck with the equivalent of a bare fist (the attack is invisible unless combined with the visual sense in an Illusion or Phantasm). Treat as a Martial Arts Striking Rank I attack. Directed Spells skill may be developed for this attack.

sp-00003.description_en: As Smell Mirage, except a set of tastes can be created.

sp-00004.description_en: Creates a 10'R cloud of noxious gas that will stun anyone failing to resist (all targets must make a RR each round they are in cloud). The cloud drifts with the wind. Targets failing their RR are stunned for 1 round per 10 failure.

sp-00005.description_en: As Smell Mirage, except all the objects and surfaces in a 10'R can be made to feel differently than they really are. Striking an object or surface will cancel the spell for that object or surface only.

sp-00006.description_en: One object (up to 10 pounds per level) has either its taste, its smell, or the way its surface feels altered for the duration of the spell. Note that the visual aspects of the object do not change.

sp-00007.description_en: As Strike I, except range is 300'.

sp-00008.description_en: As Tear Cloud I, except radius is 20'.

sp-00009.description_en: As Feel Mirage I, except objects with a feel mirage on them must be struck three times before the feeling is cancelled.

sp-00010.description_en: As Strike I, except range is 500'.

sp-00011.description_en: All of the terrain in the area of effect will feel differently than it actually does. The caster may designate in what way the terrain feels differently. For example, flat ground could be made to feel rocky; or rocky ground could be made to feel flat.

sp-00012.description_en: As many objects as the caster's level can be given individual smells and tastes.

sp-00013.description_en: As Tear Cloud I, except radius is 50'.

sp-00014.description_en: As Feel Mirage I, except objects must be struck five times.

sp-00015.description_en: As many objects as the caster's level can be given individual feeling surfaces.

sp-00016.description_en: As Feel Mirage I, except objects must be struck seven times.

sp-00017.description_en: As Feel Mirage I, except objects must be struck ten times.

sp-00018.description_en: As Smell Mirage, except one object can be given a smell permanently.

sp-00019.description_en: As Taste Mirage, except one object can be given a taste permanently.

sp-00020.description_en: As Feel Mirage I, except one object can be to permanently feel differently than it really is.

sp-00021.description_en: Causes target to appear blurred to attackers, subtracting 10 from all attacks.

sp-00022.description_en: Target and objects on his person appear to be a shadow; and thus are almost invisible in dark areas (e.g., in many situations this could be handled with a Stalking/Hiding bonus between 25 and 75).

sp-00023.description_en: Target has a limited illusion on himself that allows him to look like any humanoid race within 20% of his own size. The illusion moves as the target moves.

sp-00024.description_en: [RR Mod: -50] Caster can communicate simple ideas to the target through sign language (yes, no, hungry, good-bye, etc.). To the target it will seem as if the caster were speaking the target's language.

sp-00025.description_en: Target appears to be offset from where he actually is. All attacks have no effect 10% of the time. Each time a foe misses, the chance of foe missing again goes down by 5%.

sp-00026.description_en: As Facade I, except one of the other senses can be added.

sp-00027.description_en: As Facade I, except that a specific person can be impersonated with regards to looks. The person must have been observed for at least 1 minute of concentration.

sp-00028.description_en: As Facade I, except two of the other senses can be added.

sp-00030.description_en: As Displacement I, except chance of missing is 20%.

sp-00032.description_en: As Impersonation Facade I, except that two other aspects (or traits) of the person are impersonated. In addition, the caster must study the target for at least three minutes of concentration. For example, the target's voice and scent may be impersonated.

sp-00033.description_en: As Blur, except as many targets as the caster's level can be affected.

sp-00034.description_en: As Facade I, except all of the other senses (except for Presence) may be added.

sp-00035.description_en: As Displacement I, except chance of missing is 30%.

sp-00036.description_en: As Impersonation Facade I, except that three other aspects (or traits) of the person are impersonated. In addition, the caster must study the target for at least four minutes of concentration. For example, the target's voice, scent, and subtle mannerisms may be impersonated.

sp-00037.description_en: The caster may cast this spell and instantly know everything he needs to know for use with the Impersonation spells (i.e., this spell overrides the necessity for studying the target).

sp-00038.description_en: As Impersonation Facade I, except all aspects of the person are impersonated. In addition, the caster must study the target for at least five minutes of concentration. With this spell, even the closest friends and relations will have difficulty noticing the facade.

sp-00039.description_en: As Displacement I, except chance of missing is 40%.

sp-00040.description_en: As Facade I, except as many targets as the caster's level can be affected.

sp-00041.description_en: As Displacement I, except chance of missing is 50%.

sp-00042.description_en: As Facade V, except the caster can change the facade to a different facade each round.

sp-00043.description_en: Creates a simple immobile image or scene in the area of effect. One of the following options may also be chosen: a) an extra sense can be added to the illusion (the corresponding Mirage spell must be known) or b) the duration can be doubled or c) the range can be doubled or d) the radius of effect can be doubled. All parts of the area of effect must be within range (and within sight of the caster).

sp-00044.description_en: Creates the image of one object or being, that will move however the caster wants (as long as the caster concentrates). When the caster stops concentrating the image remains, but stops moving. The caster may resume concentration later and make the image move again (presuming that the duration has not expired). The image can be any size that would fit into a 10'R sphere.

sp-00045.description_en: As Illusion II, except any two of the options may be chosen. See the notes below for guidelines on how to combine the options.

sp-00046.description_en: As Illusion II, except it can be delayed up to 24 hours. At the time of casting, the caster must decide upon the trigger for the spell. The caster can choose one of the following: a) time period, b) specified movement, c) specified sound, d) specified touch, e) specified smell, f) specified taste, g) a specified Presence spell cast within the area of effect. If a sense is used to trigger the spell, that sense must be included in the illusion.

sp-00047.description_en: As Phantasm I, except one of the following options may also be chosen: a) an extra sense can be added (the corresponding Mirage spell must be known), b) the duration can be doubled, c) the radius of the area of effect can be doubled, d) the range can be doubled, e) another image can be created and moved (all separate phantasms that move must be within the caster's field of vision and within range of the spell), or f) limited repetitious sounds, movements, etc. can be added that do not require the concentration of the caster (the proper sense must also be included with the illusion).

sp-00048.description_en: As Illusion II, except any four of the options may be chosen.

sp-00049.description_en: II — As Phantasm II, except it can be delayed as in Waiting Illusion II. The Phantasm will move and act if given a simple command (e.g., attack, run, etc.) or it can deliver a short speech (if sound was one of the senses).

sp-00050.description_en: As Waiting Illusion II, except any two of the options may be chosen.

sp-00051.description_en: As Phantasm II, except any two of the options may be chosen.

sp-00052.description_en: As Illusion II, except any six of the options may be chosen.

sp-00053.description_en: As Waiting Phantasm II, except any two of the options may be chosen.

sp-00054.description_en: As Phantasm I, except any three of the options may be chosen.

sp-00055.description_en: As Waiting Illusion II, except any four of the options may be chosen.

sp-00056.description_en: As Phantasm II, except any four of the options may be chosen.

sp-00057.description_en: As Illusion II, except any nine of the options may be chosen.

sp-00058.description_en: As Waiting Phantasm II, except any four of the options may be chosen.

sp-00059.description_en: As Phantasm II, except any six of the options may be chosen.

sp-00060.description_en: As Waiting Illusion II, except any four of the options may be chosen.

sp-00061.description_en: All of the terrain in the area of effect will appear differently than it actually is (the corresponding Terrain spell must be known). The caster may designate in what way the terrain is different. For example, a clearing the woods could be disguised as a heavily wooded are of the woods.

sp-00062.description_en: As Phantasm II, except any nine of the options may be chosen.

sp-00063.description_en: As Waiting Illusion, except any nine of the options may be chosen.

sp-00064.description_en: As Illusion X, except its duration is permanent (until dispelled).

sp-00065.description_en: As Phantasm X, except its duration is permanent (until dispelled).

sp-00066.description_en: Creates any simple immobile image or scene up to an area of 10'R.

sp-00067.description_en: Beam of light (like a flashlight) springs from the caster's palm. This light has a 50' effective range. If the caster closes his fist, the light will “turn off;” when the fist is opened, the light will come back on (so long as the duration of the spell has not expired).

sp-00068.description_en: Caster can control the intensity of light within the area of effect. The intensity can vary from daylight to darkness (natural), and it can be different in different parts of the radius.

sp-00069.description_en: Causes a 10'R burst of intense light. All those in the area of effect are stunned 1 round per 5 failure.

sp-00070.description_en: I — A bolt of intense, charged light is shot from the palm of the caster. Attack is resolved on the Shock Bolt Attack Table.

sp-00071.description_en: One object (up to 10 pounds per level) has visual appearance altered for the duration of the spell. Note that the no other aspect of the object changes.

sp-00072.description_en: Creates an area of darkness about the target's head that blinds him. It may be dispelled or cancelled by Utterlight. The area of effect moves with the target.

sp-00073.description_en: As Light Control I, except area affected is 50'R.

sp-00074.description_en: Nullifies all magically created darkness in a 100'R, and lights that area as full daylight.

sp-00075.description_en: All of the terrain in the area of effect will appear differently than it actually does. The caster may designate in what way the terrain appears different. For example, for a group of small trees could be made into a group of tall trees. Note that only the visual aspect of the terrain changes.

sp-00076.description_en: A ray of light (any color) springs from caster's palm. This ray can be up to 1 mile long.

sp-00077.description_en: Darkens a 100'R area, no non-magic light can exist and magic light (except Utterlight) must make an RR).

sp-00078.description_en: As Light Control I, except area affected is 100'R.

sp-00079.description_en: As Shock Bolt I, except range is 300'.

sp-00080.description_en: As Beacon I, except ray can be up to 5 miles long.

sp-00081.description_en: As Shock Bolt, except a Lightning Bolt is shot. Resolve attack on the Lightning Bolt Attack Table.

sp-00082.description_en: As Light Control I, except area affected is 500'R.

sp-00083.description_en: As Lightning Bolt I, except range is 300'.

sp-00084.description_en: As Light Control I, except area affected is 100'R/lvl.

sp-00085.description_en: Caster can check one object or place (up to a 5'R) and tell if it is an illusion or has an illusion on it.

sp-00086.description_en: Detects all invisible objects or beings in the area of effect. Caster can concentrate on a different 5'R each round. All attacks against something so detected are modified by -50. See Section 7.1.10 for rules on invisibility.

sp-00087.description_en: For the purposes of mental or magical detections, target appears to be of any race the caster chooses.

sp-00088.description_en: As Misfeel Kind, except target's level may be misrepresented by 1 level (up or down).

sp-00089.description_en: Creates a false presence (for the purposes of magical detections) in the area of effect.

sp-00090.description_en: As Misfeel Kind, except target's profession may be misrepresented.

sp-00091.description_en: As Misfeel Power I, except target's level may be misrepresented by up to 3 levels (up or down).

sp-00092.description_en: ations — As Misfeel Power I, except an object's power emanations may be reduced, so that a minor item's power is undetectable and major items seem like minor items (for spells such as Detect Essence, Detect Power, Detect Channeling, etc.).

sp-00093.description_en: As Misfeel Power I, except target's level may be misrepresented by up to 5 levels (up or down).

sp-00094.description_en: One illusion within the area of effect ceases to exist (for the caster only).

sp-00095.description_en: As Detect Illusion, except caster can concentrate on one object or place per round.

sp-00096.description_en: As Misfeel Power I, except target's level can be misrepresented by up to 10 levels (up or down).

sp-00097.description_en: As Disillusion I, except up to three illusions within the area of effect cease to exist.

sp-00098.description_en: Applies all the lower level Misfeels to a target at once (only one Misfeel Power can be applied).

sp-00099.description_en: As Misfeel Kind, except target appears to have no presence.

sp-00100.description_en: As Disillusion I, except up to five illusions within the area of effect cease to exist.

sp-00101.description_en: As Unpresence I, except will affect up to three targets.

sp-00102.description_en: As Disillusion I, except all illusions within the area of effect cease to exist.

sp-00103.description_en: As Unpresence I, except affects up to five targets.

sp-00105.description_en: As Unpresence, except up to 20 targets may be affected.

sp-00106.description_en: As Misfeel, except as many targets as the caster's level can be affected.

sp-00107.description_en: Creates any simple immobile set up sounds up to an area of 10'R.

sp-00108.description_en: Creates a 5'R area into and out of which sound cannot travel. If the point is on a mobile object or being, it will move with the object/being. This results in a +25 to Stalking attempts. See Section 7.1.7.

sp-00109.description_en: Caster can control the intensity of sounds within the area of effect. The intensity can vary from absolute silence to a very loud shout, and it can be different in different parts of the radius.

sp-00110.description_en: Causes a very loud, sudden sound next to the target's ears. The target is stunned for 1 round per 5 failure.

sp-00111.description_en: As Sound Control I, except radius is 50'.

sp-00112.description_en: One object (up to 10 pounds per level) has its sound altered for the duration of the spell. Note that the no other aspect of the object changes.

sp-00113.description_en: Target cannot hear sounds occurring more than 6" from his ears, and no one can hear him speak from more than 6" away.

sp-00114.description_en: As Silence I, except radius is 50'.

sp-00115.description_en: All beings within area of effect capable of hearing ultrasonic sounds (except for the caster) are stunned for 1 round per 10 failure. Animals capable of hearing ultrasonics will panic and flee. A RR must be made each round while in radius.

sp-00116.description_en: As Sound Control I, except radius is 100'.

sp-00117.description_en: As Sudden Sound, except everyone the area of effect is affected.

sp-00118.description_en: All of the terrain in the area of effect will have sounds that are different than it actually has. The caster may designate in what way the terrain sounds different. For example, an open plain could be made to sound like a rustling forset. Note that only the audio aspect of the terrain changes.

sp-00119.description_en: As Silence I, except radius is 100'.

sp-00120.description_en: As Deafen, except everyone in a 10'R is affected.

sp-00121.description_en: As Sound Control I, except radius is 10'/lvl.

sp-00122.description_en: As Silence I, except for range.

sp-00123.description_en: As Sound Control I, except for range.

sp-00124.description_en: As Sudden Sound, except for range.

sp-00126.description_en: As Deafen, except as many targets as the caster's level can be affected.

sp-00127.description_en: As Silence I, except as many targets as the caster's level can have a 1'R silence on them.

sp-00128.description_en: As Sound Control, except radius is 20'/lvl and the caster does not have to concentrate.

sp-00129.description_en: As Minor Ultrasonics, except everyone (except for the caster) in a 100'R is affected. Anyone failing their RR by more than 40 is unconscious. Anyone failing their RR by more than 75 is dead.

sp-00130.description_en: If caster holds one end of a rope he can cause the rope to move up to its length (within the area of effect) in any direction and to tie itself in knots (it cannot attack or tie up a living being).

sp-00131.description_en: Loosens 100 cu' of earth to the consistency of plowed ground.

sp-00132.description_en: Creates of wall of earth up to 10' x 10' x (3' at the base, 1' at the top). This wall can be dug through.

sp-00133.description_en: Any previous cracks or flaws in material up to 10'x10'x10' section will extend to their limit.

sp-00134.description_en: The caster may mend a single break in a small (up to 2 pounds) inorganic object or multiple breaks, rips, or cracks in a larger (up to 10 pounds) organic object. All component parts of the object must be within a 10' radius.

sp-00135.description_en: As Earthwall, except wall is up to 10'x10'x1' of stone. It can be chipped through.

sp-00136.description_en: This spell causes the area of effect to bristle with hundreds of 6" to 12" sharp edges and blades. The exact composition of these spikes will depend on the material the ground is made of. The area of effect must be placed horizontally on a surface (i.e., it cannot be placed on walls). Most animals and creatures cannot be induced to walk through the area. Anyone moving through the area must make a manuever roll (at least Extremely Hard difficulty) for every 5' moved through. Anyone who falls inside the area of effect receives an 'A' Puncture critical strike.

sp-00137.description_en: Changes 100 cubic feet of stone to packed earth. This change is gradual (taking three rounds for complete change).

sp-00138.description_en: As Earthwall, except duration is permanent.

sp-00139.description_en: As Stone/Earth, except changes earth to soft mud.

sp-00140.description_en: As Stone/Earth, except changes packed earth to solid stone and loose earth to gravel.

sp-00141.description_en: As Stonewall, except duration is permanent.

sp-00142.description_en: As Stone/Earth, except changes mud to packed earth.

sp-00143.description_en: Disintegrates (i.e., nothing is left ) 100 cubic feet of earth.

sp-00144.description_en: Fuses two touching walls together (seam can be up to 20' long) or fuses a section of stone blocks (up to 100 cubic feet).

sp-00145.description_en: As Stone/Earth, except changes stone to mud.

sp-00146.description_en: As Stonewall True, except wall may be curved up to a semicircle.

sp-00148.description_en: As Unearth, except affects 1 cubic foot of metal.

sp-00149.description_en: Causes a very minor earthquake which could cause shoddy construction to collapse (this can be very terrifying). This is approximately 5.5 on the Richter scale.

sp-00150.description_en: Caster can use one lower level spell (on this list) each round.

sp-00151.description_en: For each level of caster, one cubic foot of liquid can be heated to boiling at a rate of 1 cubic feet per round.
