sp-00152.description_en: Any solid inanimate, non-metal material (up to 1 cubic foot per level) can be warmed to 100˚F at a rate of 1 cubic foot per round of concentration.

sp-00153.description_en: Causes any wood to ignite and burn. All wood ignited must be within 1' of caster's palm.

sp-00154.description_en: Creates an opaque wall of fire (up to 10' x 10' x 6'). Anyone passing through it takes an 'A' Heat critical (no

sp-00155.description_en: As Warm Solid, except for duration and material can be heated to 500˚F at a rate of 50˚F per round. The caster must concentrate to increase the temperature (without concentration, the material will remain at its current temperature for the duration of the spell).

sp-00156.description_en: A bolt of fire is shot from the palm of the caster. Resolve attack on the Fire Bolt Table.

sp-00157.description_en: As Wall of Fire, except it creates a cube of flame (up to 10' x 10' x 10'). The cube takes a complete round to form and be effective. Anyone passing through (or that is caught inside) the cube takes an 'A' Heat critical.

sp-00158.description_en: A 1' diameter ball of fire is shot from the palm of the caster. Upon reaching its target, it explodes to affect a 10'R area. Resolve attack on the Fire Ball Table.

sp-00159.description_en: The caster may designate a type of light source to ignite or extinguish (e.g., candles, torches, fireplaces, and lanterns, etc.). This spell will affect all of the light sources of the specified type(s) within the area of effect.

sp-00160.description_en: As Wall of Fire, except “wall” is 10' high and forms a 10'R circle (6" thick) with the caster at the center (the wall will not move with the caster).

sp-00161.description_en: As Fire Bolt I, except range is 300'.

sp-00162.description_en: As Call Flame I, except cube is up to 20'x20'x20' in size and the range is 20'.

sp-00163.description_en: As Call Flame I, except the effect can be delayed for up to 24 hours. The effect can be triggered by one of the following (decided by caster at the time of casting): time period, specific movements, specific sounds, touch, violent actions in the area, etc.

sp-00164.description_en: As Call Flame, except small balls of flame rain down in a 10' cube causing a 'B' Heat critical to all passing through (or caught within).

sp-00165.description_en: Causes a metal object to burst into flames. The object can be up to 1 lb/lvl in mass. If the object is on a being, it gets a RR. If the RR fails, the being takes an automatic Heat critical of a severity to be determined by its location on the being's body. If the object is touching exposed flesh, the being takes a 'C' Heat critical; if the object is touching through cloth, the being takes a 'B' Heat critical; in all other cases, the being takes an 'A' Heat critical.

sp-00166.description_en: Three bolts of fire are shot from the palm of the caster. They can strike up to three different targets (as long as they are all withing 60˚ of each other; and they are visible to the caster). Caster may apply his directed spell skill (Firebolt) to only one of the attacks (others get a +0 OB).

sp-00167.description_en: As Fire Bolt I, except the range is 500'.

sp-00168.description_en: As Waiting Flame, except a Firestorm can be delayed.

sp-00169.description_en: As Call Flame I, except size is up to a 50' cube and the range is 50'.

sp-00170.description_en: As Fire Bolt III, except caster can make the bolt turn once up to 90˚ before striking the target (the caster must know the target's location). The OB for the bolt is halved after making the turn.

sp-00171.description_en: As Corner Fires, except bolt can make as many turns as necessary and go through openings (must be larger than 6" radius) to strike the target.

sp-00172.description_en: As Metal Fires, except up to a 300 square foot stone surface is affected and a 'C' Heat critical is given each round passing through (or caught within) the 3' flames.

sp-00173.description_en: Caster can use any one lower level spell (on this list) each round.

sp-00174.description_en: For every level of the caster, 1 cubic foot of liquid is cooled to freezing at a rate of one cubic foot per round. This will not drop a liquid's temperature below -20˚F (thus, liquids will a freezing point below -20˚F will not freeze).

sp-00175.description_en: Any solid, inanimate, non-metal material can be cooled to -20˚F, at a rate of 1 cubic foot per round of concentration.

sp-00176.description_en: Creates a clear wall of intense cold (up to 10'x10'x1'). Anyone passing through this wall takes an 'A' Cold critical (no RR).

sp-00177.description_en: As Cool Solid, except material can be cooled to -200˚F, at a rate of 50˚F per round. The caster must concentrate to decrease the temperature (without concentration, the material will remain at its current temperature for the duration of the spell).

sp-00178.description_en: A bolt of ice is shot from the palm of the caster. Resolve attack on the Ice Bolt Attack Table.

sp-00179.description_en: A 1' diameter ball of cold is shot from the palm of the caster. Upon reaching its target, it explodes to affect a 20'R area. Resolve attack on the Cold Ball Attack Table.

sp-00180.description_en: Summons a wall of ice up to 10'x10'x(2' at base, 1' at top). It can be melted through or chipped through or toppled (if not against a solid surface).

sp-00181.description_en: As Wall of Cold, except it creates a cube of cold (up to 10' x 10' x 10'). The cube takes a complete round to form and be effective. Anyone passing through (or that is caught inside) the cube takes an 'A' Cold critical.

sp-00182.description_en: As Wall of Cold, except “wall” is 10' high and forms a 20'R circle (6" thick) with the caster at the center (the wall will not move with the caster).

sp-00183.description_en: As Ice Bolt I, except range is 300'.

sp-00184.description_en: For every level of the caster, changes 10 cubic foot of water to ice, instantly.

sp-00185.description_en: As Chill Solid, except chills metal to the point that it becomes extremely brittle (1 object only). Under normal conditions, this will decrease a weapon's strength (when checking for breakage) by 50. In addition, the weapon will have its breakage number increased by 5 (to a maximum of 10). Each following minute the breakage factor will decrease by 1 until it returns to normal (i.e., it warms up); also, the weapon's strength will increase by 5 each minute until it returns to normal.

sp-00186.description_en: As Call Cold I, except size is up to a 20' cube and the range is 20'.

sp-00187.description_en: As Ice Bolt I, except range is 500'.

sp-00188.description_en: Three bolts of ice are shot from the palm of the caster. They can strike up to three different targets (as long as they are all withing 60˚ of each other; and they are visible to the caster). Caster may apply his directed spell skill (Icebolt) to only one of the attacks (the others get a +0 OB).

sp-00189.description_en: As Call Cold I, except size is up to a 50' cube and the range is 100'.

sp-00190.description_en: As Cold Ball II, except area of effect is 40'R and the range is 300'.

sp-00191.description_en: Changes all rain within 1 mile of the caster to snow. The area of effect decreases by 500'R for every 10˚F above freezing.

sp-00192.description_en: Causes the temperature to drop 1˚F every 10 minutes up to a number of degrees equal to the caster's level.

sp-00193.description_en: Caster can use any one lower level spell (on this list) each round.

sp-00194.description_en: Beam of light (like a flashlight) springs from the caster's palm. This light has a 50' effective range. If the caster closes his fist, the light will “turn off;” when the fist is opened, the light will come back on (so long as the duration of the spell has not expired).

sp-00195.description_en: A bolt of intense, charged light is shot from the palm of the caster. Attack is resolved on the Shock Bolt Attack Table.

sp-00196.description_en: Lights a 10'R area about the point touched. If the point is on a mobile object or being, it will move with the object/ being. See Section 7.1.17.

sp-00197.description_en: All shadows in the area of effect deepen. This results in a +25 bonus to hiding manuevers and +10 to stalking manuevers.

sp-00198.description_en: Causes a 10'R burst of intense light. All those in the area of effect are stunned 1 round per 5 failure.

sp-00199.description_en: As Light I, except the radius is as a dark night.

sp-00200.description_en: As Light I, except radius can be up to 50' (the exact radius can be changed by concentrating for one round).

sp-00201.description_en: As Shock Bolt I, except range is 300'.

sp-00202.description_en: As Dark I, except radius can be up to 50' (the exact radius can be changed by concentrating for one round).

sp-00203.description_en: As Shock Bolt, except a Lightning Bolt is shot. Resolve attack on the Lightning Bolt Attack Table.

sp-00204.description_en: This spell is cast in conjunction with any Light or Dark spell (i.e., this spell is cast and then the light/dark spell is cast within 1 minute). It can delay the action of that spell for up to 24 hours. It can be triggered by one of the following (decided by caster at the time of casting): time period, specific movements, specific sounds, touch, violent actions in the area, etc.

sp-00205.description_en: As Shock Bolt I, except range is 500'.

sp-00206.description_en: A ray of light (any color) springs from caster's palm. This ray can be up to 5 miles long.

sp-00207.description_en: As Lightning Bolt I, except range is 300'.

sp-00208.description_en: As Light I, except radius is 100' and the light also nullifies all magically created darkness. Any magical darkness inside the radius will return when this spell expires.

sp-00209.description_en: As Dark I, except radius is 100' and no nonmagical light can exist inside. Any light inside the radius will return when this spell expires.

sp-00210.description_en: As Beacon V, except beacon can be up to 10 miles long.

sp-00211.description_en: As Lightning Bolt I, except range is 500'.

sp-00212.description_en: As Lightning Bolt III, except caster can make the bolt turn once up to 90˚ before striking the target (the caster must know the target's location). The OB for the bolt is halved after making the turn.

sp-00213.description_en: As Corner Lightning Bolt, except bolt can make as many turns as necessary and go through openings (must be larger than 6" radius) to strike the target.

sp-00214.description_en: Caster can use one lower level spell (on this list) each round.

sp-00215.description_en: Condenses 1 cubic foot of water from the surrounding air. Water gradually condenses into caster's hands and may be funneled into any suitable recepticle.

sp-00216.description_en: Creates dense fog within up to 10'R per level of the caster. See Section 7.1.19.

sp-00217.description_en: Creates a wall of water up to 10' x 10' x 1'. This wall reduces all movement through it by 80%. In addition, all attacks through the wall suffer a -80 penalty.

sp-00218.description_en: A bolt of water is shot from the caster's palm. Resolve attack onthe Water Bolt Attack Table.

sp-00219.description_en: Disperses any fog in the area of effect. If all of a fog is not dispersed (i.e., the fog covers a greater area than the area of effect for this spell), the fog will refill the area of effect at a rate of 10'R every 1-5 minutes.

sp-00220.description_en: Water within radius is calmed. Waves are cut by 20' in center and less towards the perimeter.

sp-00221.description_en: As Waterwall, except for the duration.

sp-00222.description_en: As Water Bolt I, except range is 300'.

sp-00223.description_en: If there are clouds in the sky, it rains (outdoors) for the duration of the spell.

sp-00224.description_en: As Water Bolt I, except range is 500'.

sp-00225.description_en: Three bolts of water are shot from the palm of the caster. They can strike up to three different targets (as long as they are all withing 60˚ of each other; and they are visible to the caster). Caster may apply his directed spell skill (Waterbolt) to only one of the attacks (the others get a +0 OB).

sp-00226.description_en: The area of effect for this spell is the water immediately surrounding the boat that the caster is on. For as long as the caster concentrates, the speed of the boat can be increased by 50' per round (approximately 3 miles per hour).

sp-00227.description_en: As Calm Water, except waves are cut by 50' in center and caster need not concentrate.

sp-00228.description_en: Creates a 50' whirlpool that will draw in any unpowered object within 500' (takes 2 minutes of concentration to start). Powered objects may make manuever rolls to resist the pull of the whirlpool.

sp-00229.description_en: Caster can part water up to 100' deep and 100' per level long and 10' wide at bottom (50' at top).

sp-00230.description_en: Summons forces of nature in a fierce sea storm (must be created over a large body of water). This storm will include waves of 20-50', heavy rain, and winds of 25-60 mph. The storm can be delayed up to 1 hour per level. After the storm is summoned, it will dissipate normally.

sp-00231.description_en: Caster can use one lower level spell (on this list) each round.

sp-00232.description_en: Causes a light breeze (up to 20' per round) as long as the caster concentrates. Any gasses in the area are moved by the breeze.

sp-00233.description_en: Creates a wall of dense churning air up to 10' x 10' x 3'. This wall reduces all movement through it by 50%. In addition, all attacks through the wall suffer a -50 penalty.

sp-00234.description_en: By concentrating, the caster can remove most of the oxygen from the area of effect. After three rounds of concentration, all targets in the area of effect must make an RR each round in the area of effect or fall asleep (1 round per 10 failure). All fire spells in the area suffers a -20 penalty (or are 20% less effective in the case of non-attack spells).

sp-00235.description_en: Creates a 5'R cloud of charged gas particles. This cloud delivers a 'C' Electricity critical to all within the area of effect on the first and second rounds; a 'B' on the third and fourth rounds; and an 'A' on the fifth and sixth rounds (after 6 rounds, the cloud dissipates). This cloud drifts with the wind. The cloud takes one round to form (so anyone in the radius when it is cast may make a maneuver to move out of the radius without taking a critical). It will then stayed formed for six rounds.

sp-00236.description_en: Stops all generalized air movement (e.g., wind) up to winds of 30 mph; cuts stronger winds by 30 mph in the area of effect.

sp-00238.description_en: I — Creates a 5'R near vacuum. Anyone inside the radius must make a successful RR or take a 'B' Impact critical, as air leaves and rushes back in.

sp-00239.description_en: As Air Stop I, except radius is 20'.

sp-00240.description_en: As Slumber Mist, except for the duration, and it drifts with the wind.

sp-00241.description_en: As Stun Cloud V, except radius is 20'.

sp-00242.description_en: As Stun Cloud I, except delivers an 'E' on rounds 1 and 2, a 'D' on rounds 3 and 4, a 'C' on rounds 5 and 6, a 'B' on rounds 7 and 8, and an 'A' on rounds 9 and 10.

sp-00243.description_en: As Vacuum I, except radius is 10'.

sp-00244.description_en: As Air Stop I, except radius is 100'.

sp-00245.description_en: A 10'R whirlwind is created. This whirlwind delivers an 'A' Impact critical to all inside (every round). All movement through or within the whirlwind is reduced by 80%. The caster can move the whirlwind 1' per round.

sp-00246.description_en: As Death Cloud I, except radius is 10'.

sp-00247.description_en: As Vacuum I, except radius is 20'.

sp-00248.description_en: As Vacuum I, except delivers a 'D' Impact critical.

sp-00249.description_en: As Stun Cloud IV, except by concentrating the caster can move it 10' per round up to 100' away.

sp-00250.description_en: Allows the caster to change the direction of the wind within the radius.

sp-00251.description_en: Caster must outstretch arms and then a hard wind comes forth from them, fanning out till it has a 25'R at 300'. All within the cone receive a 'B' Impact critical.

sp-00252.description_en: Summons forces of nature in a fierce thunderstorm. This storm will include heavy rain, 25-60 mph winds, lightning (random), and a blizzard (if correct climate). The storm can be delayed for up to 1 hour per level of the caster.

sp-00253.description_en: Caster can use one lower level spell (on this list) each round.

sp-01109.description_en: Target and objects on his person appear to be a shadow; and thus are almost invisible in dark areas (e.g., in many situations this could be handled with a Stalking/Hiding bonus between 25 and 75).

sp-01110.description_en: Up to three objects (e.g., 1 garment, 1 naked body, and 1 weapon) are made invisible. The object(s) will remain invisible until 24 hours pass, or the object is strucke by a violent blow (being hit by a weapon, falling, etc), or the object makes a violent move (i.e., an attack).

sp-01111.description_en: Target inanimate object take on the visual appearance of a similar object. For example, a small red key may appear as a small blue spoon. The object cannot vary in dimensions by more than 100% of actual size in any given dimension. This is strictly a visual illusion (and can be detected as such).

sp-01112.description_en: This spell allows the caster to find any inanimate object. The caster must be able to uniquely describe the object.

sp-01113.description_en: Creates an area of darkness up to 2'R/lvl about the point touched. The darkness is equal to the darkest night. If the point is on a mobile object or being, it will move with the object/ being. See Section 7.1.7.

sp-01114.description_en: Target inanimate object takes on the visual and tactile appearance of another object. For example, a crystal goblet might look and feel like a wooden mug. The object cannot vary in dimensions by more than 100% of actual size in any given dimension. This is an illusion (and can be detected as such).

sp-01115.description_en: As Unseen III, except affects up to five objects.

sp-01116.description_en: Target appears to be offset from where he actually is. All attacks have no effect 10% of the time. Each time a foe misses him, the chance of that foe missing again goes down by 5%.

sp-01117.description_en: As Conceal I, except affects up to three objects.

sp-01118.description_en: As Unseen III, except affects up to ten objects.

sp-01119.description_en: As Displacement I, except chance of missing is 20%.

sp-01120.description_en: As Secret I, except affects up to three objects.

sp-01121.description_en: As Unseen III, except affects up to fifteen objects.

sp-01122.description_en: As Conceal I, except affects up to five objects.

sp-01123.description_en: As Unseen III, except affects up to twenty objects.

sp-01124.description_en: As Secret I, except affects up to five objects.

sp-01125.description_en: As Displacement I, except chance of missing is 30%.

sp-01126.description_en: As Conceal I, except affects up to ten objects.

sp-01127.description_en: As Unseen III, except affects up to one object for every level of the caster.

sp-01128.description_en: As Secret I, except affects up to ten objects.

sp-01129.description_en: As Conceal I, except affects a number of objects equal to the caster's level.

sp-01151.description_en: Causes target(s) to fall into a natural sleep. This spell can affect a number of targets whose levels total up to 3. The caster must be able to see all targets. At the time of casting, the caster should designate target priority (i.e., affect target A; if levels are left, affect target B; etc.). The first 2 rounds of sleep is magical (the target cannot be awakened through normal means).

sp-01152.description_en: Target animal(s) will believe the caster is a good friend.

sp-01153.description_en: Target humanoid believes the caster is a good friend.

sp-01154.description_en: As Sleep III, except affects a total of 5 levels.

sp-01155.description_en: Target will follow a single suggested act that is not completely alien to him (e.g., no suicide suggestions, no blinding himself suggestions, etc.).

sp-01156.description_en: Caster can read the surface thoughts of the target.

sp-01157.description_en: As Sleep III, except affects a total of 7 levels.

sp-01158.description_en: Target humanoid is held to 25% activity.

sp-01159.description_en: As Charm Kind, except will affect one target for every five levels (or fraction thereof) of the caster.

sp-01160.description_en: As Sleep III, except affects a total of 10 levels.

sp-01161.description_en: As Suggestion, except will affect one target for every five levels (or fraction thereof) of the caster.

sp-01162.description_en: Target humanoid must obey caster. However, he will not perform any act that is completely alien to him (e.g., no suicide orders, no blinding orders, etc.).

sp-01164.description_en: As Hold Kind, except will affect one target for every five levels (or fraction thereof) of the caster.

sp-01165.description_en: As Telepathy I, except for range.

sp-01166.description_en: As Sleep III, except affects a total of 15 levels.

sp-01168.description_en: Target is given one task. Failure results in a penalty determined by the GM (task must be within the capabilities of the target). If the target ignores the quest, he will suffer the same effects as for failure.

sp-01169.description_en: As Sleep III, except affects a total of 20 levels.

sp-01170.description_en: As Sleep III, except affects a total number of levels equal to the caster's level.

sp-01171.description_en: As Telepathy I, except for range.

sp-01172.description_en: As Quest, except failure is punished by the target suffering five 'E' criticals (choose which critical types randomly).

sp-01194.description_en: This spell analyzes one “machine,” giving the caster an idea of its purpose and operating procedures. This gives the caster a +20 when operating this particular machine. Anyone to whom he describes the analysis to can get a +10 when operating the machine.

sp-01195.description_en: When this spell is cast upon a machine, the machine's efficiency will return to its original level. For example, if cast upon a rusty lock, the lock will return to its original non-rusty operational level.

sp-01196.description_en: This spell has a 50% chance of jamming the target mechanism (e.g., trap, lock, machine, etc.). If the target mechanism is jammed, there is only a 5% chance that the target mechanism operates normally when used/triggered normally (check separately each time the mechanism is used). For example, if this spell is cast upon a pressure plate in the floor (that will drop a portcullis when someone steps upon it), there is a 5% chance the mechanism will trigger each time someone walks over it.

sp-01197.description_en: This spell has a 30% chance of opening any nonmagical lock. If the lock is not unlocked, there is a 10% chance that any traps associated with it are set off. Rolls are open-ended and the sophistication of the lock may modify the roll. See Section 7.1.29.

sp-01198.description_en: As Unlock I, except its chances concern disarming traps.

sp-01199.description_en: As Unlock I, except this spell has a 30% chance of operating any non-magical machine in its normal capacity for the duration of the spell. After the duration, the machine will operate normally. For example, if this spell were used to turn a wheel, the wheel would spin for the duration of the spell, then slowly spin to a stop.

sp-01200.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster will be aware when any active magic is in the area of effect. The caster will not know what the magic is or where it is; only that it is in the area of effect. For example, a Dabbler with this spell active can move down a passageway. The moment he gets near magical symbols on a door, he will be warned of active magic in the area (and perhaps the spell casters in the party can set out to find the source).

sp-01201.description_en: As Jam I, except has a 70% chance of jamming the trap (and only a 4% chance of setting it off).

sp-01202.description_en: As Unlock I, except has a 50% chance of opening the lock (and only an 8% chance of setting off associated traps).

sp-01204.description_en: As Operate I, except has a 50% chance of operating the machine.

sp-01205.description_en: As Jam I, except has a 90% chance of jamming the trap (and only a 3% chance of setting it off).

sp-01206.description_en: As Unlock I, except has a 70% chance of opening the lock (and only a 6% chance of setting off associated traps).

sp-01207.description_en: As Untrap I, except has a 70% chance of disarming the trap (and a 6% chance of setting off the trap).

sp-01208.description_en: As Operate I, except has a 70% chance of operating the machine.

sp-01210.description_en: As Unlock I, except has a 90% chance of opening the lock (and only (and a 4% chance of setting off the trap).

sp-01211.description_en: As Untrap I, except has a 70% chance of disarming the trap (and a 4% chance of setting it off).

sp-01213.description_en: As Jam III, except affects all traps in the area of affect.

sp-01214.description_en: As Unlock III, except affects all locks in the area of effect.

sp-01216.description_en: As Operate III, except affects all machines in the area of effects.

sp-01130.description_en: Allows caster to move at two time normal walking pace (i.e. Run pace). He only expends exhaustion points as if he were walking. Once he stops or performs some other action, the spell is canceled.

sp-01131.description_en: The caster may jump (from any pace) up to 10' plus 5' per level of the caster horizontally, or 5' plus 2' per level of the caster vertically. This spell will allow the caster to always land safely from jumps of this distance or less.

sp-01132.description_en: Allows the caster to land safely in a fall up to 20' per level of the caster; and the caster can take that distance off the severity of any longer fall.

sp-01133.description_en: Allows the caster to cloak all of his movements in complete silence, so long as he moves no faster than a walking pace.

sp-01134.description_en: The caster may move underwater as if he were on land.

sp-01135.description_en: With this spell, the caster gets a +50 bonus to any movement manuevers performed at a walking pace.

sp-01136.description_en: The caster can move (at half walking pace) along any solid surface angled up to 90˚; so long as he keeps at least a 3-point contact with the surface (e.g., both feet and one hand).

sp-01137.description_en: Caster can safely dive through the air up to 50' per level if water deep enough is present (at least 2' of water per 50' dived).

sp-01138.description_en: Caster can move at a walking pace

sp-01139.description_en: As Spider's Step, except caster can move along any surface (including ceilings).

sp-01140.description_en: This spell allows the caster to float upon the air. While floating, the caster is at the mercy of the pervailing winds and cannot control any aspect of his flight without access to some other motive force (i.e., pulling along a rope or wall, being towed, etc.).

sp-01141.description_en: As Spider's Step, except caster may move at a normal walking pace and he needs only to maintain a 2-point contact with the wall.

sp-01142.description_en: As Balance I, except caster may move at two times normal walking pace (i.e., Run pace).

sp-01143.description_en: Caster will safely fall from any distance 99% of the time and will land without making a sound.

sp-01144.description_en: As Spider's Walk, except caster can move at two times normal walking pace (i.e., Run pace).

sp-01145.description_en: Caster can glide like a bird. The product of caster's altitude and horizontal speed cannot exceed 100' per round. For example, a caster can glide along at a rate of 5' per round if he were 20' off the ground; or he could glide at the rate of 50' per round is he were 2' off of the ground. Note that the product must equal 100' (i.e., the caster cannot choose to have a total less than or more than 100').

sp-01147.description_en: As Spiders Walk, except caster can move along any surface (including ceilings).

sp-01148.description_en: Allows the caster to walk on calm air; movement must be at a constant height (the caster may move vertically, but must do so under his own power—the spell provides no vertical movement capability).

sp-01149.description_en: True — As Balance I, except caster can move at any pace.

sp-01150.description_en: Caster may use any lower level spell from this list once per round.

sp-01173.description_en: Caster gains double normal hearing. This results in +50 to Perception involving only hearing, +25 to Perception involving hearing and other senses.

sp-01174.description_en: Caster can see 100' on a normal night as if it were daylight. See Section 7.1.19.

sp-01175.description_en: Caster gains an extremely acute sense of smell. This results in +50 to Perception involving only smell, +25 to Perception involving smell and other senses.

sp-01176.description_en: One location is “marked” so that the caster can find it again later with a Far Sense spell. The marker is automatically located when the caster casts a Far Sense spell if the marker is within range of the Far Sense spell. A marker can be placed on any inanimate object. The caster can only have as many markers as he has levels.

sp-01177.description_en: Caster may designate one of his senses to be used at any “marked” location within range (see Sensory Marker). The caster can use any perception skill he has at the time (e.g., if he is currently under the effects of Nightvision, he will have Nightvision at the marked location). The remote sensory point may be rotated to face any direction. While he is sensing at the marked location, he must remain immobile and concentrate.

sp-01178.description_en: Caster has a 300˚ field of vision. The flank bonus for attacks against the caster is lowered to +5 and the rear bonus is lowered to +15.

sp-01179.description_en: Caster gains extreme tactile sensitivity. This results in a +25 to all actions that depend on the tactile sense (e.g., pick locks, disarm traps, etc.).

sp-01180.description_en: Caster can see 100' in any water (including murky water) as if it were daylight.

sp-01181.description_en: As Nightvision, except any darkness can be seen through. Also, no light is needed for this spell to work.

sp-01182.description_en: As Far Sense I, except caster may designate up to two senses at the marked location.

sp-01183.description_en: Caster can see through wood (up to 1"/lvl).

sp-01184.description_en: Caster can see in any brightness of light (including that which would be blinding or glaring). This spell does not work in the absence of light.

sp-01185.description_en: As Far Sense I, except caster can move (though he must continue to concentrate).

sp-01186.description_en: As Far Sense I, except for range.

sp-01187.description_en: As Woodsight, except that caster can see through stone.

sp-01188.description_en: As Far Sense II, except caster can move (though he must continue to concentrate).

sp-01189.description_en: As Woodsight, except that caster can see through iron (or steel).

sp-01190.description_en: As Far Sense II, except for range.

sp-01191.description_en: As all Vision spells on this list operating at the same time.

sp-01192.description_en: Caster has the effects of Sly Ears, Scent, Touch, and all Vision spells simultaneously.

sp-01193.description_en: Caster may use any lower level spell on this list once per round.

sp-01217.description_en: The caster gets a feeling for how much the target of this spell believes he is worth (i.e., his net worth). Note that this could be drastically different than how much money the target has (as wealth could include land, livestock, etc.).

sp-01218.description_en: The caster knows approximately how much “wealth” the target has upon his person.

sp-01219.description_en: The caster magically “marks” a target for use with the Locate Target spell. The caster can only have one target marked at a time.

sp-01220.description_en: Locates the nearest person (within the area of effect; direction and distance) who wants a specific object. The caster must be touching the object at the time this spell is cast.

sp-01221.description_en: The caster knows the exact location (direction and distance) of a “marked” target.

sp-01222.description_en: Caster can assess the value of jewels and metals within 10% of actual value. This spell allows him to calculate different values for all the cultures he is familiar with. Note that this spell evaluates the materials only (not the craftsmanship or the magical properties).

sp-01223.description_en: As Jewel/ Metal Assessment, except this spell will take into account the craftsmanship of the item. Magical properties are not evaluated.

sp-01225.description_en: Detects magical power in an item (but not the realm or how much power is in the item).

sp-01226.description_en: Caster has a 10% chance of determining the enchanted abilities of an object (roll separately for each ability). Once this spell has been cast on an item, it may not be cast on the same item again until the caster has gained a level of experience. See Section 7.1.4.

sp-01227.description_en: The caster knows the location of the owner of a specified object (the caster must be touching the object at the time that this spell is cast). The owner must be within the area of effect. For the purposes of this spell, the owner of an object is defined as someone who has “legal” ownership of the object. The GM must determine what constitutes legal ownership in his world (e.g., the creator, the purchaser of the created item, possessor, etc.).

sp-01228.description_en: Locates the nearest person (within the area of effect; direction and distance) who wants a specific object, is willing to acquire it at this time, and is willing to acquire it in a non-violent fashion. The caster must be touching the object at the time this spell is cast.

sp-01229.description_en: As Item Assessment, except that any item can be assessed (e.g., livestock, houses, boats, etc.).

sp-01230.description_en: Determines if the item examined has any cultural or historical significance (but not exactly what the significance is).

sp-01231.description_en: As Find Owner I, except for area of effect.

sp-01232.description_en: Locates the nearest person (within the area of effect; direction and distance) who wants a specific object, is willing to acquire it at this time (in a non-violent fashion), and is willing to pay the best price. The caster must be touching the object at the time this spell is cast.

sp-01233.description_en: Gives the area of origin of the item, the race of the being who created it, and when it was made (within 100 years).

sp-01234.description_en: As Find Owner I, except for area of effect.

sp-01235.description_en: Caster gets a visual image of the owner of an item.

sp-01236.description_en: Gives a vision of a significant event in the item's past.

sp-01237.description_en: As Origins, except it gives the exact place of origin, the being who made it, and when it was made.

sp-01238.description_en: As Find Owner I, except for area of effect.

sp-01239.description_en: Adds +50 to any rolls for any maneuvers performed at a walking pace (e.g., walking a 3" beam).

sp-01240.description_en: Allows the caster to slightly alter his muscles, limbs, and torso. This facilitates escaping from bonds and small places. Gives a +25 to +50 bonus to maneuvers utilizing Contortion skill.

sp-01241.description_en: Adds +20 to any one maneuver. No other action can be performed the round this maneuver is resolved.

sp-01242.description_en: I — Caster is able to sustain an additional 25% of his total concussion hits before passing out, hits are still taken and remain when the spell lapses.

sp-01243.description_en: Allows caster to alter form of his face to resemble someone else.

sp-01244.description_en: Caster can breathe water but not air for the duration of this spell.

sp-01245.description_en: As Concentration I, except bonus is 30.

sp-01246.description_en: In melee, the caster does double normal concussion hits and his Strength stat bonus is doubled.

sp-01247.description_en: As Unpain I, except 50% additional hits may be sustained.

sp-01248.description_en: As Face Shifting, except the form of the body can be altered slightly to the general shape and size of the desired humanoid race (must be within 25% of the caster's normal mass).

sp-01249.description_en: As Concentration I, except bonus is 40.

sp-01250.description_en: As Strength II, except caster delivers triple concussion damage and his Strength stat bonus is tripled.

sp-01251.description_en: Awakens the caster from any unnatural sleep (e.g., Sleep spell, sleeping drug, etc.). Caster takes one round to awaken.

sp-01252.description_en: Caster can breathe any gas as if it were normal air.

sp-01253.description_en: As Unpain I, except 75% additional hits may be sustained.

sp-01254.description_en: As Concentration I, except bonus is 50.

sp-01255.description_en: This spell halves the normal amount of time needed for rest. For example, after a normal day, instead of needed only 8 hours of sleep, the caster will need only 4. This spell will remain in effect for the duration of the sleep.

sp-01256.description_en: As Unpain I, except 100% additional hits may be sustained.

sp-01257.description_en: During a normal sleep, the caster may make Perception rolls (that are not based upon sight), at no penalty.

sp-01258.description_en: Upon receiving a death blow, the caster goes into a state of suspended animation, until he is cured or his brain is destroyed.

sp-01259.description_en: As Monk's Sleep and Meditative Sleep operating at the same time.

sp-01260.description_en: As Strength II, except caster delivers four times normal concussion damage and his strength stat bonus is quadrupled.

sp-01261.description_en: As Unpain I, except caster ignores all pain. Thus, he ignores all penalties (i.e., negative modifiers to actions) due to wounds and his hit total is double his normal hits plus his constitution (on a 1-100 scale). When he exceeds this limit he does not pass out, he dies from system shock.

sp-01262.description_en: Reduces caster's bleeding by 1, as long as the caster concentrates or is immobile. For example, this will take a wound that is bleeding at a rate of 4 hits per round down to 3 hits per round. If the caster is suffering from multiple bleeding wounds, this only affects one of them.

sp-01263.description_en: As Flow Stoppage I, except after 1 hour the stoppage is permanent. If caster is unconscious, this spell will operate without concentration.

sp-01264.description_en: Caster is relieved of 1 round's worth of accumulated stun.

sp-01265.description_en: Heals 1 hit per minute for as long as the caster concentrates. If caster is unconscious, this spell will operate without concentration.

sp-01266.description_en: As Clotting I, except the permanent stoppage occurs immediately.

sp-01267.description_en: Concentrating with this spell for 2 hours per day for 1-10 days (depending on the severity) will repair a broken bone (not a shattered or destroyed bone).

sp-01269.description_en: As Clotting I, except bleeding wounds can be reduced by 3.

sp-01270.description_en: As Stun Relief I, except 3 rounds are relieved.

sp-01271.description_en: Delays the effect of a poison as long as the caster concentrates.

sp-01272.description_en: As Pain Relief I, except heals 2 hits per minute.

sp-01273.description_en: As Fracture Repair, except repairs a vein or artery.

sp-01274.description_en: As Cut Repair I, except bleeding wounds can be reduced by 3.

sp-01275.description_en: As Fracture Repair, except repair only takes 2 hours of concentration for 1 day.

sp-01277.description_en: Repairs minor damage to one nerve. Requires a 1 day recovery period. Minor damage is defined as any nerve damage that results in penalties up to -20.

sp-01278.description_en: Concentrating with this spell for 2 hours per day for 1-10 days (depending on the severity) will repair any external damage to his ear (including ear loss) or eye (including corneal scratch, removal of foreign objects, etc.).

sp-01279.description_en: Allows caster to reattach a severed limb; limb is fully fuctional after 1-10 days (caster must concentrate with this spell for 2 hours each day).

sp-01280.description_en: Has a 50% chance of neutralizing a disease (modified by the potency of the disease) if the caster is unconscious or concentrates for 1 hour. In any case, it delays the poison for as long as the caster can concentrate.

sp-01281.description_en: Has a 50% chance of neutralizing a poison (modified by potency of the poison) if the caster is unconscious or concentrates for 1 hour. In any case, it delays the poison for as long as the caster can concentrate.

sp-01282.description_en: As Clotting I, except stops all bleeding and is permanent after 1 minute of concentration for each hit stopped.

sp-01284.description_en: While in a trance (from the Self Keeping spell on the Body Reins list), the caster can use the lower level healing spells on this list to repair himself.

sp-01285.description_en: Allows caster to leap up to 10' vertically or laterally, grasp and swing from a fixed object, and land perfectly (up to 20' away from the object). The object could be a tree, branch, rafter, rope, chandelier, etc.

sp-01286.description_en: Caster may act at twice his normal rate (i.e., 200% activity per round), but immediately afterwards, he must spend a number of rounds equal to the rounds speeded at half rate (i.e., only 50% activity per round).

sp-01287.description_en: Allows caster to “dodge” one nonspell attack (missile or melee) that occurs during the same round that this spell is cast. The caster must be able to see the attack (i.e., they cannot be from the rear or invisible) and he must have room to dodge the attack; this results in the attack receiving a -50 modification.

sp-01288.description_en: As Swing I, except three Swing I's may be executed in rapid succession.

sp-01289.description_en: Allows caster to “flip” in any direction, landing up to 10' away (facing in any direction).

sp-01290.description_en: As Speed I, except no half rate rounds are required.

sp-01291.description_en: As Speed I, except duration is 3 rounds.

sp-01292.description_en: As Dodging I, except 3 attacks can be dodged.

sp-01293.description_en: As Swing I, except five Swing I's may be executed in rapid succession.

sp-01294.description_en: As Speed I, except duration is 5 rounds.

sp-01295.description_en: As Flip I, except three Flip I's may be executed in rapid succession.

sp-01296.description_en: As Haste I, except duration is 3 rounds.

sp-01297.description_en: As Dodging I, except 4 attacks can be dodged.

sp-01298.description_en: As Speed I, except duration is 7 rounds.

sp-01299.description_en: As Haste I, except duration is 4 rounds.

sp-01300.description_en: As Flip I, except total distance travelled is 1' per level.

sp-01301.description_en: As Dodging I, except 5 attacks can be dodged.

sp-01302.description_en: As Speed I, except duration is 10 rounds.

sp-01303.description_en: As Haste I, except duration is 5 rounds.

sp-01304.description_en: As Dodging I, except all attacks can be dodged.

sp-01305.description_en: As Haste I, except duration is 10 rounds.

sp-01306.description_en: Caster can use any one of the lower level non- Speed/Haste spells (on this list) each round.

sp-01307.description_en: Caster gets a +5 bonus to all Martial Arts attacks.

sp-01308.description_en: Caster gets a +20 bonus for all Adrenal Moves.

sp-01310.description_en: Caster can strike an inanimate object and deliver damage to it (taking no damage himself). Caster makes a normal Martial Arts Strikes attack against the object. In addition, there is a chance that the object that is struck will break if it has any flaws (e.g., cracks, fractures, etc.) in it. The chance is equal to 10% plus 1% per degree of severity of the critical delivered in the attack (i.e., 'A' critical = 5%, 'B' critical = 10%, etc.). This chance is modified by +10% to +50% depending on the severity of the flaws.

sp-01311.description_en: As Adrenal Focus II, except bonus is +30.

sp-01312.description_en: As Body Weaponry I, except bonus is +10.

sp-01314.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster's skin is treated as AT 3 (this is only effective if the caster is wearing no armor at all).

sp-01315.description_en: The caster may ignore the effects of the first critical strike made against him. At the end of this spell's duration, all effects apply normally. Only one wound can be ignored in this fashion at a time (i.e., the caster cannot have more than one Lion's Heart spell active at any given time).

sp-01316.description_en: As Adrenal Focus II, except bonus is +40.

sp-01317.description_en: As Shattering Blow I, except the chance of breaking the object is 25% plus 3% per degree of severity of the critical.

sp-01318.description_en: As Body Weaponry I, except bonus is +15.

sp-01320.description_en: As Adrenal Focus II, except bonus is +50.

sp-01321.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster's skin is treated as AT 4 (this is only effective if the caster is wearing no armor at all).

sp-01322.description_en: As Shattering Blow I, except the chance of breaking the object is 40% plus 6% per degree of severity of the critical.

sp-01324.description_en: As Body Weaponry I, except bonus is +20.

sp-01325.description_en: As Adrenal Focus II, except bonus is +75.

sp-01326.description_en: As Body Weaponry I, except bonus is +30.

sp-01327.description_en: As Shattering Blow I, except the chance of breaking the object is 50% plus 10% per degree of severity of the critical.

sp-01328.description_en: Caster may use any one of the lower level spells on this list, once per round.

sp-01329.description_en: Allows caster to leap 50' laterally or 20' vertically in the round that the spell is cast.

sp-01330.description_en: Allows the caster to land safely in a fall of up to 20' per level, and to take that distance off the severity of any longer fall.

sp-01331.description_en: Caster can run on even, unstable surfaces (sand, ice, etc.) as he would on a hard, stable surface.

sp-01397.description_en: Caster can run on even, narrow (at least 2" wide) surfaces as if he were on normal ground.

sp-01333.description_en: As Leaping I, except the caster can execute 3 “leaps” in succession. Each leap must be within 90˚ of the last leap's direction.

sp-01334.description_en: Allows caster to execute a turn up to 180˚ with no deceleration or unbalance (this spell can be used with any Running spells).

sp-01335.description_en: Allows caster to move up and down vertically at a rate of 10' per rond. Horizontal movement is possible only through normal means.

sp-01336.description_en: As Landing, except caster can land safely from any fall 99% of the time.

sp-01398.description_en: Caster can walk on solid surfaces up to 90˚ as if he were on normal ground.

sp-01338.description_en: As Leaping I, except limit is 10' per level laterally and 5' per level vertically.

sp-01339.description_en: As Cornering I, except caster may execute 3 such turns in one round.

sp-01340.description_en: If the caster has a wall within 10', he can leap up to the wall, bounce off and land up to 25' from the wall (facing any direction—no orientation roll required).

sp-01399.description_en: As Wallwalking, except caster may run.

sp-01342.description_en: Caster teleports to a point up to 100' away. There can be no intervening “barriers” in a direct line between the caster and the point. A “barrier” is defined as anything the caster could not physically go through (e.g., a closed door is a barrier, a pit is not).

sp-01400.description_en: Caster can run on air if there is a wind blowing. However, he cannot run into the wind; and when running in any other direction, the wind's speed will modify his movement rate (i.e., like the effect of wind on a sail boat).

sp-01401.description_en: Caster may run on any fluid surface as if on level ground.

sp-01345.description_en: As Leaving I, except range is 300'.

sp-01402.description_en: As Breezerunning, except may run against the wind, and his movement rate is unaffected by the wind speed.

sp-01403.description_en: Caster can walk on any solid surfaces as if he were on normal ground (includes ceilings).

sp-01404.description_en: As Ceilingwalking, except caster may run.

sp-01349.description_en: Caster can use any one of the lower level “running” spells (on this list) each round.

sp-01350.description_en: Caster can use any one of the lower level spells (on this list) each round.

sp-01351.description_en: Caster gains double normal hearing. This results in +50 to Perception involving only hearing, +25 to Perception involving hearing and other senses.

sp-01352.description_en: Caster can see 100' on a normal night as if it were daylight. See Section 7.1.19.

sp-01353.description_en: Caster has a 300˚ field of vision. The flank bonus for attacks against the caster is lowered to +5 and the rear bonus are lowered to +15.

sp-01354.description_en: Caster gains an extremely acute sense of smell. This results in +50 to Perception involving only smell, +25 to Perception involving smell and other senses.

sp-01355.description_en: Caster can see 100' in any water (including murky water) as if it were daylight.

sp-01356.description_en: Caster can see 100' in any precipitation (including thick fog) as if it were daylight.

sp-01357.description_en: Caster gains extreme tactile sensitivity. This results in a +25 to all actions that depend on the tactile sense (e.g., pick locks, disarm traps, etc.).

sp-01358.description_en: As Nightvision, except any darkness can be seen through. Also, no light is needed for this spell to work.

sp-01359.description_en: Detects any invisible object in the area of effect. Caster can concentrate on a different 5'R each round.

sp-01360.description_en: Caster can check one object or place (up to 5'R) and tell if is an illusion or has an illusion on it.

sp-01361.description_en: As Scent, except caster can detect extremely faint scents (e.g., up to 48 hours old, after rain storms, through snow, etc.).

sp-01362.description_en: One illusion within the area of effect ceases to exist for the caster only.

sp-01364.description_en: Caster can see through wood (up to 1" per level).

sp-01365.description_en: Caster can see all invisible things anywhere that he can normally see. In addition, he suffers no penalties against invisible targets (as they are not invisible to him).

sp-01366.description_en: As any of the lower level Vision spells on this list but without a range limit (i.e., they will allow the caster to see anywhere he could normally see).

sp-01367.description_en: Caster cannot see any visual illusions. This does not affect any of the other senses.

sp-01368.description_en: As Woodsight, except stone can be seen through.

sp-01369.description_en: As all lower level Vision spells functioning at the same time.

sp-01370.description_en: As Woodsight, except iron (or steel) can be seen through.

sp-01371.description_en: As Woodsight, except any metal can be seen through.

sp-01372.description_en: Caster can use any one of the lower level spells (on this list) each round.

sp-00984.description_en: Forces a Type I, II, or III Demon who is present (or contacted) to analyze one item. The chance of a Demon successfully analyzing each property of the item is based upon the type of Demon. Type I and Type II Demons have a 0% chance. Type III Demons have a 10% chance. Type IV Demons have a 30% chance. Type V Demons have a 60% chance. Type VI Demons have a 90% chance. In addition to normal failure, this spell fails if a 1-100 roll is less than or equal to the Demon's Type (e.g., against a Type III Demon this spell fails on a 01-03). See Section 7.1.31 for the results of this spell failing.

sp-00985.description_en: Caster contacts a Demon (contact takes two rounds to establish). Roll d100 for type of Demon contacted. If the result is 01 to 60, a Type I Demon is contacted; if the result is 61 to 90, a Type II Demon is contacted; if the result is greater than 90, a Type III Demon is contacted. If the Demon is not “Forced” (i.e., by Force Analysis #, Force Information #, or Force Search #), the Demon will leave and the caster suffers the effects outlined in Section 7.1.31.

sp-00986.description_en: As Force Analysis III, except the Demon can be forced to answer one yes or no question, whose answer exists in someone's unshielded mind. The chance of successfully answering the question is the same as that presented in Force Analysis III, but the special spell failure chance is 3 times the Demon's Type.

sp-00987.description_en: As Force Analysis III, except the Demon can be forced to conduct a search for a specific person, place, or thing. The Demon searches, but not on our plane of existence. Upon finding the person, place, or thing, the Demon will report upon it's location. The chance of successfully find the object is the same as presented in Force Analysis III, but the spell failure chance is 5 times the Demon's Type.

sp-00988.description_en: As Lesser Demonic Contact, except roll d100 to determine the type of Demon contacted. If the result is 01 to 60, a Type III Demon is contacted; if the result is 61 to 85, a Type IV Demon is contacted; if the result is 86 to 95, a Type V Demon is contacted; if the result is greater than 95, a Type VI Demon is contacted.

sp-00989.description_en: As Force Analysis III, except Types I through IV can be forced.

sp-00990.description_en: As Force Information III, except Types I through IV can be forced.

sp-00991.description_en: As Force Search III, except Types I through IV can be forced.

sp-00992.description_en: As Force Analysis III, except Types I through V can be forced.

sp-00993.description_en: As Demonic Information Link, except will act as a Greater Demonic Contact and then a Force Analysis IV.

sp-00994.description_en: Creates a permanent link to the world of Demons. The target of the spell must be a large object or a location. Upon activation, the target object or place will act as a Greater Demonic Contact and then a Force Information IV. The target object or place can only be activated once per day. For example, this spell could be cast upon a large mirror. Someone could use the mirror once per day to attempt to find out the answer to a question (i.e., “Mirror, Mirror, on the wall….”).

sp-00995.description_en: As Force Information III, except Types I through V can be forced.

sp-00996.description_en: As Demonic Information Link, except acts as Greater Demonic Contact, then Force Search IV.

sp-00997.description_en: As Force Search III, except Types I through V can be forced.

sp-00998.description_en: As Force Analysis III, except Types I through VI can be forced.

sp-00999.description_en: As Force Information III, except Types I through VI can be forced.

sp-01000.description_en: The caster can attune himself to a small animal to serve as his familiar. The caster must obtain the animal through normal means (can be no more than 10% of the caster's own mass) and cast this spell on the animal once per day for one week (concentrating for 2 hours each day). The caster can then control the familiar and view the world through its senses by concentrating on it (though the familiar must be within 50' per level). If the animal is killed, the caster will have a -25 modification to all actions for 2 weeks.

sp-01001.description_en: Caster can instantly summon a first level creature that he can control. If the creature can understand the caster's communication (e.g., Animal Tongues), the creature can be controlled by normal communication. Otherwise, control is maintained through concentration of the caster. The general type of creature can be specified by the caster, but exactly what creature is summoned should be determined by the GM (select from creatures commonly found in the area where the spell is cast). If the creature was summoned to be used for a task that is not dangerous to the creature, the duration for this spell is 10 minutes per level of the caster. However, if the creature is ever put into a dangerous situation, the duration drops to 1 round per level of the caster.

sp-01002.description_en: This spell is cast upon the caster's familiar. However, the familiar must be a type of animal that is usually associated with “evil” (e.g., a reptile, a bat, a raven, etc.). This spell transfers part of the caster's “life” into the familiar. This spell must be cast upon the familiar every day for a month (concentrating for 2 hours a day). The familiar retains all of its old abilities and it gains special abilities. The familiar will become a malformed version of the animal it once was (more grotesque). The caster can view the world through the senses of the creature at a range of 250' per level. The creature's AT changes to 4, and it gains a +10 to its DB and OB. The caster can cast spells through the familiar as if the caster were exactly where the familiar is (this includes casting “self” spells on the famliar—the range for this ability is 50' per level). The creature will make all of its RRs at half the caster's level (or its own level,

sp-01003.description_en: As Summons I, except caster can also choose one of the following options: a) the level of the summoned creature is increased by one, b) an extra first level is summoned, or c) the duration can be doubled.

sp-01004.description_en: Caster can bind one creature (animal intelligence, up to second level). The bound creature must follow the commands of the caster (the caster does not have to concentrate). The caster can only have as many creatures bound as he has levels. If the creature is ever outside the range of the spell, the spell is dispelled.

sp-01005.description_en: As Summons II, except it has 2 options.

sp-01006.description_en: The target of this spell is any creature (animal intelligence, up to second level) that has been bound (with a Binding spell). The caster can give a simple, straightforward task for the creature to attempt to complete. The creature will do its best to complete the task (within the duration of the spell). When the duration of this spell expires, the creature returns to its “unbound” status.

sp-01007.description_en: As Summons II, except it has four options.

sp-01008.description_en: As Binding II, except binds up to a 5th lvl creature.

sp-01009.description_en: As Summons II, except it has six options.

sp-01010.description_en: The target of this spell is a familiar that has had Investiture I successfully cast upon it. This spell puts more of the caster into his familiar. The caster must cast this spell once per day for six months (for 2 hours each day). The caster can use the famliar's sense up to 1,000 feet per level away; can cast spells through the familiar up to 200' per level away; the creature's AT improves to 11; its gets a DB bonus of +20 (to the original DB); it gets an OB bonus of +30 (to the OB); gains a poisonous attack that is used in conjunction with its normal attack (bite, sting, etc.); makes RRs at three quarters the caster's level or its own level (whichever is higher); its appearance continues to become more grotesque (assuming the nature of the caster—it may not be recognized as the animal-type that it once was). If the familiar dies, the caster loses half his Power Points and Hits for 1-5 weeks.

sp-01011.description_en: As Summons II, except it has nine options.

sp-01012.description_en: As Binding II, except binds up to a 10th level creature.

sp-01013.description_en: As Summons II, except it has eleven options.

sp-01014.description_en: As Order Bound II, except affects up to a 10th lvl creature.

sp-01015.description_en: As Summons II, except it has fourteen options.

sp-01017.description_en: As Summons II, except it has sixteen options.

sp-01018.description_en: As Investiture II, except familiar becomes even more part of the caster. Investiture II must already have been completed, then the caster must cast this spell once per day for one year (for 2 hours each day). Caster can use the familiar's senses up to 1 mile per level away; can cast spells through the familiar up to 1,000' per level away; the creature's AT improves to 12; it gets a DB bonus of +30 (to the original DB); it gets an OB bonus of +50 (to the original OB); gains a minor breath weapon attack (in addition to its normal attacks); makes its RRs at the caster's level (or its own, whichever is higher); its form becomes completely grotesque and could not be associated with the animal it once was. However, if the familiar dies, the caster loses three quarters of his Power Points and Hits for 1-5 weeks.

sp-01019.description_en: As Summons II, except has nineteen options.

sp-01020.description_en: As Binding II, except binds any creature.

sp-01021.description_en: As Order Bound II, except affects any level creature.

sp-01022.description_en: Caster can use any lower level spell on this list, once per round.

sp-01023.description_en: Creates an area of up to 20'R about the point touched. The darkness is equal to the darkest night. If the point is on a mobile target, it will move with the target. See Section 7.1.7.

sp-01024.description_en: Target can see 100' in normal darkness as if it were day.

sp-01025.description_en: I — Caster can vary the intensity of darkness in the area, but he cannot lighten it past its natural state.

sp-01026.description_en: As Darkness II, except radius is 100'.

sp-01027.description_en: As Nightvision, except caster can see in all darkness (even magical).

sp-01028.description_en: As Dark Control II, except range and radius are 50'.

sp-01029.description_en: Caster can create either the visual illusion of shadowy figures, or real shadows (as many as the caster's level); they will move when he concentrates. See Section 7.1.27 for more on illusions.

sp-01030.description_en: As Darkness II, except radius is 300'.

sp-01031.description_en: Creates a 20'R area of darkness. No nonmagic light can exist and magic light (except Utterlight) must make a RR or be cancelled.

sp-01032.description_en: As Dark Control II, except range and radius are100'.

sp-01033.description_en: As Dark Vision, except the target can see as far as he would be allowed in daylight.

sp-01034.description_en: As Lesser Utterdark, except radius is 100'.

sp-01035.description_en: As Darkness II, except radius is 500'.

sp-01036.description_en: Creates a “cloud” of darkness that has a 100'R and drifts with the wind. The darkness can vary in intensity from an overcast day to the dark of night.

sp-01037.description_en: As Nightvision, except affects a number of targets equal to caster's level.

sp-01038.description_en: As Lesser Utterdark, except area of effect is 200'.

sp-01039.description_en: As Darkvision, except affects a number of targets equal to caster's level.

sp-01040.description_en: As Clouds of Darkness I, except for area of effect.

sp-01041.description_en: As Darkness II, except radius is 1,000'.

sp-01042.description_en: As Lesser Utterdark, except radius is 300'.

sp-01043.description_en: As Darkness II, except radius is 100' per level of the caster.

sp-01044.description_en: As Clouds of Darkness I, except radius is 1 mile per level of the caster.

sp-01045.description_en: Caster summons an Elemental Servant (a Type I Entity) that gradually appears over the course of two rounds. If it is not “controlled” or “Mastered” (usually by one of the spells on this list); it will attack random targets until it fades away after 2-20 rounds.

sp-01047.description_en: As Summon Elemental I, except the caster summons a Weak Elemental (a Type II entity).

sp-01048.description_en: Caster summons a Demon who gradually appears over the course of 2 rounds. Roll d100 (not open-ended) for Type. A result of 01-60 is aType I; a result of 61-90 is a Type II; a result of 91-100 is a Type III. If the Demon is not “Controlled” or “Mastered” (i.e., usually by one of the spells on this list) before the Demon materializes, the caster suffers an effect as outlined in Section 7.1.31.

sp-01049.description_en: As Control Entity I, except the caster need not concentrate to control the Entity. The chance of failure is 5 times the Entity's Type. The Entity will remain and obey the caster until the caster is killed or the Entity is outside the range limit or the caster releases him. A maximum of two Entities can be mastered at one time by one being. Obtaining information may only be accomplished by using spells off the Evil Magician's Base list, Dark Contacts.

sp-01050.description_en: As Control Entity I, except Types I and II can be controlled.

sp-01051.description_en: As Summon Elemental I, except caster summons a Guardian Elemental (a Type III Entity).

sp-01052.description_en: As Entity Mastery I, except Types I and II can be mastered.

sp-01053.description_en: As Control Entity I, except Types I-III can be controlled.

sp-01054.description_en: As Summon Elemental I, except caster summons a Strong Elemental (a Type IV Entity).

sp-01055.description_en: As Lesser Demonic Gate, except Types III-VI can be summoned: (01-60) Type III, (61-85) Type IV, (86-95) Type V, (96-100) Type VI.

sp-01056.description_en: As Entity Mastery I, except Types I-III can be mastered.

sp-01057.description_en: As Control Entity I, except Types I-IV can be controlled.

sp-01058.description_en: As Entity Mastery I, except Types IIV can be mastered.

sp-01059.description_en: The target of this spell is any Mastered Elemental. The Elemental can be given a simple, straightforward task that it will attempt to complete (within the duration of the spell). When this spell expires, the Elemental returns to its plane.

sp-01061.description_en: As Order Elemental, except will work on any Mastered Entity.

sp-01062.description_en: As Contain Elemental, except will work on any Mastered Entity.

sp-01063.description_en: As Control Entity I, except Types I-V can be controlled.

sp-01064.description_en: As Entity Mastery I, except Types I-V can be mastered.

sp-01065.description_en: As Control Entity I, except Types I-VI can be controlled.

sp-01066.description_en: As Entity Mastery I, except Types I-VI can be mastered.

sp-01067.description_en: Turns 100 cubic feet of ice into water vapor.

sp-01068.description_en: Turns 10 cubic feet of earth into fine dust.

sp-01069.description_en: Any previous cracks or flaws within a section of any normal material 1,000 cubic feet (10'x10'x10') will extend to their limit. See Section 7.1.7.

sp-01070.description_en: Turns 10 cubic feet of stone into fine powder.

sp-01071.description_en: As Un-Ice I, except affects up to 1,000 cubic feet.

sp-01072.description_en: Turns 1 cubic foot of any inorganic material to fine powder (must be one object).

sp-01073.description_en: As Earth to Dust I, except affects up to 100 cubic feet.

sp-01074.description_en: Can shatter an inorganic object, up to 1 cubic foot in volume; all within 5' take an 'A' Impact critical, holder takes a 'C' Impact critical. Metal objects get a +30 RR modification.

sp-01075.description_en: As Powder Stone I, except affects up to 100 cubic feet.

sp-01076.description_en: As Un-Ice I, except affects up to 100 cubic feet per level of the caster.

sp-01077.description_en: As Disruption I, except affects up to 10 cubic feet.

sp-01078.description_en: As Earth to Dust I, except affects up to 1,000 cubic feet.

sp-01079.description_en: Causes cracks to appear in up to 100 cubic feet of non-metal, inorganic material.

sp-01080.description_en: As Powder Stone I, except affects 1,000 cubic feet.

sp-01081.description_en: Completely disintegrates 1 cubic feet of inorganic material.

sp-01082.description_en: As any single spell (10th level or lower) from this list, except with a range of 300'

sp-01083.description_en: As Disintegration I, except affects 10 cubic feet.

sp-01084.description_en: As Earth to Dust I, except affects up to 100 cubic feet per level of the caster

sp-01085.description_en: As Powder Stone I, except affects up to 100 cubic feet per level of the caster

sp-01086.description_en: As Disruption I, except up to as many objects (up to 1 cubic foot each) as the caster's level can be affected, and range is 100'.

sp-01087.description_en: As Disintegration I, except affects objects up to 100 cubic feet and range is 300'.

sp-01088.description_en: Target feels pain, and he takes 20% of his remaining hits.

sp-01089.description_en: Target has one of his physical stats (characteristics) temporarily lowered by d10. Only the temporary stat is lowered. Physical stats include Strength, Agility, Quickness, Constitution, Presence, and Self Discipline (one is selected at random). When the duration expires, the stat will go back up by the same amount that it went down (with a maximum of whatever the potential for the stat is).

sp-01090.description_en: As Pain, except the ache seems natural and reduces target's hits by 10% until cured (caster must specify nature of ache). The target is unaware that the spell has been cast on him, because it affects him gradually (target loses 1 hit per minute). The GM should describe the ache as a natural thing (and may choose not inform the player that the character has reduced hits).

sp-01091.description_en: As Pain, except target takes 40% of his remaining hits.

sp-01092.description_en: As Impair I, except affects temporary and potential stats.

sp-01093.description_en: As Impair I, except decrease is 3d10.

sp-01095.description_en: As Pain, except target takes 60% of his remaining hits.

sp-01096.description_en: As Trait Erosion I, except decrease is 2d10.

sp-01097.description_en: As Impair I, except decrease is 5d10.

sp-01098.description_en: As Ache, except target's hits are reduced by 40%.

sp-01099.description_en: As Pain, except as many targets as the caster's level can be affected.

sp-01100.description_en: As Pain, except target takes 90% of his remaining hits.

sp-01101.description_en: As Trait Erosion I, except decrease is 3d10.

sp-01102.description_en: As Impair I, except affects a number of targets equal to the caster's level.

sp-01103.description_en: As Fire Nerves, except affects a number of targets equal to the caster's level.

sp-01104.description_en: As Trait Erosion I, except affects a number of targets equal to the caster's level.

sp-01105.description_en: As Impair I, except decrease is 10d10.

sp-01106.description_en: As Agony, except as many targets as the caster's level can be affected.

sp-01107.description_en: As Trait Erosion I, except decrease is 5d10.

sp-01108.description_en: As Trait Erosion I, except one physical stat is reduced to 1.

sp-08681.description_en: I — As Rune Paper I, except paper will hold up to a second level spell.

sp-08686.description_en: As Make Wand, except a “rod” can be made.

sp-08689.description_en: As Rune Paper I, except paper will hold up to a tenth level spell.

sp-08690.description_en: As Make Wand, except a “staff” can be made.

sp-08691.description_en: III — As Rune Paper I, except paper will hold up to a thirteenth level spell.

sp-08695.description_en: As Work Organic, except any organic material can be worked (e.g., this might be required to work the skins of dragons or other “enchanted” creatures).

sp-08696.description_en: As Rune Paper I, except paper will hold up to a twentieth level spell.

sp-08698.description_en: As Rune Paper I, except paper will hold any level spell.

sp-05913.description_en: [RR Mod = -50] Target makes an RR. Failure results in one being ,chosen by the caster, becoming invisible to the target; others see the protected being normally. If the protected being makes an obvious action (e.g., talking, moving an object, etc.), the target may attempt another RR (the GM may deem it appropriate to apply modifiers to this RR based upon the action the protected being takes). If the protected being attacks the target, he may make another RR with a +50 modifier.

sp-05914.description_en: [RR Mod = -50] Target makes an RR. Failure results in one being, chosen by the caster, becoming inaudible to the target; others hear the protected being normally. If the protected being causes a sound arising from 1' beyond his body, the target may attempt another RR (the GM may deem it appropriate to apply modifiers to this RR based upon the action the protected being takes). If the protected being attacks the target (e.g., casting a spell with a verbal component), he may make another RR with a +50 modifier.

sp-05915.description_en: [RR Mod = -50] Target makes an RR. Failure results in one being, chosen by the caster, becoming invisible and inaudible to the target, as per Cloak Sight and Cloak Hearing.

sp-05916.description_en: [RR Mod = -50] Target makes an RR. Failure results in the target becoming unable to feel, taste, or smell one being, chosen by the caster; others sense the protected being normally. If the protected being attacks the target (e.g., by physically striking the target with a fist), he may make another RR with a +50 modifier. Note that if the target is attacked by the protected being, he will not know it (as he cannot feel the attack); he will still suffer the damage, but won't know why (though he will get another RR).

sp-05917.description_en: As Minor Cloak I and Cloak Feel/Taste/ Smell, except the target cannot see, hear, smell, taste or feel the being chosen by the caster.

sp-05918.description_en: As Minor Cloak I, except affects three targets. The caster makes one BAR that applies to all of the targets.

sp-05919.description_en: [RR Mod = -50] Target makes an RR. Failure results in the target becoming unable to detect the mental pattern of one being chosen by the caster through magical means (or special sense); others may perceive the protected being normally.

sp-05920.description_en: [RR Mod = -50] Target makes an RR. Failure results in the target becoming unable to detect one being, chosen by the caster, using unusual senses; others perceive the protected being normally. Examples of unusual senses might include sonar, magnetic senses, the life detection ability of undead etc.

sp-05921.description_en: As Lesser Cloak I, except affects 3 targets. The caster makes one BAR that applies to all of the targets.

sp-05922.description_en: As Lesser Cloak I, except the target cannot perceive the being, chosen by the caster, using any senses possessed by the target.

sp-05923.description_en: As Minor Cloak I, except affects 5 targets.

sp-05924.description_en: As Minor Cloak I, except affects all targets within a chosen 10'R. The caster makes one BAR which is applied to all of the targets.

sp-05925.description_en: As Lesser Cloak I, except affects 5 targets.

sp-05926.description_en: As Greater Cloak I, except affects three targets. The caster makes one BAR which is applied to all the targets.

sp-05927.description_en: As either Sphere of Cloaking I except affects all targets within a chosen 30'R or as Lesser Cloak I, except affects all targets within a chosen 10'R. In either case, the caster makes one BAR which is applied to all of the targets.

sp-05928.description_en: As Minor Cloak I, except affects 10 targets.

sp-05929.description_en: As Lesser Cloak I, except affects 10 targets.

sp-05930.description_en: As Greater Cloak I, except affects 5 targets.

sp-05931.description_en: As either Sphere of Cloaking I, except affects all targets within a chosen 50'R or as Lesser Cloak I, except affects all targets within a chosen 30'R, or as Greater Cloak I, except affects all targets within a chosen 10'R. In any case, the caster makes one BAR which is applied to all of the targets.

sp-05932.description_en: As Minor Cloak I, except affects one target per level of the caster and the range is only limited to the caster's field of vision.

sp-05933.description_en: As Lesser Cloak I, except affects one target per level of the caster and the range is only limited to the caster's field of vision.

sp-05934.description_en: As Greater Cloak I, except affects ten targets.

sp-05935.description_en: As Greater Cloak I, except affects one target per level of the caster and the range is only limited to the caster's field of vision.

sp-05936.description_en: The caster can create a visual (static or dynamic) image which is perceived in the mind of one target for the duration of this spell. The caster can set up to one conditional action per level of the caster in the Seeming spell (this action requires no concentration by the caster). This action can be triggered on a given action by the target. The caster can concentrate and exercise dynamic control over what is perceived in the target's mind (thought the target must still be within range of the caster for this to work).

sp-05937.description_en: As Light Seeming, except the caster can create a set of sounds.

sp-05938.description_en: Caster can determine if the target is being affected by an Overlay or Seeming spell.

sp-05939.description_en: As Light Seeming, except the caster can create a set of smells.

sp-05940.description_en: This spell will allow the next Overlay or Seeming spell from either this list or Seeming Law to be able to affect animal targets (though the spell must be cast within one minute of completing this spell).

sp-05941.description_en: As Light Seeming, except the caster can create a set of tastes.

sp-05942.description_en: The caster can attempt to stop an Overlay or Seeming from effecting a given being (note that the Overlay or Seeming must already be “detected” with a Detect Seeming spell). The Overlay or Seeming spell is allowed a RR (at the level of its caster or the spell level if the former is unknown); if the RR is successful, it continues to affect the being. If the RR is failed, the spell will no longer effect this being, other targets will continue to be effected.

sp-05943.description_en: As Light Seeming, except the caster can create a set of tactile sensations.

sp-05944.description_en: The caster can analyze a detected Overlay or Seeming spell to determine the nature of the spell in terms of the hallucination it is generating within the mind of the affected being. The analyzed spell is allowed a RR (at the level of its caster or the spell level if the former is unknown); if the RR is successful, no information is gained.

sp-05945.description_en: This spell will allow the caster to create up to two simultaneous streams of perceptual input when concentrating on the next Overlay or Seeming spell from either this list or Seeming Law. When providing two streams, the activity for concentrating on the enhanced spell is raised to 75%. Note that the Overlay or Seeming spell must be cast within one minute of completing this spell.

sp-05946.description_en: As Light Seeming, except the caster can create a mental pattern which can be detected by and interact with appropriate spells or special senses.

sp-05947.description_en: This spell will allow the caster to extend the range over which he can dynamically concentrate upon the next Overlay or Seeming spell.
