Such a spell will have a range of 100' per level of the caster. Note that the next Overlay or Seeming spell must be cast within one minute of completing this spell.

sp-05948.description_en: As Animal Seeming, except it will enable the enhanced Overlay or Seeming spell to effect sentient plants.

sp-05949.description_en: As Light Seeming, except the caster can create a set of sensations appropriate to a given esoteric sense. Examples of unusual senses would include sonar, magnetic senses, the life detection ability of undead etc.

sp-05950.description_en: As Animal Seeming, except it will enable the enhanced Overlay or Seeming spell to affect Elementals, Constructs, Golems, Spirits, Undead, and other supernatural beings with at least minimal intelligence.

sp-05951.description_en: As Far Seeming I, except the range for concentration is increased to 1,000 feet per level of the caster.

sp-05952.description_en: As Dual Seeming, except the caster can supply up to three simultaneous distinct streams of perceptual input and the necessary level of concentration (for three streams) is increased to 90% activity.

sp-05953.description_en: As Far Seeming I, except the range for concentration is increased to one mile per level of the caster.

sp-05954.description_en: As Dual Seeming, except the caster can supply up to four simultaneous distinct streams of perceptual input and the necessary level of concentration (for four streams) is increased to 100% activity.

sp-05955.description_en: As Far Seeming I, except the range for concentration is ten miles per level of the caster.

sp-05956.description_en: The caster can alter the visual appearance of an item, being, or place as perceived in the mind of one target for the duration of this spell. The other characteristics of the item, being, or place do not change. The nature of the item, place, or being does not change (e.g., a book will remain a book, a bridge will remain a bridge, etc.). The caster can set up to one conditional action per level of the caster in the Overlay spell (this action requires no concentration from the caster). The action is triggered on a given action by the target with the item, being, or place that has been overlaid. By concentrating, the caster can exercise dynamic control over what is perceived in the target's mind with regard to the affected item, being, or place (though the target must still be within range of the caster). The caster may choose one of the following options: a) an extra sense can be added to the Overlay (the corresponding Seeming spell from the Seeming Enhancement spell list must be known), b) an additional target may be affected, c) the duration can be doubled, d) the range can be doubled, or e) an additional item, being, or place may be altered.

sp-05957.description_en: The caster can create a visual (static or dynamic) image (e.g., of an item, being, or place) which is perceived in the mind of one target for the duration of this spell. The caster can set up to one conditional action per level of the caster in the Seeming spell (this action requires no concentration from the caster). This action is triggered on a given action by the target. By concentrating, the caster can exercise dynamic control over what is perceived in the target's mind (though the target must still be within range of the caster). The caster may choose one of the following options: a) an extra sense can be added to the Seeming (the corresponding Seeming spell from Seeming Enhancement spell list must be known), b) an additional target may be affected, c) the duration can be doubled, d) the range can be doubled, or e) an additional image (of an item, being or place) can be created.

sp-05958.description_en: As Overlay II, except the caster may choose two of the options.

sp-05959.description_en: As Seeming II, except any two of the options may be chosen.

sp-05960.description_en: As Overlay II, except it can be delayed up to 24 hours. At the time of casting, the caster must decide upon the trigger for the spell. The caster can choose one of the following as a trigger for the spell: a) time period, b) specified movement, c) specified sound, d) specified touch, e) specified smell, f) specified taste, or g) other specified sensation perceived by the target.

sp-05961.description_en: As Seeming II, except it can be delayed up to 24 hours. At the time of casting, the caster must decide upon the trigger for the spell. The caster can choose one of the following as a trigger for the spell: a) time period, b) specified movement, c) specified sound, d) specified touch, e) specified smell, f) specified taste, or g) other specified sensation perceived by the target.

sp-05962.description_en: As Overlay III, except four of the options may be chosen.

sp-05963.description_en: As Seeming II, except four of the options may be chosen.

sp-05964.description_en: As Waiting Overlay I, except the caster may choose two of the options.

sp-05965.description_en: As Waiting Seeming II, except two of the options can be chosen.

sp-05966.description_en: As Overlay III, except nine of the options may be chosen.

sp-05967.description_en: As Seeming II, except nine of the options may be chosen.

sp-05968.description_en: As Waiting Overlay III, except four of the options may be chosen.

sp-05969.description_en: As Waiting Seeming II, except four of the options can be chosen.

sp-05970.description_en: As Overlay III, except fourteen of the options may be chosen.

sp-05971.description_en: As Seeming II, except fourteen of the options may be chosen.

sp-05972.description_en: As Waiting Overlay III, except nine of the options may be chosen.

sp-05973.description_en: As Waiting Seeming II, except nine of the options can be chosen.

sp-05974.description_en: As Overlay III, except nineteen of the options may be chosen.

sp-05975.description_en: As Seeming II, except nineteen of the options may be chosen.

sp-05976.description_en: As Waiting Overlay III, except nineteen of the options may be chosen.

sp-05977.description_en: As Waiting Seeming II, except nineteen of the options can be chosen.

sp-05978.description_en: As either Overlay III or Seeming II except option per level of the caster may be chosen.

sp-05979.description_en: Detects if a target is under the influence of a charm or other mind control affect (generally speaking, that would include any spell with a sub-type of “m”). The mind control spell may resist detection by making an RR at the level of the caster of the charm spell (or the level of the charm spell).

sp-05980.description_en: The target of this spell will take no offensive action, and will fight only in selfdefence.

sp-05981.description_en: Target will follow a single suggested act that is not completely alien to him (e.g., no suicide suggestions, no blinding himself suggestions, etc.).

sp-05982.description_en: Causes the target to be affected by any one desired emotion chosen at time of casting. Possible emotions include hate, love, sadness, anger, fear, etc. The caster may choose the object of the induced emotion.

sp-05983.description_en: Caster can cause the target to doubt the truth of one belief or fact chosen by the caster for the duration of this spell. The target may regain his belief prematurely if he is presented with irrefutable evidence of the doubted belief's truth or persuaded of its veracity.

sp-05984.description_en: The target must obey the caster for the duration of this spell, as specified in Suggestion I.

sp-05985.description_en: Caster can cause the target to believe, with complete certainty, an idea, reasoning, or “fact” implanted by the caster for the duration of this spell. The target may lose this belief prematurely if he is presented with irrefutable evidence of the falsehood of the belief or persuaded of its falsehood.

sp-05986.description_en: As Calm I, except affects 3 targets.

sp-05987.description_en: As Suggestion I, except affects 3 targets and the range is 20'.

sp-05988.description_en: As Emotion I, except affects 3 targets.

sp-05989.description_en: As Obedience I, except affects 2 targets.

sp-05990.description_en: As Calm I, except affects 5 targets.

sp-05991.description_en: As Suggestion I, except affects 5 targets and the range is 30'.

sp-05992.description_en: As Emotion I, except affects 5 targets.

sp-05993.description_en: As Obedience I, except affects 3 targets and the range is 20'.

sp-05994.description_en: As Calm I, except affects 10 targets.

sp-05995.description_en: As Suggestion I, except affects 5 targets and the range is 50'.

sp-05996.description_en: As Emotion I, except affects 10 targets.

sp-05997.description_en: As Obedience I, except affects 5 targets and the range is 30'.

sp-05998.description_en: As Calm I, except affects 1 target per level of the caster.

sp-05999.description_en: As Suggestion I, except affects 1 target per level of the caster and the range is 100'.

sp-06000.description_en: As Emotion I, except affects 1 target per level of the caster.

sp-06001.description_en: As Obedience I, except affects 1 target per level of the caster and the range is 100'.

sp-06002.description_en: The caster causes the target to relive an experience chosen by the caster at time of casting. If the target is in a relaxed state of mind, the target will be in a reverie and oblivious to his surroundings unless disturbed (loud noise, physical prod, etc.). If the target is active, the target will remain active but be distracted by momentary flashbacks and the attempts of his mind to relate the experience to the current situation (-20 to all actions). This spell will also provide the target with a +25 bonus to recalling specific details of the remembered experience. This bonus is not cumulative with Force Recall or Recall spells.

sp-06003.description_en: The caster can select a topic and obtain one cue per level of the caster from the target. Each cue will relate to an experience of the target with respect to the topic. These cues are used as the triggers for the Relive and Share Experience spells.

sp-06004.description_en: Caster can assess the target's ability (in terms of skill ranks) with regard to one specific skill or spell list chosen at time of casting.

sp-06005.description_en: As Relive Experience, except that a second target shares the remembering of the experience of the principal target. The caster must choose which target is to be the principal target at time of casting.

sp-06006.description_en: Allows the caster to improve the target's memory for the duration of this spell. The caster may choose to limit the topics on which the improvement will be obtained. Any maneuver involving Memory receives a special bonus of +10. This is not cumulative with Force Recall II, Recall or Relive Experience spells.

sp-06007.description_en: Caster can temporarily tap the language skills of the target, enabling the caster to use one language at the level of fluency (spoken and written) of the target. The language must be chosen at time of casting. For the duration of this spell, the caster must use the target's skill at the given language, even if the target is less fluent than the caster in the chosen language.

sp-06008.description_en: As Share Experience II, except three targets relive the chosen experience.

sp-06009.description_en: As Tap Skill I, except the caster can tap one purely mental skill of the target (that would be any skill that uses either Memory or Reasoning as one of it's stat bonuses). For the duration, the caster replaces his skill rank bonus with that of the target, and recalculates the skill bonus for the skill.

sp-06010.description_en: As Share Experience II, except five targets relive the chosen experience.

sp-06011.description_en: Caster receives surface thoughts from target, learns the reasoning and the thought patterns behind the surface thoughts, and may additionally scan the target's conscious memories, at a rate of one scene every round. If the target makes his RR by more than 25, he realizes that someone is trying to read his thoughts. The caster can concentrate on a new target each round.

sp-06012.description_en: As Tap Skill I, except the caster can tap one physical (any skill that uses either Strength, Agility, or Constitution as one of it's stat bonuses, except OB related skills) or mental skill of the target (as defined in Tap Skill II). For the duration, the caster replaces his skill rank bonus with that of the target, and recalculates the skill bonus for the skill.

sp-06013.description_en: The caster can remove one thought or memory from the target's mind each round.

sp-06014.description_en: As Tap Skill I, except the caster can tap one combat skill (OB related skill) of the target. For the duration, the caster replaces his skill rank bonus with that of the target, and recalculates the skill bonus for the skill.

sp-06015.description_en: Caster can copy one thought or memory from the target into his own mind each round.

sp-06016.description_en: Caster may use one spell list (chosen at time of casting) of the target accessing the spell knowledge up to 5th level or the number of skill ranks possessed by the target (whichever is lower). For the duration of this spell, the caster's knowledge of the spell list is limited to the knowledge possessed by the target. The caster must use his own PPs and must always make a Spell Casting Static Maneuver, with all appropriate penalties taken into consideration. Any failed spells suffer a special modification of +50 to all spell failure results (i.e., add +50 to all spell failure rolls).

sp-06017.description_en: As Force Recall I, except any maneuver Memory receives a special bonus of +25.

sp-06018.description_en: As Share Experience II, except ten targets relive the chosen experience.

sp-06019.description_en: As Mind Scan, except caster can probe target's subconscious memories (i.e., all experiences).

sp-06020.description_en: As Copy Experience, except the caster can copy one thought or memory from his mind into the mind of the target.

sp-06021.description_en: As Tap Spell V, except the caster can access the spell knowledge up to 10th level or the number of skill ranks possessed by the target (whichever is lower).

sp-06022.description_en: erience—As Share Experience II, except one target per level of the caster relive the chosen experience. .

sp-06023.description_en: As Tap Spell V, except the caster can access the spell knowledge up to 20th level or the number of skill ranks possessed by the target (whichever is lower).

sp-06024.description_en: As Tap Spell V, except the caster can access the spell knowledge up to 50th level or the number of skill ranks possessed by the target (whichever is lower).

sp-06025.description_en: The target suffers a special penalty of -30 to all actions.

sp-06026.description_en: The target is rendered unable to speak for the duration of the spell.

sp-06027.description_en: The target will believe that he is afflicted with a wound of a type chosen by the caster (i.e., roll an 'A” severity critical on a chosen critical strike table). The target will perceive all the symptoms of the injury, but will not in reality suffer the effects. If as a result of the injury, the target falls “unconscious,” the target will pass out due to mental shock for one round per level of the caster. If as a result of the injury, the target would “die,” then the target will pass out from mental shock for one minute per level of the caster.

sp-06028.description_en: The target loses his sense of hearing for the duration of this spell.

sp-06029.description_en: A chosen limb of the target is numb and useless for the duration of this spell. If the limb is a leg, the target loses 40% of his movement. If the limb is an arm, the target suffers -40 to melee and missile fire using that arm.

sp-06030.description_en: As Wound A, except the apparent wound can be up to a 'B' severity critical.

sp-06031.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the target will believe that he is suffering from the effects of one non-life-threatening illness (chosen by the caster).

sp-06032.description_en: The target loses his sense of sight for the duration of this spell.

sp-06033.description_en: As Wound A, except the apparent wound can be up to a 'C' severity critical.

sp-06034.description_en: The target loses one sense (other than sight or hearing) chosen by the caster at time of casting.

sp-06036.description_en: As Wound A, except the apparent wound can be up to a 'D' severity critical.

sp-06037.description_en: As Minor Hypochondria, except the target believes himself to be suffering from a life threatening disease.

sp-06038.description_en: As Sensory Loss, except the target loses all senses (i.e., receives no sensory input whatsoever) for the duration of this spell.

sp-06039.description_en: As Wound A, except the apparent wound can be up to an 'E' severity critical.

sp-06040.description_en: As any one of the non-Wound spells on this list below 15th level, except the effect of the projection upon the target can be delayed up to 24 hours. At the time of casting, the caster must decide upon the trigger for the spell. The caster can choose one of the following as triggers for this spell: a) time period, b) specified movement, c) specified sound, d) specified touch, e) specified smell, or f) specified taste perceived by the target.

sp-06041.description_en: As any one of the non-Wound spells on this list below 15th level, except affects 5 targets. The caster makes one Base Attack Roll which is applied to all of the chosen targets.

sp-06042.description_en: As any one of the Wound spells on this list, except the effect of the Wound spell upon the target can be delayed up to 24 hours. At the time of casting, the caster must decide upon the trigger for the spell. The caster can choose one of the following as a trigger for this spell: a) time period, b) specified movement, c) specified sound, d) specified touch, e) specified smell, or f) specified taste perceived by the target.

sp-06043.description_en: As any of the Wound spells, except affects 5 targets. The caster makes one BAR which is applied to all of the chosen targets. Separate rolls are made to determine the nature of the apparent wound on each target.

sp-06044.description_en: As Projection V, except affects 10 targets.

sp-06045.description_en: As Wound V, except affects 10 targets.

sp-06046.description_en: As Projection V, except affects one target per level of the caster.

sp-06047.description_en: As Wound V, except affects one target per level of the caster.

sp-02504.description_en: The caster can attune himself to a normal spider to serve as his familiar. The caster must obtain the spider through normal means (can be no more than 10% of caster's own mass) and cast this spell on the creature once per day for l week (concentrating for 2 hours per day). The caster can then control the familiar and view the world through his senses by concentrating on it (though the familiar must be within 50' per level). If the creature is killed, the caster will have a -25 modification to all actions for 2 weeks. Any spell that affects "familiars" will affect this spider.

sp-02505.description_en: Allows caster to move along the webs of giant spiders easily. Webs will not stick to the caster and he will be able to move freely through a any "web" spell.

sp-02506.description_en: Caster creates a web rope (to climb, swing from, etc.) Each round, a 10' strand can be produced that will support 2000 lbs. One end can be "projected" away from the caster and will be sticky so that it will stick to whatever it hits (the rest of the strand will not be sticky). On subsequent rounds, the length of strand may be extended by 10' per round (each 10' extension decreases the weight the strand can hold by 100 pounds). Alternatively, the caster can create new strands each round. At the end of the duration, the web ropes become brittle and snap easily.

sp-02507.description_en: Web strands shoot out of the caster's hand at one target. If the target fails an RR, the amount of his body that is covered in the web is equal to the percent of failure. For example, if a target fails his RR by 25, 25% of his body is covered in the web. The portion of the body covered must be determined by the GM. If a limb or limbs are covered, they cannot be used. Breaking the web requires a Very Hard static maneuver (modified by the victim's Strength bonus).

sp-02508.description_en: The spell will cause any arachnid-type creature to believe the caster to be a good friend. This spell will also allow the caster to speak and understand the language of spiders.

sp-02509.description_en: Caster may move along (at half walking pace) any solid surface angled up to 90° so long as he maintains at least three of his four limbs in contact with the surface.

sp-02510.description_en: Caster will summon a lesser great spider that will obey his wishes when he concentrates. If such spiders are common to the area, then the spider will appear slowly over the course of 3 rounds. If such spiders are not common to the area, then the spider will appear slowly over the course of l 0 rounds.

sp-02511.description_en: As Minor Web Rope, except the caster can produce two l O' strands per round or one 20' strand per round.

sp-02514.description_en: As Charm Spider, except that the target spider will obey one "suggestion" per round.

sp-02515.description_en: Allows the caster to either has a poisonous touch or a poisonous bite. If the caster chooses a poisonous touch, the caster's finger tips will begin to secrete a poisonous venom. If this poison touches any bare skin (other than the caster's), it will deliver a Muscle Poison (level determined by rolling a d I 0). If the caster chooses a poisonous bite, the next bite attack that delivers a critical hit (even a Tiny critical) will be accompanied by a Circulatory Poison (level determined by rolling 2d10). The spell ceases to function once it has delivered one poison from an attack.

sp-02516.description_en: As Lesser Spider Summons, except that a greater great spider is summoned.

sp-02517.description_en: Caster can take the form (and have all of the abilities of) a lesser great spider.

sp-02518.description_en: As Major Web Rope, except the caster can produce a 30' strand each round.

sp-02519.description_en: As Major Web, except that up to one target for every two levels of the caster can be targetted or "webbed" togetheror half of that number can be webbed to non-mobile objects.

sp-02520.description_en: Completely encases target in webbing. Breaking the cocoon requires an Absurd maneuver (with a special modification of -20; modified by Strength bonus).

sp-02521.description_en: As Spider Climb, except that only one limb need be in contact with the surface and any angled surface, even ceilings, can be moved along at full movement rate.

sp-02522.description_en: As Lesser Spider Summons, except a major great spider is summoned.

sp-02523.description_en: Summons hundreds of normal-sized, spiders (a mixture of poisonous and non-poisonous based upon what is common to the area) that swarm over a I 0'R area. These. spiders will stay together as a unit for 3d 10 rounds (and can move into a new I 0'R area each round; the caster has no control with this spell). Anyone in the area of effect must make d l ORRs versus a Reduction Poison each round. The GM can determine the level of the poison, each round or he can use a level of d l 05. After 3dl0 rounds, the spiders will wander away.

sp-02524.description_en: As Lesser Spider Shapechange, except caster takes the form of a greater great spider.

sp-02525.description_en: As Spider Control, except all spiders in the radius can be controlled.

sp-02526.description_en: Caster can use one spell from this list each round. All spiders who see the caster will regard him as master and obey him.

sp-02527.description_en: Caster knows the origins, purity, and general worth of any one drug sample. Any impurity will be known. Alternatively, this spell provides a +25 to the skill Drug Lore.

sp-02528.description_en: Caster causes some base to rapidly ferment into an alcoholic beverage (beer, wine, etc). This spell can also be used to di still whiskey, brandy, etc. at one quarter a cubic foot per level of caster.

sp-02529.description_en: As Identify Drug, except poison is known. Alternatively, this spell provides a +25 to the skill Poison Lore.

sp-02530.description_en: Caster is aware of the presence of all drugs and poisons in the area of effect. Caster may concentrate on a different 1'Reach round. If the poison/drug was mixed with food by a Brew spell, the poison/drug may make a RR to resist detection.

sp-02531.description_en: Enables the caster to prepare one dose of a stimulant through a chemical process from natural ingredients. The drug will have an effective duration of one hour and act as if it were the level of the caster for RR purposes. A person affected by a stimulant is at + 10 for all actions for the duration of the drug.

sp-02533.description_en: As Soriel's Brew, except a person affected is relieved of queasiness and vertigo. Alternatively, Syleg's Relief may be brewed to cause nausea.

sp-02534.description_en: Allows caster to prepare, handle, and contain a known poison of up to 10th level potency.

sp-02536.description_en: s-As Soriel's Brew, except a person affected is -10 to all actions, but very happy. Additionally, a it will put the person into a sleep-like trance within 5 to 30 minutes of taking it. The Addiction Factors may be anywhere from I 0 to double the caster's level (caster's choice).

sp-02537.description_en: Caster may di still the essence of any healing herb into a portable potion that will keep indefinitely. The caster may also combine a healing herb with appropriate herbal catalysts (healing in nature) to create up to a 50% more powerful potion than the original healing herb.

sp-02538.description_en: As Soriel's Brew, except this medicine will reduce the effects of a parasitic infestation, killing parasites on contact. This medication's Addiction Factor may be anywhere from 10 to double the caster's level.

sp-02539.description_en: Allows caster to prepare, handle, and contain a known acid.

sp-02540.description_en: As Brew Minor Poison, except allows caster to work with any poison up to 20th level potency.

sp-02542.description_en: Caster may brew any lower level spell on this list in 75% the normal time by mixing it in the target cauldron. For the purposes of this spell, any pot-shaped container may be considered a cauldron.

sp-02543.description_en: As Soriel's Brew, except a person affected by an hallucinogenic is at -50 to all actions, but he is very happy and experiencing wild hallucinations. This medication's Addiction Factor may be anywhere from 15 to double the caster's level.

sp-02544.description_en: Caster may make one dose of a drug that acts as the antidote to one type of poison (determined at the time of brewing). I 9. Brew Truth Potion-As Soriel' s Brew, except drug lasts for I hour only. A person affected by this drug must tell the whole truth for the duration.

sp-02546.description_en: As Brew Healing Herbs, except any herb may be processed into a potion with up to a 50% increase in power.

sp-02547.description_en: As Magic Cauldron, except caster may brew any lower level spell on this list in half the normal time.

sp-02548.description_en: As Brew Minor Poison, except allows caster to work with any poison.

sp-02549.description_en: The caster produces the "elixir of life." This potion returns the person who drinks it to a youthful state. The target's age will drop to one-third its current age. Additionally, the elixir prolongs life so that ten passing years seems as only one to the person who drinks it. This potion may only be imbibed once by a person. Someone who takes a second drink will immediately and painfully die. Elves who drink this elixer experience no effect other than to suffer violent retching.

sp-02550.description_en: Caster receives a special +25 to all Fauna Lore rolls while concentrating.

sp-02551.description_en: Caster instantly summons any one catalyst in his possession to his hand for immediate use.

sp-02552.description_en: Caster permanently enchants one corpus catalyst. The enchanted catalyst gains+ I to its level for casting purposes. Any subsequent casting of an Enchant spell on the catalyst destroys the catalyst.

sp-02553.description_en: Caster freezes the passage of time for target inanimate organic (can not have more mass than the caster). This organic object will not deteriorate, decompose, or smell.

sp-02554.description_en: Caster enchants one corpus catalyst making it a minor focus. A minor focus will never deteriorate through age or wear regardless of its composition. A minor focus can be used to satisfy the spell category requirement of a spell in the spell category(s) to which it is attuned without being consumed in the process. A minor focus does not add its level to the level requirement of any spell. A minor focus may also add a special +5 to any ritual dealing with its spell category. In addition, a minor focus adds its level to any Spell Casting Static Maneuvers for spells in the spell category(s) to which it is attuned.

sp-02555.description_en: The target animal thrives as if it were maintained under the best possible conditions for the animal in respect to food, shelter, and exercise. The animal must be fed, but the food can be inappropriate or of poor quality with no negative effect on the target animal. The animal will continue to grow even under very harsh conditions. Target animal can not have more mass than the caster.

sp-02556.description_en: As Enchant Corpus I, except the catalyst gains +2 to its level for casting purposes.

sp-02557.description_en: Caster can instantly summon a first level animal from the surrounding area. The summoned animal is under the control of the caster for as long as the caster concentrates. The general type of creature can be specified by

sp-02558.description_en: Caster can split a single corpus into two equal parts. Each part is just as effective as the original corpus. If this spell is ever cast a second time on an already split corpus, it is destroyed. I 0. Create Lesser Focus-Caster enchants one minor focus making it a lesser focus. A lesser can be used to satisfy the spell category requirement of a spell in the spell category(s) to which it is attuned without being consumed in the process. A lesser focus may add one fourth of its normal level in PPs to any spell cast with it. A lesser focus may also add a special + I O to any ritual dealing with its spell category. In addition, a lesser focus adds its level to any Spell Casting Static Maneuvers for spells in the spell category(s) to which it is attuned.

sp-02561.description_en: As Enchant Corpus I, except the catalyst gains +3 to its level for casting purposes.

sp-02562.description_en: All animals within I O' will act friendly toward caster. This spell does not control the animals.

sp-02563.description_en: As Preserve Organic I, except the organic material can be up to four times the caster's mass.

sp-02564.description_en: Caster enchants one lesser focus making it a greater focus. A greater focus may use one third of its normal level in the casting of spells within its category. Additionally, a greater focus may add +15 to any associated ritual. In addition, a lesser focus adds its level to any Spell Casting Static Maneuvers for spells in the spell category(s) to which it is attuned.

sp-02565.description_en: As Animal Summons I, except caster can choose two of the following options: a) the level of the summoned creature is increased by one; b) an extra 1st level creature can be summoned; or c) the duration can be doubled.

sp-02566.description_en: As Divide Corpus II, except produces three usable corpi.

sp-02567.description_en: As Enchant Corpus /, except the catalyst gains +4 to its level for casting purposes.

sp-02568.description_en: AsAnimal Sleep lll, except up to 5 animals may be affected.

sp-02569.description_en: Caster enchants one greater focus making it a major focus. A major focus may use one half of its normal level in the casting of spells within its category. Additionally, a major focus may add +20 to any associated ritual. In addition, a lesser focus adds its level to any Spell Casting Static Maneuvers for spells in the spell category(s) to which it is attuned.

sp-02570.description_en: As Enchant Corpus I, except the catalyst gains +5 to its level for casting purposes.

sp-02571.description_en: When cast on any domesticated animal, that animal will return to its "wild" state. The animal will have no difficulty adapting to the harsh requirements of the wilderness (and have no desire to return to domestication).

sp-02572.description_en: Caster enchants one major focus making it a true focus. A true focus may use its normal level in the casting of spells within its category. Additionally, a true focus may add +30 to any associated ritual. In addition, a lesser focus adds its level to any Spell Casting Static Maneuvers for spells in the spell category(s) to which it is attuned.

sp-02573.description_en: Allows the caster to tap the power of a tiny crystal catalyst. Each time a spell is cast from such a catalyst, one charge is drained, and if all of the charges are everused, the crystal becomes "dead" and no further Tap or Charge spells will affect it.

sp-02574.description_en: Allows the caster to transfer some of his own power to a tiny crystal catalyst. The crystal must have been previously tapped by the caster. This spell will place dlO charges in the crystal, not to exceed its maximum total charges.

sp-02575.description_en: The caster is instantly aware of the number of charges in a crystal and the category of catalyst the stone falls into. This spell will also inform the caster if the crystal is "dead," and if it contains a Gem Seed.

sp-02576.description_en: Over the course of 1 hour, the caster summons forth a gem seed from a common crystal. The crystal must have a gem seed for this spell to work. This process does not harm the original crystal in any way, nor does it reduce the number of charges the crystal contains.

sp-02577.description_en: As Tap Tiny Crystal, except the caster may tap a small crystal catalyst.

sp-02578.description_en: As Charge Tiny Crystal, except the caster may charge a small crystal catalyst.

sp-02579.description_en: Caster can propagate a new common crystal from a gem seed. The new crystal will be identical to the original in every respect, except that it will not contain a gem seed of its own. The caster must touch the gem seed when the spell is cast, but then the seed is placed in a mineral solution (a liquid solution with a high mineral content-medium Alchemy roll required to create). This process takes 5dl0 days to complete.

sp-02581.description_en: As Tap Tiny Crystal, except the caster may tap a medium crystal catalyst.

sp-02582.description_en: As Charge Tiny Crystal, except the caster may charge a medium crystal catalyst.

sp-02583.description_en: Allows caster to create a crystal focus. The crystal focus must be at least medium sized. Once created, the crystal focus allows the caster to cast spells through it from the spell category to which it is attuned. Casting spells through a focus does not use any charges and the focus contributes no power points to the spell. A crystal focus also adds + I 0 to any ritual rolls dealing with its spell category. A crystal focus also adds its level to all Spell Casting Static Maneuvers in the spell category to which it is attuned.

sp-02584.description_en: As Grow Common Seed, except for duration and a semi-precious crystal will be created. This process takes lOdl0 days to complete.

sp-02585.description_en: As Tap Tiny Crystal, except the caster can tap a large crystal catalyst.

sp-02586.description_en: As Charge Tiny Crystal, except the caster may charge a large crystal catalyst.

sp-02587.description_en: As Common Gem Seed, except for the duration and a gem seed is extracted from a precious crystal.

sp-02590.description_en: As Grow Common Seed, except for duration and a precious crystal will be created. This process takes 20dl0 days to complete.

sp-02591.description_en: As Common Gem Seed, except for the duration and a gem seed is extracted from a rare crystal.

sp-02592.description_en: As Tap Tiny Crystal, except the caster can tap a huge crystal catalyst.

sp-02593.description_en: As Tap Tiny Crystal, except the caster can tap a huge crystal catalyst.

sp-02594.description_en: As Grow Common Seed, except for duration and a rare crystal will be created. This process takes 40d I O days to complete.

sp-02595.description_en: Caster returns a "dead" crystal to "life." He must hold the crystal and concentrate his will upon it for an entire day. At the end of this period, the caster will have no power points, and the crystal will have one charge.

sp-02618.description_en: Caster learns significant details of a book's past including the original author, the approximate age of the book, whether or not the book is keyed to a specific individual (but not who), and whether or not the book is sealed or warded.

sp-02619.description_en: Caster can detect whether or not a book has been copied. The caster detects the existence (but not location) of all copies made within 1 year per level of the caster. For the purposes of this spell, the caster would be aware if the target book itself was a copy if made within the time frame.

sp-02620.description_en: Caster may dictate to a blank page or book and his words will appear on the page in his own handwriting (must have appropriate writing knowledge for the language). The caster's words can be in any color and the caster can vary the appearance (font, size, underline, etc.) at will.

sp-02621.description_en: Target area (up to 1 square foot of surface area per level of caster) is completely cleaned of dirt, sweat, blood, grime, and accumulated filth. The filth all collects in a pile near the target area.

sp-02622.description_en: All zero level and first level creatures (of a type determined by the caster to be pests) must leave the area of effect. This spell only works on creatures with animal intelligence or less.

sp-02623.description_en: Allows the caster to locate all copies ofa book within the range of the spell. The caster must have previously cast Book Analysis on the book or on one of its copies.

sp-02624.description_en: Target repels dirt, mud, blood, and grime for the duration of this spell (i.e., such filth will not cling to the target).

sp-02625.description_en: Caster places a magical wax seal on the target book. When sealed, the caster determines a triggering event, sound, phrase, movement, etc. that will unseal the book. While sealed, the book may not be opened or used in any way. During this time, the book may not be damaged by the normal environment, it will not age, and the book will repel minor insects and vermin that might damage the book.

sp-02626.description_en: All zero level creatures (of animal intelligence or less) in the area of effect (including molds etc.) are instantly dead with no RR (unless magical in nature). Does not act as a Cure Disease spell.

sp-02627.description_en: Caster "keys" a target book to a specific person. Keyed books are +25 to resist all types of disenchant spells. Only the keyed person may read the target book. Anyone else attempting to read the book find the words to be nonsensical. If someone other than the caster of this spell or the keyed person attempts to cast Key Book on a previously keyed book, then the book resists the spell at +25.

sp-02628.description_en: Caster can place up to a third level spell into a book ward on any book (scroll, letter, etc.). Within one minute of casting the Book Ward spell, the spell to be emplaced must be cast ( within 10'). The ward may be visible or invisible as the; caster determines at the time of casting. When emplaced, the ward's trigger must be chosen, which may be a specified time period, specified movements, specified sounds, touch, reading, violent actions in the area, etc. If anything occurs to trigger the ward, the ward will fade as the emplaced spell is cast (at reader, area of effect, at book, as determined at time of emplacement). A ward can only be triggered once before it disappears. Only one ward may be active on any given book at a time.

sp-02629.description_en: As Locate Copy I, except range is 1 mile and if the copy is outside of this range, the caster receives a general impression of the direction of the nearest copy.

sp-02630.description_en: Target book is protected from normal wear and tear, withering, aging, etc.

sp-02631.description_en: As Lesser Seal, except the target book has a buffer of 35 HPs that must be overcome in a single attack before any damage is applied to the book.

sp-02632.description_en: As Book Ward Ill, except up to 5th level spells may be emplaced.

sp-02633.description_en: As Repel Small Vermin, except affects pests up to 3rd level.

sp-02634.description_en: As Locate Copy II, except range is 50 miles.

sp-02635.description_en: Completely rejuvenates any book, manuscript, tome, etc., of which the caster has a major portion. This spell repairs all damage done due to water damage, fire, vermin, etc. This book will not replace missing pages or portions of a book. For example, a book damaged in a fire could have partially burned pages restored to the extent that there remains a crisped page to repair. If any page was reduced to ash, then those pages could not be replaced.

sp-02636.description_en: Caster learns the basic spell parameters of any spell in effect or alternatively that a target is preparing to cast. This allows the caster to learn how Jong a spell has been in effect and how long it will remain in effect.

sp-02637.description_en: As Clean, except effects all targets in the area of effect.

sp-02638.description_en: As Book Ward Ill, except up to 10th level spells may be emplaced.

sp-02639.description_en: As Sterilize, except first level creatures may also be affected. First level creatures do get a RR.

sp-02640.description_en: Caster records his knowledge of any one spell list into a spell book. The caster must have a number of sheets of rune paper equal to the number required for the spell book (see Learning from Books). The process of creating the book takes I week. The book may be used as a +25 source book by other casters attempting to learn that list, or alternatively used like rune paper to cast individual spells from the recorded spell list. Anyone attempting to cast a recorded spell must spend 5 rounds preparing and reading the spell in the book; the spell may be cast with a Read Runes skill roll. Any spell cast from the book in this manner removes the spell from the book. Anyone researching the list from a book with gaps in it will have gaps in their knowledge of the list.

sp-02641.description_en: G ives caster a +20 to all Cooking maneuvers and + 10 to anyone to whom he describes the preparation. May also be used to chill or warm a food to the proper serving temperature.

sp-02643.description_en: This spell perfectly prepares one day's worth of food (1 ration) for one week. Also instantly freshens any slightly turned or spoiled food (e.g., wilted lettuce).

sp-02644.description_en: This spell removes most of the water from one day's worth of food, reducing the weight of the food by 80%-90%. The food will be edible only after water has been added to it (approximately 2 quarts per ration). As long as the food is dry, the food remains dehydrated and the normal spoilage rate is decreased by 10 times.

sp-02645.description_en: Caster condenses 1 cubic foot of water from the surrounding air.

sp-02646.description_en: T his spell neutralizes abnormal diseases, poisons, and other similar substances in one day's worth (1 ration) of food and/or water. It will not neutralize a poison or similar substance that is a natural part of the food. Special magical poisons/diseases might be allowed a RR (GM' s discretion). When the duration ends, any poisons or diseases return to normal potency. Any food consumed during the duration remains purified permanently.

sp-02647.description_en: Al lows caster to heat a cooking container to any desired temperature (up to 500'). This spell will also allow caster to cook food in the desired method (e.g. bake, fry, steam, braise, etc).

sp-02648.description_en: Caster creates a smell and taste illusion that alters the flavor of food within one container to any reasonable taste, by simulating the effects of spices or seasonings upon the food.

sp-02649.description_en: Allows caster to chill a container to any desired temperature (down to -40').

sp-02650.description_en: Creates a table, chairs, tablecloth and up to 12 place settings, candles, etc. Everything needed for a meal is provided except for food and drink. At the end of the duration, all created items vanish. If the created items are used in any manner other than for dining then they instantly vanish.

sp-02651.description_en: As Food Dehydration/, except 3 rations are prepared.

sp-02652.description_en: Automatically and successfully prepares one course of food, taking only half the normal preparation time. In addition to normal cooking, caster also detects any spoiled or poisoned food.

sp-02653.description_en: As Condensation/, except caster creates 3 cubic feet of water.

sp-02654.description_en: Allow s caster to digest grass, wood, woody stems, etc. and receive nourishment from such for one day.

sp-02655.description_en: Allows caster to age food or drink by up to 20 years. This can be used to improve the flavor of certain foods or it can be used to rot the target food.

sp-02656.description_en: Caster may detect any poison. The caster may concentrate on a different l 'R each round.

sp-02658.description_en: As Food Dehydration /, except preserves 5 rations.

sp-02659.description_en: As Condensation/, except produces 5 cubic feet of water.

sp-02660.description_en: As Cookery, except may prepare one course per level of the caster.

sp-02662.description_en: As Create Setting, except caster creates everything necessary for one meal. Provides food and drink (any type), all serving and dining implements, table, chairs, lighting, linen, etc. The banquet can serve up to 20 people with up to 10 courses.

sp-02663.description_en: Caster may use any lower level spell on this list each round for the duration of this spell.

sp-02665.description_en: Caster instantly summons any one catalyst in his possession to his hand for immediate use.

sp-02666.description_en: Caster permanently enchants one herbal catalyst. The enchanted catalyst gains+ 1 to its level for casting purposes. This spell has no effect on healing herbs. Any subsequent casting of an Enchant spell on the catalyst destroys the catalyst.

sp-02667.description_en: Caster freezes the passage of time for target plant (can not have more mass than the caster). This plant will neither grow, deteriorate, nor require any form of sustenance.

sp-02668.description_en: Caster enchants one herbal catalyst making it a minor focus. A minor focus will never deteriorate through age or wear regardless of its composition. A minor focus can be used to satisfy the spell category requirement of a spell in the spell category to which it is attuned without being consumed in the process. A minor focus does not add its level to the level requirement of any spell. A minor focus may also add a special +5 to any ritual dealing with its spell category. In addition, a minor focus adds its level to any Spell Casting Static Maneuvers for spells in the spell category(s) to which it is attuned.

sp-02670.description_en: As Enchant Herb I, except the catalyst gains +2 to its level for casting purposes.

sp-02671.description_en: Castercanlocateas pecificherb if it lies within the target area.

sp-02672.description_en: Caster can split a single dose of herb into two equal parts. Each part is just as effective as the original dose. If this spell is ever cast a second time on a split dosage, it is destroyed.

sp-02673.description_en: Caster enchants one minor focus making it a lesser focus. A lesser can be used to satisfy the spell category requirement of a spell in the spell category to which it is attuned without being consumed in the process. A lesser focus may add one fourth of its normal level in PPs to any spell cast with it. A lesser focus may also add a special + 10 to any ritual dealing with its spell category. In addition, a minor focus adds its level to any Spell Casting Static Maneuvers for spells in the spell category(s) to which it is attuned.

sp-02674.description_en: Heals damage to one plant that is less complex than a tree (especially severe damage may get a RR to avoid the effects of this spell, GM discretion).

sp-02675.description_en: As Enchant Herb I, except the catalyst gains +3 to its level for casting purposes.

sp-02676.description_en: Target plant is protected from one elemental force (specified at time of casting) for the duration of this spell. The target plant receives a special bonus of +25 versus all attacks associated with this element. The spell is totally protected from natural occurrences of this element. For example, a plant that is protected from wind could not be blown down by a hurricane.

sp-02677.description_en: As Plant Stasis I, except plant can be up to four times the caster's mass.

sp-02678.description_en: Caster enchants one lesser focus making it a greater focus. A greater focus may use one third of its normal level in the casting of spells within its category. Additionally, a greater focus may add +15 to any associated ritual. In addition, a minor focus adds its level to any Spell Casting Static Maneuvers for spells in the spell category(s) to which it is attuned.

sp-02679.description_en: Allows caster to increase the speed of growth for all plants in area of effect by I 00 times.

sp-02680.description_en: As Divide Herb II, except produces three usable doses.

sp-02681.description_en: As Enchant Herb I, except the catalyst gains +4 to its level for casting purposes.

sp-02682.description_en: As Plant Restore, except it can affect any plant (including trees).

sp-02683.description_en: Caster enchants one greater focus making it a major focus. A major focus may use one half of its normal level in the casting of spells out of its category. Additionally, a major focus may add +20 to any associated ritual. In addition, a minor focus adds its level to any Spell Casting Static Maneuvers for spells in the spell category(s) to which it is attuned.

sp-02684.description_en: As Enchant Herb I, except the catalyst gains +5 to its level for casting purposes.

sp-02685.description_en: As Protect Plant, except duration is permanent.

sp-02686.description_en: Caster enchants one major focus making it a true focus. A true focus may use its normal level in the casting of spells within its category. Additionally, a true focus may add +30to any associated ritual. In addition, a minor focus adds its level to any Spell Casting Static Maneuvers for spells in the spell category(s) to which it is attuned.

sp-02688.description_en: Allows caster to make a rope (of no more than 5' per level in length) magical. Any maneuvers the caster performs with this rope will receive a special bonus of +25. Maneuvers performed by others will receive a special bonus of + l 0. Once made magical, the rope will support twice the weight it could before. A caster can only have one Personal Rope at any one time. If the caster ever casts Personal Rope on another rope, the old one loses it's enchantment.

sp-02689.description_en: The caster can place one end of the rope in any position and it will remain fixed there. Normal rules for encumberancelimits will apply to this bond (though the caster's weight should be used as the target weight).

sp-02690.description_en: As Magical Rope I, except the rope has a +10 DB and 30 hits.

sp-02691.description_en: Allows the caster to activate a carpet prepared by the higher level spells on this list. The carpet will fly at a rate of up to 25' per round. The caster must concentrate to make the carpet move. Skill in "maneuvering" the carpet may be developed.

sp-02692.description_en: The next "rope" spell cast from this list will affect two ropes (this applies to any spell on this list that has as a target "one rope").

sp-02693.description_en: As Magical Rope I, except the rope has a + 15 DB, 50 hits, and the attack is resolved as a Medium Grapple attack .

sp-02695.description_en: As Mystical Bond I, except for the duration and the normal strength of the rope is doubled.

sp-02696.description_en: The rope (up to l 00' in length) this spell is cast on will keep the same form for the duration of the spell. It has the approximate strength of bands made of iron.

sp-02698.description_en: Allows caster to create a Flying Carpet that he can command. A caster can only have one Flying Carpet at a time. The creation process takes one week and this spell must

sp-02699.description_en: As Magical Rope Ill, except the rope has a DB of +30 and 80 hits.

sp-02700.description_en: As Carpet Flying II, except the move rate is 75' per round.

sp-02701.description_en: As Multiple Ropes II, except affects 5 ropes.

sp-02702.description_en: As Carpet Flying/, except the move rate is l 00' per round.

sp-02703.description_en: As Flying Carpet, except will hold double the normal encumbrance limits for spells. The carpet can be up to 100 square feet in area and can take l 00 hits before needing repairs (taking 200 hits before being destroyed).

sp-02704.description_en: As Carpet Flying I, except the rate is 150' per round.

sp-02705.description_en: As Multiple Ropes II, except up to 12 ropes are affected.

sp-02706.description_en: The caster can use any lower spell on this list each round.

sp-02707.description_en: Mends multiple rips in a piece of string/twine up to 0.25" diameter. All bits must be collected together (i.e. within a 1O' radius). The string is returned to its pre-ripped state. If pieces are missing or destroyed (i.e., burned to ash) the string can still be repaired but it will be structurally weaker and more susceptible to unraveling. Caster may mend up to 5 feet of string.

sp-02708.description_en: As Mend String, except mends parchment, paper, vellum, etc. Caster may mend 5 square foot of paper.

sp-02709.description_en: As Mend String, except mends rope. Caster may mend up to 15 feet of rope.

sp-02710.description_en: As Mend String, except mends cloth. Caster may mend 5 square foot.

sp-02711.description_en: As Mend String, except mends leather, hide, skin, etc. Caster may mend 5 square foot of leather.

sp-02712.description_en: As Mend String, except mends multiple breaks in nonmagical wood. This can be used to repair cracks or to reassemb Ie broken pieces. Caster may mend 5 cubic foot of wood.

sp-02713.description_en: As Mend String, except mends earth, ceramics, etc. Caster may mend 5 cubic foot of ceramics.

sp-02714.description_en: As Mend String, except mends hard animal substances such as bone, horn, or antler. Caster may mend 1 bone up to 2 cubic foot.

sp-02715.description_en: As Mend String, except mends iron, tin, lead, etc. Caster may mend up to 5 cubic foot.

sp-02716.description_en: As Mend String, except mends ordinary stone and glass. Caster may mend up to 5 cubic foot.

sp-02717.description_en: As Mend String, except mends platinum, gold, silver, etc. Caster may mend up to 1 cubic foot.

sp-02720.description_en: As Mend Parchment, except mends magical parchment, etc.

sp-02721.description_en: As Mend Cloth, except mends magic cloth or rope.

sp-02722.description_en: As Mend Leather, except mends magic leather.

sp-02723.description_en: As Mend Wood, except mends magic wood.

sp-02724.description_en: As Mend Horn, except mends magic horn.

sp-02725.description_en: As Mend Earth, except mends magic earth or ceramics.

sp-02726.description_en: As Mend Stone, except mends magic stone or glass.

sp-02727.description_en: As Mend Metals, except mends magic metals.

sp-02728.description_en: As Mend String, except mends all facets of any one item regardless of the item's composition. Total mass may not exceed 30 cubic feet. All bits must be within 50'R.

sp-02729.description_en: Allows caster to use any of the lower level spells on this list each round for the duration of this spell.

sp-02731.description_en: Target has no reflection in mirrors and other reflective objects. This can affect other spells on this list (Reflection Double, Reflect Inner Truth, and Mirror Slave).

sp-02732.description_en: Allows caster to levitate a flat mirror (no larger than 2'x2'). The mirror must remain in sight of the caster at all times. While the caster concentrates, the mirror can be maneuvered around a within range of the spell at a rate of 20' per round.

sp-02733.description_en: Allows caster to gaze into a reflective surface and gain knowledge regarding one specific topic. This information will be conveyed in an indirect, symbolic, and metaphorical manner. The caster is in a trance like state for the duration of his vision.

sp-02734.description_en: Prepares a mirror to receive a rune. An appropriate rune spell must be cast on the mirror within one minute after casting this spell, and then the spell to be enruned must be cast (as per the normal rules for runes). The rune will be activated by someone looking in the mirror (if the spell has one target, the first person to look in the mirror becomes the target). Once the spell has been discharged, the rune fades. The caster will not trigger his own mirror runes.

sp-02735.description_en: Creates a IO'x IO'x I" mirrored wall. This wall can take 50 concussion hits before shattering.

sp-02736.description_en: This spell may be cast on two mirrors that are within 1000' feet of each other (atthe time of casting). The mirrors must have the spells cast upon them within I day. The mirrors must be at least 2'x3' in size. At any time during the duration of this spell, the caster may step "into" one of the two mirrors and emerge "out of' the other. If either mirror is moved, the spell is dispelled. Note that this spell must be cast separately on each mirror of a pair (and only two mirrors at a time may hold this spell.

sp-02737.description_en: When cast on an appropriate reflective surface, the surface will reflect all objects, including those that are masked by magic.

sp-02738.description_en: Allows the caster to create an illusionary image in anymirror(up to I0'xl0' in size). The illusion is purely visual, but the caster may control the movement of objects in the image, or change the entire image by concentrating.

sp-02739.description_en: Allows caster to ask a single "yes/no" question when gazing into a mirror. He will receive a correct answer 75% of the time, an incorrect answer 20% of the time and a detailed answer 5% of the time.

sp-02740.description_en: When cast on a mirror, this spell traps the gaze of the next person who looks into it and fails a RR. If trapped, the victim will stand or sit immobile, and continue to look unwaveringly into the mirror, paying absolutely no attention to any activity around him (target can initiate no actions). The mirrortrance can be interrupted by breaking the victim's visual contact with the mirror. The caster is immune to his own Mirror Trance spells.

sp-02741.description_en: Pulls target's reflection from mirror, to become a doppelganger-like entity under control of the caster as long as he concentrates. The reflection has same skills and combat abilities as the target (though any wounds the target had at the time of casting will also appear on the double). Ifthe target is a spell caster, the double will have the same numberof PPs the target had at the time of the casting of this spell. For each wound the double takes, the target takes half as much damage (both half the concussion and half of all other penalties).

sp-02742.description_en: All mirrors in the radius shatter explosively. Victims within 50' of any mirrors, who are unable to make maneuver rolls to avoid the flying shards of glass take dlO 'A' slash criticals.

sp-02743.description_en: If target fails his RR, anyone in his presence will see a representation of his "true inner self' in reflective surfaces. For example, if the target is a blow hard bully who is really a coward, his reflection may depict him as a sheep.

sp-02744.description_en: As Mirror Question/, except answer may consist of a short phrase (no more than 10 words).

sp-02745.description_en: As Mirror Door I, except mirrors may be separated by up to a mile.

sp-02746.description_en: Traps target's soul in a mirror designated by the caster(the caster must be touching the mirror when the spell is cast), where it will remain until the mirror is shattered. If the mirror is broken, the target takes a '8' impact critical as his soul escapes.

sp-02747.description_en: Allows caster to use a mirror to deflect a spell that has just been cast on him. If the caster is touching his mirror and can position it between himself and the attacking spell, the caster of the attack spell becomes the victim of his own spell.

sp-02748.description_en: As Steal Reflection, except for duration.

sp-02749.description_en: As Mirror Door I, the mirrors may be up to I 0 miles apart.

sp-02750.description_en: Caster causes a maze of mirrors to spring up and occupy an area of up to 50'x50' (there can be no intervening objects such as walls within the designated area). Mirrors are I 0' high and can withstand 50 concussion hits per 5' section before shattering. The "corridors" of the maze are 5' wide. Caster intuitively knows how to maneuver through his own maze.

sp-02751.description_en: As Reflection Double, except target's reflection becomes caster's personal slave, under his complete control. The target no longer has a reflection. The target's reflection can be restored by the caster or by the caster's death.

sp-02752.description_en: Allows caster to pass through a mirror, and enter the Mirror World. The Mirror World parallels the caster's "real world" only at the point of connection (the mirror). Beyond sight of the mirror, the world may be completely different. Caster must return to his own world through the same mirror he left it. If he remains longer than the spell duration, there is a I% cumulative chance per day that he will become permanently trapped in the Mirror World. Note that if the mirror in the casters own world is moved or destroyed, he will be unable to return home until another mirror is placed in the same location as the previous one.

sp-02754.description_en: Allows caster to completely recall anything he says, reads, or hears while concentrating, for up to I month.

sp-02755.description_en: Caster may dictate to a blank page or book and his words will appear on the page in his own handwriting (must have the appropriate writing knowledge for the language). The caster's words can be in any color and the caster can vary the appearance (font, size, underline, etc.) at will.

sp-02756.description_en: Caster can read text written in an unknown language. The caster reads as though he has rank 3 written in the language. This spell does not convey the sounds of the language, only knowledge of the content of the text.

sp-02757.description_en: Causes any written text to be vocalized aloud in the language in which it is written. It will be heard in the caster's voice. This spell will only read up to a rank 3 linguistic level. If the text is of a higher rank, any concepts beyond rank 3 will be skipped, stuttered over, or incomprehensible. The caster may stop concentrating on this spell to cast any of the Translation spells on this list, and then resume the Phonics spell.

sp-02758.description_en: While concentrating, caster can understand and speak at rank 3 to any sentient being with whom he is conversing. This spell only allows verbal communicating (it is useless for trying to communicate to a race that only communicates mentally or through motions). The caster gains no lasting knowledge of the language; the spell magically translates the caster's words into sounds the being can understand and vice versa. Ifthis spell is used in conjunction with a Spoken spell, the caster can eventually learn the language. This requires the caster to use these spells for at least 2 hours per day for I week.

sp-02759.description_en: Protects any one book or paper from normal wear and tear, aging, weathering, etc.

sp-02760.description_en: Completely restores any non-magical book, or manuscript to its original condition. This spell will not replace lost pages or missing parts of pages, but will return faded or smeared pages to like new.

sp-02761.description_en: As Text Analysis III, except a text can be read to rank 5 of complexity.

sp-02762.description_en: As Spoken Ill, except the writing will be read at rank 5 of complexity. l l. Translation V-As Translation Ill, except the caster can understand and respond at rank 5 complexity and, used in conjunction with Spoken spell, the caster can learn a language.

sp-02764.description_en: Copies a book or document at the rate of I page per minute. The caster does not need to open the book or read the pages, but he does need to supply the paper to be written on.

sp-02765.description_en: As Text Analysis Ill, except a text can be read to rank 7 of complexity.

sp-02766.description_en: As Spoken Ill, except the writing will be read at rank 7 of complexity.

sp-02768.description_en: Caster knows the general direction (east, northeast, etc.) and approximate distance to a non-magical text that he has seen or has been given a detailed description of. This description should contain at least the title, author and general topic of the text.

sp-02769.description_en: As Restore Text /, except will affect magical books. 18 . .Text Analysis X-As Text Analysis III, except a text can be read to rank 10 of complexity.

sp-02771.description_en: As Spoken Ill, except the writing will be read at rank 10 of complexity

sp-02773.description_en: Instantly makes a complete copy of a nonmagical manuscript (25 pages or less). The caster must have sufficient blank paper to make the copy. Multiple castings of this spell can copy larger manuscripts.

sp-02774.description_en: Will restore any text to new condition so long as at least half of it is present. This will repair any damage other than lost or completely destroyed pages. Any pages that are lost or destroyed will be replaced by a page that is a 75% correct replication of the original page.

sp-02775.description_en: As Locate Text, except will work for magical texts.

sp-02776.description_en: Caster learns the dimensions, carrying capacity, average crew size, average running speed, top running speed, and maneuverability of target vessel.

sp-02777.description_en: Caster becomes aware of any threatening weather within the area of effect. This spell will only detect weather capable of putting the ship and crew in danger, not simple wind and rain.

sp-02778.description_en: Allows caster to know in which direction North lies.

sp-02779.description_en: Caster magically marks a location upon the ocean and will know the approximate direction and distance to that location for the duration of the spell. The caster can only have one Location Marker active per 5 levels (round up).

sp-02780.description_en: So long as the stars are visible, the caster can determine his exact latitude in the world.

sp-02781.description_en: Caster learns the exact depth of the water under him at that moment.

sp-02782.description_en: Caster is able to clean all crustacean growth and other buildup from the bottom of his ship. Creatures with a level of I or greater get a resistance roll.

sp-02783.description_en: Purifies water making it suitable for drinking and cooking.

sp-02784.description_en: Caster instantly sets target sails to the exact length and tautness that he desires. This allows the caster to maximize his control and speed on any sailing vessel.

sp-02785.description_en: Target(s) of this spell may row at average pace for the duration of this spell without tiring. Caster may affect up to I target per 2 levels.

sp-02786.description_en: Caster can move 25 gallons per minute. The water is magically moved up to 50' away in a direction of the caster's choosing. There can be no intervening barriers from the initial location to the target location ..

sp-02787.description_en: Allows the caster to view objects in the distance as if they were I Otimes closer. This gives a +50 to all Observation maneuvers involving objects at a distance.

sp-02788.description_en: The caster is able to anticipate which direction the wind will be blowing from in the minutes ahead. Under normal circumstances, this results in a 20% increase in the speed of the vessel.

sp-02789.description_en: Totally dissipates all fog within in the area of effect for as long as the caster concentrates.

sp-02790.description_en: Caster gains knowledge of any areas within area of effect too shallow for the draft of his vessel.

sp-02791.description_en: Caster can steer the vessel from anywhere aboard the vessel as though he were at the rudder. This spell must be cast while holding the wheel or rudder of the vessel. After the spell has been cast, the caster may move freely about the ship.

sp-02792.description_en: This spell creates an anchor of force with a connecting chain that will allow a medium sized vessel to hold its position in light winds (waves). It may be cast multiple times to compensate for a larger vessel or heavier waves.

sp-02793.description_en: Caster will learn the distance and direction to the nearest dry land (of significant size).

sp-02795.description_en: Caster causes the ocean surrounding him to become an area of calmness. This results in 1. 2' waves inside the radius of the spell. Heavy waves will get a RR to this spell with a bonus based on their severity (+50 for extremely severe storms). This spell will not cause any change in the amount of rain or wind in the radius.

sp-02796.description_en: The caster has a complete knowledge of his vessel for the duration. He will constantly be aware of the direction his ship faces, any damage to the ship, the ship's speed, and the direction of the wind. Further, the confidence gained by the casting of this spell will cause sailors to obey orders from the caster quickly and thoroughly.

sp-02797.description_en: Caster knows the exact distance and direction to the last port in which his ship was docked, and becomes aware of the best route to arrive there.

sp-02798.description_en: Caster's ship will immediately begin moving at full speed in any desired direction regardless of wind. Caster may change direction at any time during this spell (as often as desired).

sp-02800.description_en: Caster gains special insight into the difficulty of any proposed maneuver. The GM should inform the character of the difficulty of the proposed maneuver as well as all modifications to the roll. The GM does not have to reveal the source of modifications that are not apparent, but does need to reveal the existence of them.

sp-02801.description_en: When faced with a choice about which he has little information (e.g., which corridor leads outside the quickest) the caster may cast this spell and the GM will determine if there are any obscure clues that might indicate the correct answer. If there are some overlooked clues, then the GM will inform the caster of the best choice biasing the choice favorably by 25% (e.g. on a 1-100 roll: 01-25 incorrect or 26100 correct). If there are no clues, then the GM will randomly decide what the best choice is without any bonus.

sp-02802.description_en: Caster gains a special insight into any pattern he is studying. The pattern could be anything from the stars in the heavens to spider webs to guard shifts. The character gets +25 to all maneuvers associated with understanding the pattern and determining any exceptions or changes in the pattern.

sp-02803.description_en: Caster study's a person's outward appearance, mannerisms, clothing, and speech patterns to gain insight into the opponent's psyche. This understanding allows the character to take advantage of this insight through the use of higher level spells on this list. A caster can have any number of opponents studied at one time as he wishes, but at the end of the duration, the character forgets all of his insights.

sp-02805.description_en: Caster learns the location(s) of any "path(s)" within 500'; gives the nearest point on path, but not the path's course. The caster must either be familiar with the area, have been given directions, or have seen a map of the general area to use this spell accurately. If the caster does not meet one of these criteria then this spell will only give accurate results 75% of the time.

sp-02806.description_en: As Orienteering I, except caster learns the most probable location(s) of a specific landmark, structure, or site (within range of this spell). This spell will only locate things that are larger than the caster in size. I 0. Locate Person-Caster learns the direction and distance to a specified person who is currently "studied" through the use of a Study Person spell (he must be within range of this spell). I I. Memory's Path-Caster can remember an exact route he is travelling; whether or not he was without one or more of his senses (e.g. a caster could remember a trip even if he had been blindfolded).

sp-02809.description_en: Caster can commit to memory any person currently "studied" through the use of a Study Person spell. The caster can only have one person per level memorized. If the caster attempts to memorize a person when he has already memorized his maximum number of persons, the oldest memorized person will "slip" from his memory and will be lost unless re-studied and re-memorized.

sp-02810.description_en: As Read Person I, except caster gains information on the next two rounds and receives a +25 to Influence maneuvers.

sp-02811.description_en: As Orienteering I, except finds all paths within I mile.

sp-02812.description_en: As Probable Location I, except range is 5 miles.

sp-02813.description_en: As Locate Person I, except range is 5 miles. I 7. Find Lost-Caster can locate any I object with which he is familiar. If the object is not in range, the caster learns nothing.

sp-02815.description_en: For the duration of the spell, the caster detects all non-magical lies (magical lies have a 50% chance of being detected). If the caster is subject to an ongoing series of lies, he has a chance to determine the actual truth, assuming that the liar is trying to hide the truth. The chance of determining the truth in this manner is based on the GM's discretion.

sp-02816.description_en: Caster learns all of the conditions and facts behind a prophecy. The caster can identify the age of the prophecy, the origin of the prophecy, and a general indication of the time the prophecy should come to pass. The caster has a 50% chance of learning if a supposed prophecy is a total hoax.

sp-02817.description_en: Caster may locate all hidden openings in the area of effect. This spell will only hidden openings that are normally concealed (i.e., not magical). Caster may concentrate on a different area each round.

sp-02818.description_en: When cast upon a studied person, this spell allows the caster to learn a target's greatest weakness. This weakness can be a physical deformity, a mental deficiency, or a magical susceptibility. Alternatively, the caster can use this spell once per day to make one attack against the person that ignores the opponent's DB.

sp-02820.description_en: Caster may freely cast any lower level spell on this list each round.

sp-02841.description_en: For the duration of this spell, caster will always know in which direction North lies.

sp-02842.description_en: Caster creates his own symbol on a surface of object, which may flare up and be visible to the naked eye or merely visible to Detect Magic spells.

sp-02843.description_en: Caster is able to instantly fasten together any two pieces of cloth, leather, etc. with appropriate materials (thread, thongs, etc). This spell also allows the caster to patch torn or holed material by roughly reattaching torn edges. This spell may also be used to reinforce clothing.

sp-02844.description_en: Caster repels all insects within the area of effect. All insects in the area of effect must leave.

sp-02845.description_en: Caster can see far-off objects as if they were ten times closer. Provides a special +35 to all Observation maneuvers involving distant objects.

sp-02846.description_en: Target repels dirt, mud, blood, and grime for the duration of this spell.

sp-02847.description_en: Target repels rain, hail and snow in a I 'radius around the target. For the duration, the target will not get wet from precipitation. This spell does not provide any protection from bodies of water or water attacks.

sp-02848.description_en: Lights a IO' radius area about the point touched. If the point is on a mobile object or being, it will move with the object or being.

sp-02849.description_en: Caster sets conditions (such as "unauthorized entry") upon which a loud alarm will sound. The alarm may be set to protect an area up to a 50' radius.

sp-02850.description_en: Creates a hidden carrying area up to 1 cubic foot that will hold objects with a combined weight of less than five pounds. Caster is able to recall what is kept in the Hidden Pouch instantly to his hand. For example, Puzz the mage is captured by bandits and is stripped, bound, and gagged. During a moment alone he called up his trusty dagger that is stored in his Hidden Pouch, which enables him to escape. For the duration, the caster may retrieve from or place an item within the Hidden Pouch any number of times. If the items are not retrieved before the end of the duration, the stored items will appear at the caster's feet.

sp-02851.description_en: Caster has a 30% chance of opening any nonmagical lock. If the lock is not unlocked, there is a 10% chance that any traps associated with it are set off. Rolls are open-ended and the sophistication of the lock may modify the roll. (See Spell Law Section 7.1.29). Alternatively, the caster may automatically lock any lock.

sp-02852.description_en: Allows caster to communicate at a distance using a normal method such as flags, flares, lights, drums, etc. Caster may communicate simple ideas or concepts to all who can see the signal. If a viewer of the signal has the skill Signaling, then they will be able to understand more complex concepts or ideas sent by this method.

sp-02853.description_en: Shields a package from the environment. The caster may protect a total surface area ofup to 10 square feet per level of the caster. This spell will not protect against temperature differences, merely moisture damage and vermin. For example, a package protected through the use of this spell will be free of mold and mice, but the mayonnaise inside will still go bad in the summer heat.

sp-02854.description_en: Allows caster to read weather signs (e.g., clouds, winds, smells, temperature, barometric pressure, animal actions, etc). This will allow the caster to predict probable weather conditions for up to 12 hours in advance with 90% accuracy.
