sp-02855.description_en: Allows caster to control the direction of a ship, wagon, or other vehicle from any location on that vehicle as if he were in the appropriate location to steer the vehicle.

sp-02856.description_en: Allows caster to move up to 200 pounds at his normal walking pace (i.e., as if he were not encumbered).

sp-02857.description_en: Allows caster to move large loads (up to 2,000 pounds) short distances (up to 10' per round with no acceleration).

sp-02858.description_en: Allows caster to move objects from one place to another without concentration. Caster casts this spell on a pile of objects which are then transferred (usually from ground to wagon or back). Caster is able to transfer up to 200 pounds per round a distance of up to 100 feet. This spell will not move objects heavier than allotted, and when this is attempted the spell will be canceled. For example, Holl ad, a 20th level mage, casts this spell on a storeroom full of weapons. The spell then moves the weapons (approximately 200 pounds of them per round) to the designated place up to 100 feet away (in this case a waiting wagon outside the building).

sp-02859.description_en: Allows caster to diminish the weight of an object or package to one-fifth normal weight.

sp-02860.description_en: This spell makes all members of a caravan recognizable to each other (outsiders will be easily noticed). This portion of the spell "magically" marks every member of ~he caravan. The mark manifests itself to every type of percept10n (though not in an unpleasant or dominating way). The caster may effect up to I 00 targets.

sp-02861.description_en: Creates an animal of force that will transport up to 500 pounds as a normal pack animal (movement rate of approximately 5 mph).

sp-02862.description_en: Caster is able to pack one item (up to 50 cubic feet) that will be kept in stasis for up to I month. If the packing container is opened before the duration is up, the spell is cancel ed. If this spell is cast upon a living target, the target will be placed in stasis when put into the container.

sp-02863.description_en: Caster creates an interdimensional space (that will hold up to 50 cubic feet) that will hold up to 1,000 pounds. The dimensional pack encumbers the caster at a weight equal to one-tenth the stored weight. This spell must be cast on a suitable container (e.g., barrel, backpack, large box, etc.) which can normally carry the one-tenth weight. If this spell fails, any item inside the space is forever lost.

sp-01708.description_en: Caster can run at one better pace category than normally allowed for his armor and encumbrance. For example, an unarmored man could move at his base rate x6 (expending 75 exhaustion points per round) instead of x5. If the caster stops running, the spell ends. The spell does not give the caster any modifier to the maneuver difficulty nor does it give exhaustion bonuses.

sp-01709.description_en: The caster does not have to breathe for the duration of this spell.

sp-01710.description_en: Caster can whisper and the whisper can be heard at any point he chooses within the range.

sp-01711.description_en: Caster is able to track by sense of smell. This spell gives the caster a +25 to his Tracking skill or +25 to his Observation skill where a sense of smell could help him track (i.e., not underwater).

sp-01712.description_en: This spell sets up random wind currents and eddies around a target for one round per 10% failure. The target is at -25 to all moving maneuvers and combat for the duration. Anyone attempting to attack the target suffers a penalty of -5 to their OB.

sp-01713.description_en: The caster can convert any gas to normal, breathable air at a rate of I cubic foot/round.

sp-01714.description_en: Caster can fly at a rate of 75' per round. While Fly is active, normal movement (e.g., walking, running) is not allowed.

sp-01715.description_en: lfthe target fails his RR he takes damage equal to 10% of his remaining hits each round that the caster concentrates.

sp-01716.description_en: Caster causes all missile attacks to be blown off course, giving them a -100 attack modification. I 0. Concealing Mist-Creates a dense mist in a I 00 radius; normal visibility is JO'.

sp-01718.description_en: Caster reduces all range penalties for one missile attack by 50 (to a maximum of +0).

sp-01719.description_en: The caster's body and gear assumes a gaseous state. The caster may not make or be the target of physical attacks nor perform any action requiring physical manipulation (picking locks, opening doors, lifting, moving objects). The caster may still be the target of spells. Caster is especially vulnerable to wind magic. For the duration of this spell, the caster can move through small openings, pass through bars, and ignore physical attacks. The caster may cast spells normally while in this state, but any elemental spell (E) the caster attempts automatically fails.

sp-01720.description_en: As Minor Turbulence, except maneuver penalty is -50 and attack penalty is -10.

sp-01721.description_en: As Long Breath I, except for duration.

sp-01722.description_en: As Long Whisper/, except for range.

sp-01723.description_en: As Fly/, except rate is 150' per round.

sp-01724.description_en: As Cross Winds I, except area of effect.

sp-01725.description_en: A JO' radius whirlwind is created. This whirlwind delivers an 'A' Impact critical to all inside (every round). All movement through or within the whirlwind is reduced by 80%. The caster can move the whirlwind I' per round.

sp-01726.description_en: As Fly I, except rate is 300'.

sp-01727.description_en: As Minor Turbulence, except the maneuver modifier is -100 and the attack penalty is -20.

sp-01728.description_en: As Fly I, except rate is 450'.

sp-01729.description_en: Caster can use any one lower level spell on this list each round.

sp-01730.description_en: For the duration, the caster gains a +5 bonus to all skills in the Influence skill category (and any other skill that deals with interaction with people).

sp-01731.description_en: One humanoid target of the opposite sex believes the caster is a good friend. The target's RR can be modified by racial prejudices.

sp-01732.description_en: Causes a bright aura about the caster, making him appear more powerful and subtracting 10 from all attacks.

sp-01733.description_en: As Charm Opposite I, but one sentient plant is affected.

sp-01734.description_en: Caster emotionally and/or sensually manipulates one humanoid target (emotional attachment may result). Caster receives a bonus to his Seduction maneuvers against this target equal to the amount the target failed his RR. For example, if a target fails a RR by 15, the caster gets +15 to all Seduction maneuvers for the duration of the spell.

sp-01736.description_en: As Charm Opposite I, except one creature with animal intelligence is affected.

sp-01737.description_en: Target will follow a single suggested act that is not completely alien (e.g. suicide, blinding himself, etc.). This spell expires when the target completes the action.

sp-01738.description_en: As Charm Opposite I, except a member of the same sex is affected.

sp-01739.description_en: As Charm Opposite I, except up to 3 targets may be affected.

sp-01740.description_en: As Empathy I, except the bonus is + 10.

sp-01741.description_en: As Charm Opposite I, except affects any sentient being.

sp-01742.description_en: As Self Aura, except 20 is subtracted from all attacks.

sp-01743.description_en: As Charm Opposite I, except up to 5 targets may be affected.

sp-01744.description_en: Target is given one task that must be within its abilities. Failure or refusal to perform the task results in the target taking 3 'E' electricity criticals.

sp-01745.description_en: As Charm Plant I, except up to 3 plants may be affected.

sp-01746.description_en: As Suggestion I, except up to 3 targets may be given the same suggestion.

sp-01747.description_en: As Charm Animal I, except up to 3 animals may be affected.

sp-01748.description_en: As Charm Same I, except up to 3 targets may be affected.

sp-01749.description_en: As Charm Opposite I, except up to I 0 targets may be affected.

sp-01750.description_en: As Geas, except failure results in death.

sp-01751.description_en: As Self Aura, except caster seems like a demi-god and the penalty to all attacks is -30.

sp-01752.description_en: Caster can use one lower level spell from this list every round.

sp-01844.description_en: Caster detects any fey within the area of effect as well as any objects or items closely associated with the fey.

sp-01845.description_en: The closest appropriate fey will receive a request or distress call from the caster. Whether the fey decides to respond depends on the caster's relationship to the fey and the fey's current attitude. Often if the fey does show up, he will bargain extensively before offering assistance, unless he is already associated with the caster.

sp-01846.description_en: Summons a Type I fey from the faerie realms. The fey appears gradually over the course of d I 0+ I rounds. The summoned fey will remain for the duration and then leave if not bargained with, challenged, commanded, or bound in this time. After the duration, the fey may choose to remain in the area.

sp-01847.description_en: The target fey must accept a challenge from the caster to play a game of chance, riddles, or other similar game. The loser of the game is bound to provide a reasonable service to the winner. A reasonable service includes paying a small sum (up to I gp), revealing a secret, providing a non-magic item, or any other service that would normally have a cost ofless than l gp or requires less than 2 hours of time (GM discretion). If an unreasonable request is made then the spell is broken. A fey cannot refuse a reasonable request so long as it is within his capabilities. If a character refuses a request then all fey receive a special +50 RR to all further Challenge spells cast by the caster. If the caster ever successfully casts a challenge spell after such a refusal and manages to win or provide the requested service, then this penalty is removed.

sp-01848.description_en: Allows the caster to control a Type I fey for the duration of the spell. At the end of this duration, the fey will wander away confused 50% of the time, the other 50% of the time fey will be angry and either attack the caster or require compensation. These requests for compensation will be minor, as Type I fey are easily appeased.

sp-01849.description_en: Caster summons a small animal (up to I 0 pounds) from the faerie realms. The animal will be a beautiful specimen of his species. The animal need not be representative of

sp-01850.description_en: As Summon Fey/, except summons a Type II fey.

sp-01851.description_en: Target Type I fey is bound to the caster for a specified time or a specified task. The fey will remain with the caster for 1 day per level of the caster or until one specific task is accomplished (e.g., the lich king is dead, Prince Solon is crowned, etc.). If the caster is not taking active steps to achieve the specified task, the fey has a 10% chance per day to break the bind. A fey who must break his binding sometimes seek revenge for the deception or else spread word among the fey of the unreliability of the caster. The GM should determine if this has any effects on the caster's later dealings with the fey.

sp-01852.description_en: As Minor Challenge, except the challenge can include contests of magic. The loser must provide a service with a normal value up to 5 gp or 1 week's service.

sp-01853.description_en: Caster and fey become soul mates. This is a process by which two close friends or lovers link their souls and fates together. This spell must be cast once per day for 1 month and can only be completed once in a lifetime by a caster. A soul link shares the spirits or souls of the two targets in such a way that both targets will always know the general direction and distance to their soul mate. Whenevera soul mate is in dire need he can mentally summon his other half. The other half must get there by normal means, but will know the general location of the threatened half of his soul. Each target receives a bonus of +30 versus charm, seduction, fear, subjugation, and mind control spells. Furthermore, each will take on traits of the other half, as determined by the GM.

sp-01854.description_en: As Command Fey/, except affects Type II fey. Also, compensation should be more valuable as Type II fey are more jealous of their time and abilities.

sp-01856.description_en: As Summon Fey/, except summons a Type III fey.

sp-01857.description_en: As Bind Fey/, except affects Type II fey.

sp-01858.description_en: Banishes a Type I fey from the human world for a period of time equal to 1 year per 1% failure. This is a humiliation and a punishment for the targeted fey. Other fey will look down on any such crippled fey.

sp-01859.description_en: As Call Local Fey, except all fey in the range will receive the request for help or the distress call. All who are interested will arrive and they may help or begin arguing with one another.

sp-01861.description_en: As Bind Fey/, except affects Type III fey.

sp-01862.description_en: As Banish Fey/, except affects Type II fey.

sp-01863.description_en: As Produce Small Animal, except I random animal is summoned each round for 1 round per level. The animals will work together and not attack one another for the duration of the spell.

sp-01864.description_en: As Minor Challenge, except physical contests may also be proposed. The loser must provide the equivalent of 1 months service or up to 10 gp value gift.

sp-01865.description_en: This spell may only be cast on the target of a Soul Link spell. Targets can communicate mentally at a distance of 100' per level of their average level. The two targets have twice the number of rounds before soul departure, and are immune to charm spells, seduction, fear, subjugation, and mind control spells.

sp-01928.description_en: Darkens a I 0' radius about the point touched.

sp-01929.description_en: Target can see 100' on a normal night as if it were daylight. See Section 7.1.19 in Spell Law.

sp-01930.description_en: The caster can pick any shadow in range and may visually perceive as if he were at that location.

sp-01934.description_en: Creates a fog of concentrated shadow in a I 0'R that delivers an 'A' Cold critical to those who pass through it. Once created, the fog is affected by the wind and breezes. At the end of the duration, the fog melts away entirely. I 0. Banish Shadow-Target's shadow is banished. For the duration of this spell the caster has no shadow. People without shadows are often shunned as evil, hunted as servants of the unlife and are generally mistrusted.

sp-01937.description_en: When cast in conjunction with a Dark or Enshroud spell, it delays the effects of the other spell until a specific time has passed (up to 24 hrs), or until triggered by a specific event (chosen by the caster at the time of casting).

sp-01938.description_en: As Nightvision, except any darkness can be seen through. Also, no light is needed at all for this spell to work.

sp-01939.description_en: Target's shadow has a life of its own. Although the shadow remains with the target, it does not mimic the target's movement (except in a general way). Instead, its specific movements are often grotesque and random.

sp-01940.description_en: Darkens a lO0'R about the point touched. Utterdark nullifies all magically and naturally created light.

sp-01941.description_en: All shadows in the area of effect are constantly moving and shifting, and bear little if any relation to the actual physical situation.

sp-01943.description_en: As Shadow Spy, except the shadow may interact with the environment and has the following combat statistics: AT 4; DB [half the caster's], Hits [half the caster's], Melee Attack [half the caster's best OB]. The shadow warrior can only be affected by magical attacks. If destroyed, the caster takes 50% of his remaining hits and the caster's shadow will not return for I week.

sp-01944.description_en: As Shadow Servant, except the shadow also has half the caster's PPs (the PPs he has remaining after casting this spell). The shadow can cast spells from any one list that the caster knows (the list must be designated when this spell is cast).

sp-01945.description_en: Caster can use one lower level spell on this list each round.

sp-01947.description_en: Caster can modify the volume of all natural noises produced by the target by x0.5 to x2 original volume (the volume must be selected at the time of casting).

sp-01948.description_en: Creates a 1'R area around the target, into and out of which sound cannot travel; if the point is on a mobile object or being, it will move with the object/being; +25 to Stalking attempts. See Section 7.1.7 in Spell Law.

sp-01949.description_en: Caster can select a specific source of sound that he can hear clearly. All other forms of noise will be muted. This spell effectively screens out all forms of background noise. Caster must make an Alertness maneuver to recognize any other sound for the duration of this spell.

sp-01950.description_en: Caster designates a point within the range of the spell. Caster can speak and his voice will be heard as if it originates at that point.

sp-01951.description_en: Creates a plane (up to 20'x20'), through which sound will not pass.

sp-01952.description_en: Caster's point of hearing may be moved independently up to 100' away (moves at the rate of 1O' per round). He must physically be able to go there (e.g. he could not send his point of hearing through walls or doors).

sp-01953.description_en: As Quiet I, except affects a lO'R.

sp-01954.description_en: As Quiet I, except may affect up to three targets.

sp-01955.description_en: Target's voice has its loudness quadrupled. This has no effect on spell casting capabilities (it simply allows the target to make himself heard without difficulty over long distances).

sp-01956.description_en: As Soundwall I, except 5 such walls are created. Each Sound wall must be connected to at least one other Sound wall.

sp-01957.description_en: As Long Voice I, except range is 300'.

sp-01958.description_en: As Quiet/, except may affect up to three targets.

sp-01959.description_en: As Long Ear I, except range is 300'.

sp-01960.description_en: Target's ears begin ringing so loud that he can hear nothing for the duration.

sp-01961.description_en: As Quiet I, except affects a SO'R

sp-01962.description_en: As Long Voice I, except range is 300' .

sp-01963.description_en: Target object must make a resistance roll or break. Glass items resist at -25 and metal items resist at +25.

sp-01964.description_en: As Long Ear I, except range is 500'.

sp-01965.description_en: Target is incapable of vocalizing any sound for 1 round per 5% failure.

sp-01966.description_en: As Soundwall V, except as many Soundwalls as the target's level can be created.

sp-01967.description_en: As Quiet/, except affects a IOO'R.

sp-01968.description_en: Caster may use any lower level spell on this list each round for the duration of this spell.

sp-01991.description_en: The target need not breathe for the duration of this spell. This spell does not allow the target to breathe water, only to hold his breath for a long time. Therefore, the target cannot speak for the duration either.

sp-01992.description_en: Provides the minimum nutritional requirements to keep the caster from starving. Use of this spell does not provide the feeling of having eaten (the target will still feel hungry). If this spell is used continuously for more than a week (without actually eating normally), the caster will begin to suffer- I for each additional day he uses the spell for sustenance. This penalty can be relieved by eating normally (gaining back 10 points for each day the caster eats normally).

sp-01993.description_en: While the spell is in effect, the caster may, at any time, spend 1 power point to gain 5 exhaustion points. This in not considered to be casting another spell, requires no concentration, and takes no activity.

sp-01994.description_en: Target will feel well-rested without sleep, however he does not heal (or regain power points) until such time as he does sleep for at least 4 hours plus an additional 4 hours for each night he went without sleep.

sp-01995.description_en: Target can tolerate temperatures I O per level of the caster beyond normal with no ill effects. This temperature modification can be set for extremes of heat or extremes of cold, but cannot be changed once the spell is cast.

sp-01996.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster will expend no exhaustion points for any activity that he performs. If this spell is cast multiple times in one day, after the second spell ends, all exhaustion point expenditures are doubled (then tripled after the third spell, etc.).

sp-01997.description_en: Caster can cause his skin to become more dense and resistant to damage. The caster gains AT 3 for the duration. However, if the caster spends double the normal necessary PPs (i.e., 14 PPs), he gains AT 8. If the caster spends triple the normal PPs (i.e., 21 PPs), he gains AT 11. If the caster spends quadruple the normal PPs (i.e., 28 PPs), he gains AT 14. However, in all cases, the caster's DB is lowered by -10.

sp-01998.description_en: For the duration of this spell, all concussion damage the caster takes is halved (rounding up).

sp-01999.description_en: The caster gains an extra RR versus any poison in his system. This RR is modified by +20. If the poison is still not resisted, it takes effect normally. I 0. Resist Disease-As Resist Poison, except affects diseases.

sp-02001.description_en: Target becomes extremely resistant to a particular element (designated by the caster at the time of casting). The target and his equipment gain a special modification of +50 to any RRs versus normal, non-magical elements specified. Versus magical attacks from that element, the target gains a special bonus of +20 to DB and/or RRs.

sp-02002.description_en: Upon receiving a death blow, the caster goes into a coma until he is healed or his brain is destroyed. The caster's normal bodily functions occur, but he is still subject to changes from the environment around him.

sp-02003.description_en: Resists the effects of harmful psychological changes on the target. This allows the target to make an RR versus the insanity modified by a +20. If the RR fails, the insanity has normal effects.

sp-02004.description_en: Allows caster a special bonus of +1 per level to all RRs versus spells from one realm of magic (Essence, Channeling or Mentalism) chosen at the time of casting.

sp-02005.description_en: Allows caster a special bonus of+ I per level to all RRs versus one combination of the realms (Essence/ Channeling, Essence/Mentalism, Arcane, etc.) chosen at the time of casting.

sp-02006.description_en: Caster gains some slight resistance to criticals. All criticals rolled against the caster are lowered by l per five levels of the caster (i.e., a 21st level Illusionist would have all criticals he took lowered by -4). However, this effect does not apply to natural '00' or natural '66' on the critical roll.

sp-02008.description_en: Caster may make a second RR versus any attempt to remove his soul from from his body (via Absolution, etc.).

sp-02009.description_en: Caster is able to cause his body to maintain it's internal pressure regardless of outside conditions. Thus it is possible for a caster to be exposed to the ocean depths (or in a vacuum) without harm.

sp-02010.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster operates as if he were in normal gravity conditions.

sp-02011.description_en: Caster goes into a state of suspended animation. He can survive in any environment regardless of conditions. When this spell is cast, the caster sets a condition under which he will come out of the stasis. This condition must be relatively simple and pertain to the immediate location of the caster (i.e., after a certain time has elapsed, when the temperature drops below I 00 degrees, when I am no longer underwater, etc.).

sp-02036.description_en: When a Circle of Summoning is drawn it is dedicated to a type of creature subject to the GM's approval (e.g., animal, demon, elemental, faerie, etc ). While the caster is within this circle he receives a special +35 to his Summoning skill for that particular creature.

sp-02037.description_en: Allows up to a 1st level spell to be imbedded into a prepared circle. The spell to be imbedded into the circle must be cast within one minute after the Circle spell.

sp-02038.description_en: The caster dedicates the containment circle to a type of creature subject to GM' s approval (e.g., human, animal, demon, elemental, faerie, etc). Whenever such a creature tries to cross the border of the circle, he must make a RR at-50 or else take a 'C' Impact critical. If the creature makes his RR, the containment circle is canceled. The caster can summon creatures into a circle of containment.

sp-02039.description_en: As Circle /, except up to 2nd level spells can be imbedded.

sp-02040.description_en: Allows the caster to place two circles around each other, thereby combining their effects without negating one another.

sp-02041.description_en: As Circle /, except up to 3rd level spells can be imbedded.

sp-02042.description_en: All within the area of effect must resist or take 10% of their remaining hits every round (they may make a new RR each round).

sp-02043.description_en: Caster causes the outline of the circle to blaze in unearthly fire. Anyone attempting to cross the circle will take an 'A' Heat critical.

sp-02044.description_en: As Circle/, except up to 5th level spells can be imbedded.

sp-02045.description_en: As Multi-Circle //, except up to three circles may be placed in conjunction.

sp-02046.description_en: As Circle/, except up to 6th level spells can be imbedded.

sp-02047.description_en: Any creature summoned within a Circle ofBinding must answer one question or perform one task for the caster. This spell does not grant the caster the ability to communicate with the creature.

sp-02048.description_en: As Circle/, except up to 7th level spells can be imbedded.

sp-02049.description_en: The next imbedded Circle spell effect(s) can be delayed for up to one day per level of the caster or until triggered by one of the following (decided at the time of casting): specified movements, touch, or a specific action.

sp-02050.description_en: All within the area of effect must make an RR or gain 1 power point per 10% failure for every round they are in the area.

sp-02051.description_en: As Circle/, except up to 10th lvl spells can be imbedded.

sp-02052.description_en: All within the area of effect must make a RR or lose l power point per I 0% failure for every round they are in the area.

sp-02053.description_en: As Multi-Circle //, except up to four circles may be placed in conjunction.

sp-02054.description_en: As Circle/, except up to 12th level spells can be imbedded.

sp-02055.description_en: As Circle/, except up to 15th level spells can be imbedded .

sp-02056.description_en: Allows the caster to "link" multiple circles (each circle must be within half a mile of at least one other circle in the matrix) for the transfer of power points or spells. A spell user in any linked circle may send spells or power points to any other spell user in a circle within the matrix. The recipient of any spells must cast the spell immediately as an instantaneous spell. The recipient still may only cast one spell per round and if multiple spells are transferred to him he will cast each in the order that they were sent to him. Any spell sent to a recipient must include the appropriate number of power points and both the sender and recipient must make spell casting maneuvers to check for spell failure. The size of the matrix must be defined when this spell is cast. All circles must already be in place and this spell must be cast at each circle (within one year of the creation of the first piece of the matrix). The maximum size of the matrix is one circle per 10 levels of the caster.

sp-02057.description_en: As Circle /, except up to 30th level spells can be imbedded.

sp-02059.description_en: Detects the presence of any counterspells on a target. Has a 50% chance of revealing what spell by which the counters pell will be triggered. Multiple casts of this spell on a target will reveal no additional information.

sp-02060.description_en: When casting this spell on the target, the caster must specify one first level spell to be counterspelled. The spell to be counterspelled must either be known by the caster or have been previously studied (using the Study Spell on this list). If the specified spell is later cast on that target, that spell will have no effect, and this counterspell will be dispelled. At any one time, a target can only have one level of counterspells per level of experience. Each Counters pell I counts as 1 spell level, each Counterspell III counts as 3 spell levels, etc.

sp-02061.description_en: Detects the presence of any spell traps on a target. Has a 50% chance of revealing what spell by which the spell trap will be triggered. Multiple casts of this spell on a target will reveal no additional information.

sp-02062.description_en: As Counterspe/1 /, except if the specified spell is cast on the target, the target will gain a number of PP equal to the level of the countered spell.

sp-02063.description_en: As Counterspe/1 /, except that three levels of spells can be countered. This can be a specific third level spell or a specific second and a specific first level spell or three specific first level spells. Note that the three first level spells can be the same spell, so that if the spell is cast on the target repeatedly it can be countered more than once.

sp-02064.description_en: Any Counterspel/s or Spelltraps on the target have a chance of disintegrating with no effect. Each counterspell or spelltrap should roll a resistance roll at +25. Failure results in the dispelling of the failing counterspell or spell trap.

sp-02065.description_en: As Counterspell Ill, except affects 4 levels.

sp-02066.description_en: As Spelltrap I, except that up to 3 levels may be trapped.

sp-02068.description_en: As Spelltrap Ill, except 5 levels can be trapped.

sp-02069.description_en: As Counterspe/1 Ill, except affects 8 levels.

sp-02070.description_en: This spell may be cast in conjunction with any Counterspell. If the specific spell selected is cast on the target, the spell is reflected back upon its caster. Treat the caster as the target of the spell in all ways.

sp-02071.description_en: As Reflect Essence, except affects Channeling spells.

sp-02072.description_en: As Reflect Essence, except affects Mentalism spells.

sp-02074.description_en: As Countermeasures, except resistance rolls are made at no modification (+O).

sp-02075.description_en: As Counterspe/1 Ill, except affects 15 levels.

sp-02076.description_en: As Spelltrap Ill, except 15 levels can be trapped.

sp-02077.description_en: When this spell is cast, the target spell must make a RR (target level is the level of the spell) or be reversed. A reversed spell will have the opposite effect it was intended to have. For example, elemental attack spells will heal hits and wounds, Hold spells will Haste the target, Curses will Bless, etc. The exact nature of this reversal is up to the GM. If there is no appropriate reverse effect, the spell is merely canceled.

sp-02078.description_en: As Counterspel/ Ill, except affects 20 levels.

sp-02079.description_en: As lord Counterspe/1, except affects the specified spells that target anyone or anything inside a 10'R around a point touched. This point may be on an object that can be moved.

sp-02080.description_en: As Spelltrap Ill, except 20 levels can be trapped.

sp-02104.description_en: Caster can relocate packed earth at the rate of 1 cubic foot per minute. Dirt can be relocated anywhere within 10' radius of target area.

sp-02105.description_en: Caster gains a +25 to all caving, underground survival, and direction sense rolls (while underground).

sp-02106.description_en: Creates a wall of earth up to 10'x I 0'x(3' at base, 1' at top). This wall can be dug through ..

sp-02107.description_en: This spell causes earth and stone tendrils to rise up out of the ground and attack anything within their area of effect. The tendrils attack as a +0 Medium Grapple attack. Alternatively, the GM may allow the caster to develop a skill called Targeting for Earth Fingers (Power Manipulation Skill Category). If the GM allows this skill, then all attacks that use this bonus requires that the caster concentrates.

sp-02108.description_en: For the duration of the spell, the caster has + 15 HPs and reduces criticals by I level. Any spells cast from any other list while this spell is active is at-15. Any damage done to the character affects the 15 HPs of the Earthskin first and never hits the caster. So when the spell is over the damage does not transfer to the caster.

sp-02109.description_en: As Dig, except that stone may be relocated at the rate of I cubic foot per minute or earth may be relocated at 2 cubic feet per minute.

sp-02110.description_en: Creates of wall of stone up to I 0'x 10'x(3' at the base, 1' at the top). This wall can be chipped through.

sp-02111.description_en: As Earthwall, except range and duration.

sp-02112.description_en: As Earth Fingers, except causes a huge hand to rise up out of the ground. The hand can attack with a +50 Large Grapple anything the caster chooses within the area of effect. After being held, the target takes a 50 Large Crush attack

sp-02113.description_en: Caster can merge into any earth, stone or metal inanimate object or wall. While merged, the caster cannot move or perceive. When the caster emerges from the material, he can emerge from any side or face of the material. The caster cannot move "through" material greater in width than his own body size plus 2 feet. The caster can exit at any time during the spell duration.

sp-02114.description_en: Allows caster to alter the shape ofup to 1 cubic foot per level of any stone or metal material by molding it with his hands. The shape formed lasts until the duration ends, and then is affected normally by the environment.

sp-02115.description_en: I-As Earthskin, except caster gains +45 HPs and reduces criticals by 2 levels. Any spells cast from any other list while this spell is active is at -45.

sp-02116.description_en: Caster can phase through any earth, stone or metal inanimate object or wall at a rate of 2' per round.

sp-02117.description_en: As Stone Wall, except duration is permanent.

sp-02118.description_en: Caster can see through natural earth or stone to a depth of up to I' per level.

sp-02119.description_en: As Earth Hand, except a pair of huge (5'diameter, I 0' long) earth and stone arms rise out of the ground and attacks the target of the caster's choice within the area of effect with a + 100 Huge Grapple Attack. If the attack causes a 'C' critical or better, the victim is enveloped and begins to suffocate. If the caster concentrates then the victim will take an 'E' Crush critical each round. Target may make a RR each round (using his strength bonus as his level) versus the caster's level. If successful, the target escapes the hand.

sp-02120.description_en: As Earthwall, except range and duration.

sp-02121.description_en: As Earth Molding, except for duration.

sp-02123.description_en: As Earth Phasing, except caster can move at a rate of I 0' per round.

sp-02124.description_en: As Stone Wall, except creates a 50'x IO'x 1' stone wall.

sp-02125.description_en: Caster can use one lower level spell on this list each round.

sp-02131.description_en: ental-As Repel Elemental Servant, except it repels Weak Elementals.

sp-02132.description_en: ental-As Control Elemental Servant, except affects Weak Elementals.

sp-02133.description_en: ental-As Banish Elemental Servant, except affects Weak Elementals.

sp-02134.description_en: As Summon Elemental Servant, except affects Weak Elementals.

sp-02135.description_en: unication-For the duration, the caster can communicate freely with the target Elemental. This spell allows no control of the Elemental and does not automatically make it friendly toward the caster.

sp-02136.description_en: ental-As Master Elemental Servant, except affects Weak Elementals. _

sp-02137.description_en: ental-As Repel Elemental Servant, except it repels Strong Elementals.

sp-02138.description_en: ental-As Control Elemental Servant, except affects Strong Elementals.

sp-02139.description_en: ental-As Banish Elemental Servant, except affects Strong Elementals.

sp-02141.description_en: ental-As Summon Elemental Servant, except affects Strong Elementals.

sp-02142.description_en: ental-As Master Elemental Servant, except affects Strong Elementals.

sp-02145.description_en: Caster calls out to his familiar, summoning it to his location. The familiar will instinctively know the direction to the caster and begin moving in that direction at best speed. If the caster moves while the familiar is in transit, he will have to cast this spell again for the familiar to know his new location.

sp-02146.description_en: Allows the caster and his familiar to combine their senses, and use those best suited for their surroundings. This means that they will both receive +20 to all Observation and Alertness maneuvers for the duration. For this spell to work, the familiar must be "in range" of the this spell.

sp-02147.description_en: The caster can attune himself to a small creature (of creature intelligence) to serve as his familiar. The caster must obtain the creature through normal means and cast this spell on the creature once per day for 2 weeks (concentrating for 4 hours per day). The caster can then control the familiar and view the world through its senses by concentrating on it (though the familiar must be within 50' per level). See Section 10.2 for more information about True Familiars.

sp-02148.description_en: Caster will know the exact distance and direction to the familiar, at that moment, if it is within range of this spell.

sp-02149.description_en: Allows the caster's familiar to be considered "in range" up to 100' per level.

sp-02150.description_en: The caster can take any damage to his familiar upon himself if he wishes. In addition, the caster can choose to send any damage he has suffered to his familiar instead (this must be done when the wound occurs to the caster).

sp-02151.description_en: Allows the caster to store one spell in the familiar. Whenever the caster desires, the spell will be instantly cast as though the caster were in the location of the familiar. The familiar must be "in range" for the stored spell to be activated, and the caster may not cast any other spells until the stored spell is discharged.

sp-02152.description_en: As Call Familiar I, except for range. I0. Range Extension II-As Range Extension I, except for range.

sp-02155.description_en: As Locate Familiar I, except for range.

sp-02156.description_en: Allows caster and familiar to share their resistance to magic, poison, and disease, using those most advantageous to their environment. This results in a +20 to all RRs for the duration. If either caster or familiar fails a RR, they both suffer the consequences of failure.

sp-02157.description_en: Instantly teleports the familiar to the caster's side as long as the familiar is "in range".

sp-02158.description_en: As Call Familiar I, except for range.

sp-02160.description_en: As Locate Familiar I, except for range.

sp-02161.description_en: Allows the caster to instantly teleport to the familiar's location as long as the familiar is "in range"

sp-02162.description_en: As Call Familiar I, except for range.

sp-02163.description_en: As Range Extension/, except for range.

sp-02164.description_en: This spell goes into effect the instant the caster or familiar' s soul leaves its body. The soul is stored in the body of the other until the body can be restored to a condition where it can survive again (this may require a variety of healing spells), or until 1 day per level of the caster has elapsed. If the caster or familiar (whichever one did not die) is killed while carrying both souls, both souls depart as normal.

sp-02165.description_en: The caster and familiar are able to act and think in perfect unison for the duration. The caster may cast any lower level spell from this list once per round.

sp-02166.description_en: The caster can summon a torch-sized flame to his hand. The hand will be unharmed by the flames, though the fire is very real. If the caster strikes an opponent in combat with this hand, there is a 50% chance that he will inflict an 'A' Heat critical on his opponent in addition to any other damage he does.

sp-02167.description_en: Any solid inanimate, non-metal material (up to 1 cubic per level) can be warmed to 100° F at a rate of 1 cubic per round of concentration.

sp-02168.description_en: Causes one flammable object to burst into flames. Fire is normal and can be put out by the usual methods.

sp-02169.description_en: Caster can cauterize any one bleeding wound that is bleeding 5 hits per round or less. The target takes 2 concussion hits for each hit per round the wound was bleeding. This stops the bleeding, but leaves an ugly scar.

sp-02170.description_en: Caster is totally protected from natural heat up to 200° F and adds + 10 to RRs versus heat and -10 to elemental fire attacks.

sp-02171.description_en: Caster is bathed in flames. Anyone who comes within l' of the caster will take an 'A' Heat critical. The caster is unharmed by these flames, but the cloak provides no protection from other elemental attacks (including fire).

sp-02173.description_en: As Resist Heat, except protects against all natural heat and fire and modifies spells involving heat and fire by -20.

sp-02174.description_en: A bolt of fire is shot from the palm of the caster. Resolve attack on the Fire Bolt Attack Table.

sp-02175.description_en: Caster can control the movement and spread of flames within the area of effect. The caster can cause flames to spread in a specific direction at the rate of 1' per round to 1O' per round depending upon the fuel. The fire itself can be caused to suddenly flare in areas to attack targets within the area of effect causing an 'A' Heat critical to any targets within the area of effect (the whole area must be aflame). The caster can only cause the fire to flare in such a way every other round. The caster can concentrate on a different area each round.

sp-02176.description_en: As Fire Cloak I, except causes a 'B' Heat critical.

sp-02177.description_en: A 1' diameter ball of fire is shot from the palm of the caster. Upon reaching its target, it explodes to affect a lO'R area. Resolve attack on the Fire Ball Attack Table.

sp-02178.description_en: As Lesser Firebolt, except range is 100'.

sp-02179.description_en: As Ignite, except 1 object per level of the caster is ignited.

sp-02180.description_en: Caster creates a wall of fire that is 1O' high and forms a lO'R circle (6" thick) with the caster at the center (the wall will not move with the caster).

sp-02181.description_en: As Resist Heat, except protects against all natural heat and fire and modifies spells involving heat and fire by 20, reduces damage from fire by half, and reduces heat criticals by one level.

sp-02182.description_en: I-Caster creates a lO'xlO'xlO' cube of flame. The cube takes a complete round to form and be effective. Anyone passing through (or that is caught inside) the cube takes an 'A' Heat critical.

sp-02183.description_en: As Fire Cloak I, except causes a 'C' Heat critical to anyone touching the caster and an 'A' Heat Critical to all within 5'R of the caster.

sp-02184.description_en: As Control Flames, except area of effect is 20'R, caster can cause a flame to spread at a rate of 3' per round to 30' per round depending on the fuel. Also, the caster can cause 'B' Heat criticals from sudden flare up of the flame.

sp-02185.description_en: Caster can enchant any normal fire to an intense heat. This fire will burn anything remotely flammable and can be used to melt or weaken most metals. Any metal item made at a forge from such an enchanted flame becomes magical with no bonus and no other abilities. These weapons can affect creatures that can only be affected by magical weapons. The use of this spell does not modify the normal time to create any such item.

sp-02186.description_en: As Fire Cloak I, except causes a 'D' Heat critical to anyone within 1' of the caster and an 'B' Heat Critical to all within I O'R of the caster.

sp-02187.description_en: With this spell, the caster causes an explosion offire. The attack is resolved as a+ 100 Fire Ball delivering double concussion hits. The caster is at the center of the attack, but takes half damage.

sp-02188.description_en: Caster can use one lower level spell from this list each round.

sp-02225.description_en: Caster launches a flare of light that rapidly flies to a target area within range, where it slowly drifts to the ground. For the duration of the spell, the flare illuminates a 1O' radius area. If fired at a target, it will do no damage and simply fade away.

sp-02226.description_en: A beam of light springs from the caster's palm. This light has a 50' effective range. If the caster closes his fist, the light will "tum off;" when the fist is opened, the light will come back on (so long as the duration has not expired).

sp-02227.description_en: Target is immune to bright light, sun glare, and snow blindness. Target also receives a special bonus of +25 versus all blinding attacks.

sp-02228.description_en: Creates 1 ball of iridescent light per caster's level, which can be made to "dance" anywhere within the spell's range. These lights cannot harm, and give off light equal to that of a torch. Everyone within sight of the lights (except the caster) must make a RR versus a first level attack (as per a Fear RR) or be transfixed for one round per 10% failure.

sp-02230.description_en: Creates a multi-colored display of exploding lights.

sp-02231.description_en: Creates a bright aura about the target, making him appear more powerful and subtracting 5 from all attacks against him.

sp-02232.description_en: Causes a 10' radius burst of intense light; all those inside are stunned for 1 round per 10% failure .

sp-02233.description_en: As Light I, except has a 50' radius.

sp-02234.description_en: Caster creates and releases a sparkling ball of translucent, swirling color which strikes the target, resulting in one round of blindness per 10% failure.

sp-02235.description_en: Causes any object up to 1000 cubic feet to glow any desired color.

sp-02236.description_en: As Aura, except subtracts 10 from all attacks.

sp-02237.description_en: As Sudden light/, except has a 20' radius.

sp-02238.description_en: As light I, except has a 100' radius.

sp-02239.description_en: This spell is cast in conjunction with any Light spell (i.e. the Light spell must be cast within 1 minute of casting this spell). It can delay the activation of that spell for up to 24 hours. It can be triggered by one of the following (decided by the caster at the time of casting): time period, specific movements, specific sounds, touch, violent action in the area, etc.

sp-02240.description_en: A ray of light (any color) springs from caster's palm. This ray can be up to 5 miles long.

sp-02241.description_en: As Aura, except subtracts 15 from all attacks.

sp-02242.description_en: As Light I, except has a 200' radius.

sp-02243.description_en: As Sudden Light I, except has a 50' radius.

sp-02244.description_en: As Light I, except has a 50' radius.

sp-02245.description_en: As Beacon V, except ray can be up to 10 miles long.

sp-02246.description_en: As Light I, except for area of effect.

sp-02247.description_en: Caster may use any lower level spell on this list each round for the duration of this spell.

sp-02287.description_en: The tip of the staff glows at whatever intensity the caster desires, from barest glimmer to a bright light (20'R). When the caster is not concentrating, the tip will barely glow.

sp-02288.description_en: The caster can store any one spell in his staff. The spell to be stored must be cast immediately after this spell (within I minute). The power point cost of this spell is equal to the level of the store spell plus the cost of the spell to be stored. For example, in order to store a 5th level spell in a magic staff using Staff Spell I is equal to 5 (the level of the spell)+ 3 (the level of the store spell) = 8. The caster must spend power points to cast the spell that has been stored. A stored spell may be cast at any later time with no preparation and does not prevent the caster from casting other spells normally. Every staff has up to 5 spell storage slots in it. Only the first of these slots is available through the use of this spell, so only one spell may be stored at a time through the use of Spell Store I.

sp-02289.description_en: As Minor Staff, except that it turns the Minor Staff into a + I adder and a + I O quarterstaff.

sp-02290.description_en: When this spell is cast on a staff, it becomes attuned to a particular situation. If this situation arises, the staff makes a sound, alerting the caster. The situation must be within 100' for the staffto register the situation. For example, if the caster attuned his staff to ores, the staff would make a sound as soon as an ore approached within 100'. The caster must decide ifhe wants the alerting sound to be loud or soft at the time of casting.

sp-02291.description_en: This immediately returns the caster's staff to his outstretched hand if the staff is within range of this spell.

sp-02293.description_en: As Staff Spell I, except caster can store spells in the second spell storage slot. The caster may store any one spell in this slot and use it with no preparation at any later time.

sp-02294.description_en: As Lesser Staff, except that it turns the Lesser Staff into a +2 spell adder and a+ 10 quarterstaff.

sp-02296.description_en: As StaffSpell I, except caster can store spells in the third spell storage slot.

sp-02297.description_en: Caster's staff points in the direction of any specific object or place that the caster is familiar with or has had described to him in detail. The caster must have the dimensions of the object within 10% if actual size and know at least two other attributes that make the item unique (e.g., color, texture, weight, etc.). Note that sometimes the caster must know more than two other attributes to make the item unique.

sp-02298.description_en: When this spell is cast, the caster adds his level to his Defensive Bonus and Resistance Rolls (e.g. a 15th level caster would add+ I 5 to both his DB and all RRs).

sp-02299.description_en: As StaffSpell I, except caster can store spells in the fourth spell storage slot.

sp-02300.description_en: As Greater Staff, except that it turns a Greater Staff into a +3 spell adder and a+ 15 quarterstaff.

sp-02301.description_en: Staff does double concussion hits for the duration of this spell.

sp-02302.description_en: Transforms caster's staff into any animal (creature intelligence). The creature's mass may not exceed 50 pounds. The beast is treated as a familiar (see Section 10.0 for more information on familiars).

sp-02303.description_en: As Staff Spell I, except caster can store spells in the fifth spell storage slot.

sp-02304.description_en: As Silver Staff, except that it turns a Silver into a +4 spell adder and a+ 15 quarterstaff. Alternatively, the caster may choose to change the staffinto a x2 PP multiplier and a + I Oquarterstaff.

sp-02305.description_en: Staff does triple concussion hits for the duration of this spell.

sp-02306.description_en: As Golden Staff, except that it turns a Golden into a +5 spell and a+ 20 quarterstaff. Alternatively, the caster may choose to change the staff into a x2 PP multiplier and a+ I 5 quarterstaff.

sp-02307.description_en: As Lord Staff, except that it turns a Lord Staff into a +6 spell adder and a +30 quarterstaff. Alternatively, the caster may choose to change the staffinto a x2 PP multiplier and a +20 quarterstaff.

sp-02331.description_en: Allows caster to memorize any one shape he has seen or created (through the use of Modify Stored Shape). A given caster can only have as many shapes stored as he has levels.

sp-02332.description_en: Allows caster to alter any "stored" shape. Caster may combine parts of up to one shape per level into one shape. Shape must be contiguous.

sp-02333.description_en: Allows caster to create desired shape from an idea. Shape may them be stored for normal use.

sp-02334.description_en: Allows a caster to alter the shape of up to I cubic foot per level of any one type of gas by using his hands to move and place portions of the gas. The shape formed lasts until the duration ends and is then affected normally by the environment. For example Haladan the Vizier, uses this spell to mold smoke from the fireplace into funny animal shapes, pleasing the king and courtiers.

sp-02335.description_en: As Mold Gas, except allows the moldingof one type of liquid.

sp-02336.description_en: As Mold Gas, except allows the molding of one type of solid.

sp-02337.description_en: As Mold Gas, except allows the molding of a material that is either a combination of two of the other three previous materials (lava, mud, etc.), or none of them (energy, plasma, magical energy, Jiving tissue, etc.). This spell confers no immunity to harmful effects of handling these materials.

sp-02338.description_en: Allows caster to remove matter from a shape without upsetting the dynamics and/or balance of the object/ material. This removed material may be utilized for other purposes. Up to I% of the present material may be removed per level of the caster.

sp-02339.description_en: As Lessen Shape, except that material is added to an abject instead of subtracted. This spell does not provide the extra material to be added.

sp-02341.description_en: Allows caster to reduce the density ofup to I cubic foot of material per level. The density (and therefore weight) can be reduced by up to 5% per level of the caster, but never more than 90% decrease.

sp-02342.description_en: Caster can increase the density of up to l cubic foot of material per level. The density (and therefore weight) can be increased by up to 5% per level.

sp-02343.description_en: Allows caster to alter the shape (with his mind) ofup to l cubic foot per level ofany one type of gas within range. The Altered form will retain it's shape for the duration and afterwards until acted upon by outside forces.

sp-02344.description_en: As Shape Gas, except allows the shaping of one type of liquid.

sp-02345.description_en: As Shape Gas, except allows the shaping of one type of solid.

sp-02346.description_en: As Shape Gas, except allows the shaping of a material that is either a combination of two of the other three previous materials (lava, mud, etc.), or none of them (energy, plasma, magical energy, living tissue, etc.). This spell confers no immunity to harmful effects of handling these materials.

sp-02348.description_en: As Liquify Gas, except material goes from a liquid to a gas.

sp-02349.description_en: As Liquify Gas, except material goes from a liquid to a solid.

sp-02350.description_en: As Liquify Gas, except material goes from a solid to a liquid.

sp-02351.description_en: As Liquify Gas, except material goes from "other" state to a gas. Living things and magical forces get a RR.

sp-02352.description_en: As Liquify Gas, except material goes from "other'' state to a liquid. Living things and magical forces get a RR.

sp-02353.description_en: As Liquify Gas, except material goes from "other" state to a solid. Living things and magical forces get a RR.

sp-02354.description_en: This spell analyzes one "machine," giving the caster an idea of its purpose and operating procedures. This gives the caster a +20 when operating this particular machine. Anyone to whom he describes the analysis to can get a+ I 0 when operating the machine.

sp-02355.description_en: Caster discovers the weakest point in the studied object. The weakness may be a crack, a thin point, or crumbling mortar in a wall. This weak point may be exploited by the casteror pointed outto others. Any attacks the caster does to a weak point is at xl.5 damage. This spell does not work on living creatures.

sp-02356.description_en: Target object develops a temporary internal fracture-like flaw. This reduces the strength of the item by 10 for every 10% failure on the item's RR. The item must be checked for breakage/reliability the first time it is used after this spell is cast on it. After the initial check, follow normal breakage/reliability rolls.

sp-02357.description_en: Caster warps a mechanism to modify its normal operations in a specific way. For example, if the mechanism is set to go off if the correct key is not inserted into the lock, the mechanism can be warped to go off only when the correct key is inserted. Changes to a mechanism must operate with the existing machinery.

sp-02358.description_en: Caster can improve the efficiency of any mechanism by 50% over its original efficiency for the duration of this spell.

sp-02359.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the object degrades with use. Each round the object is used it receives a cumulative -1. At the end of this spell, the object will lose a -1 penalty each round (to a maximim of +0). For every accumulated penalty of -25, the object will have a permanent -5 penalty. This penalty can be removed with an appropriate maintenance maneuver.

sp-02360.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the object improves with use. Each round the object is appropriately used it receives a cumulative +I (non-magic bonus). For every 2 rounds the object is not appropriately used, it loses a +I bonus (to a minimum of +0). At the end of the spell's duration, the object will lose a+ I bonus every 2 rounds. The maximum bonus for any object is +50.

sp-02361.description_en: The area of effect becomes a chaotic maelstrom of activity. The actual appearance of this spell depends on the surroundings. If this spell is cast in the forest, then leaves and dirt may swirl in the air throughout the area of effect. If this spell is cast indoors, books, pots, pans, and the like may swirl around. Though the appearance varies, the net effect remains the same. Everyone in the area of effect must make a successful Observation maneuver (Medium to Very Hard) or be unable to move for that round. The caster may pass through the chaos unaffected.

sp-02362.description_en: Caster instantly assembles a number of appropriate components to form a simple trap. The catalysts must logically work together, but the spell itself forms the connections that assembles the catalysts into a coherent trap. The GM must determine the effectiveness and quality of the trap based on the materials and the caster's description of how the trap will work.

sp-02363.description_en: Caster gains special insight into mechanical operations which allows him to analyze the inner workings of a specific mechanism. The caster can use this information to later re-create this mechanism given the appropriate materials. Additionally, caster gains a +25 to all Mechanition rolls.

sp-02364.description_en: As Concealed Flaw, except the strength of the item is reduced by 25 per 10% failure.

sp-02365.description_en: Allows caster to delay the effects of the next spell cast from this list (must be cast within I minute) up to 24 hours. The spell may be triggered by a specific set of circumstances that must be set at the time of casting.

sp-02366.description_en: Caster gains a special insight into engineering studies. The caster receives a special bonus of +50 to all engineering maneuvers for the duration of this spell.

sp-02371.description_en: As Entropy, except penalty is -2 per round used. At the end of this spell, the object will lose a -1 penalty every round. For every accumulated penalty of -25, the object will have a permanent - I 0 penalty. This penalty can be removed with an appropriate maintenance skill roll.

sp-02372.description_en: As Practice Effect, except bonus is +2 per round used. For every round the object is not appropriately used, it loses a+ I bonus (to a minimum of +0). At the end of the spell' s duration, the object will lose a + I bonus every 2 rounds. The maximum bonus for any item is +50.

sp-02373.description_en: Target non-magic mechanism will operate in its normal capacity for the duration of this spell. After the duration, the machine will operate normally. For example, if this spell were used to turn a wheel, the wheel would spin for the duration of the spell, then slowly spin to a stop.

sp-02374.description_en: Target structure develops a number of temporary fracture-like flaws. The entire structure takes double damage for the duration of the spell. The chance of a structure collapsing due to damage is also doubled.

sp-02482.description_en: Caster may swim at double his normal swimming pace; he expends exhaustion points at the same rate he would if he were walking, once he stops or performs some other action the spell is canceled. This spell also grants a special + IO to all Swimming maneuvers.

sp-02483.description_en: Caster can see up to I 00' in even murky water.

sp-02484.description_en: Caster can breathe water, but not air, for the duration of this spell.

sp-02485.description_en: Causes a wave of water to move away from the caster across the surface of a body of water. The wave is large enough to capsize small boats (i.e. a canoe or small row boat) and give swimmers a -50 to their swimming maneuvers.

sp-02486.description_en: Target becomes soaked in water that condenses from the air.

sp-02487.description_en: Removes all of the liquid (usually water) from I cubic foot of inanimate material.

sp-02488.description_en: Target must make a RR or else begin to sink. The target takes a penalty to all of his Swimming maneuvers equal to the amount by which he failed his RR.

sp-02489.description_en: As Swim I, except target may move at three times his normal swimming pace and only expends exhaustion points at the same rate he would if he were walking.

sp-02490.description_en: As Wave I, except it is large enough to upset medium boats and give swimmers a -75 to Swimming maneuvers.

sp-02491.description_en: Water within the area of effect is calmed. Waves are cut by 20' in center (less towards the perimeter).

sp-02492.description_en: The caster's body and gear assumes a liquid state. The caster cannot pick up anything more dense than water while in this form and the caster is immune to normal attacks. The caster may still be the target of spells (though elemental spells will have half effect on him, except for electrical attacks).

sp-02493.description_en: As Dehydrate, except affects JO cu'.

sp-02494.description_en: The area of effect for this spell is the water immediately surrounding any vessle the caster is on. For the duration of this spell, the speed of small boats can be increased by 75' per round, medium boats by 50' per round, and large boats by 25' per round.

sp-02495.description_en: As Wave I, except it is large enough to upset large boats and give swimmers a -JOO to Swimming maneuvers.

sp-02496.description_en: If there are clouds in the sky, it rains (outdoors) for the duration of the spell.

sp-02497.description_en: Caster creates a dam (of magical force) with a length and height of 5' per level. For the duration of the spell, flowing water will build up against the dam or flood around it as dictated by natural forces.

sp-02498.description_en: As Swim I, except target may move at four times his normal swimming pace and only expends exhaustion points at the same rate he would if he were walking. Also, the caster is immune to the pressures of deep water for the duration of this spell.

sp-02499.description_en: As Wave I, except it is large enough to upset any boat or ship and give swimmers a -200 to Swimming maneuvers.

sp-02500.description_en: If the target fails his RR, he immediately begins to dehydrate. The target is immediately at -10% activity and takes I% of his total hits. For each round that the caster concentrates, the target loses another 5% activity and I% of his total hits. If the caster maintains concentration for 28 consecutive rounds, animate targets will be reduced to dried out husks (i.e., when the penalty reaches 150% ). If the caster is prevented from completing his rounds of concentration or the target gets .i~ 111 out of the range of the spell, the target keeps accumulated activity penalty and hits lost. The hits may be healed normally, but the activity penalty only recovers at the rate of I 0% per day. Alternatively, the GM may allow the activity penalty to be removed with a Cure Disease spell (or its equivalent) cast after all of the hits are restored.

sp-02501.description_en: Creates a 50'R whirlpool that will draw in any unpowered object within 500' (takes 2 minutes of concentration to start). Powered objects may make maneuver rolls to resist the pull of the whirlpool.

sp-02502.description_en: As Calm Water, except waves are cut by 50' in center and caster need not concentrate.

sp-02503.description_en: Caster can use one lower level spell from this list each round.

sp-00254.description_en: Allows target to see all Mana Barriers (any spell effect from this list) within 100'. Without benefit of this spell, the caster can only see Mana Barriers that he creates.

sp-00255.description_en: Creates a shield of force in front of the caster th.at adds 25 to his defense. The shield will move with the caster.

sp-00256.description_en: Creates an invisible barrier 10'x I0'x I' that slows anyone who tries to move through it by 35%. It will also modify any attack made through it by -35.

sp-00257.description_en: Creates a shield of mana behind the caster that negates any bonuses for flank or rear attack made on him.

sp-00258.description_en: Encases the caster in a mana shield that will absorb 20 concussion hits damage before collapsing. Any concussion hits absorbed in this manner are not inflicted upon the caster. Any criticals scored against the caster are reduced by one level unless the concussion damage breaks the shield (treat an 'A' critical as an 'A' critical modified by -25).

sp-00259.description_en: Creates a cage of mana around a target. Target cannot move more than I foot from his current location or make any attacks. All melee attacks against (or by) the target suffer a special modification of -50 and missile attacks suffer a penalty of -25. The target can break out of this cage by making a Very Hard static maneuver (modified by triple Strength).

sp-00260.description_en: As Hindrance Barrier I, except movement reduction is 50% and penalty if -50.

sp-00261.description_en: Covers an area in a thin layer of mana that is very slippery. All attempts to move across the area require a Hard moving maneuver to avoid slipping and falling (Very Hard if moving on an incline).

sp-00262.description_en: Creates a mana barrier around a single, inanimate object (that has no more than 1.5 times the caster's mass) that makes the object difficult to hold on to or move. Any attempt to manipulate the object requires a Hard static maneuver (modified by triple strength). If the object is a weapon, failing this maneuver results in a fumble.

sp-00263.description_en: As Personal Shield I, except the shield can take 40 hits before collapsing.

sp-00264.description_en: Creates a wall of mana through which nothing will pass. It can withstand 100 concussion hits damage before collapsing.

sp-00265.description_en: Creates an invisible field that slows anyone trying to move through it by 75%. All attacks made through the field are at -75.

sp-00266.description_en: Wraps the target in a mana barrier that is very slippery on the exterior. Everytime the target moves, he must make a Very Hard moving maneuver to stay on his feet.

sp-00267.description_en: As Slippery Barrier I, except an Extremely Hard maneuver must be made to move while on the field (Sheer Folly if on an incline).

sp-00268.description_en: As Personal Shield I, except the shield can take 60 hits before collapsing and any criticals are reduced by two unless the concussion damage breaks the shield (treat a 'B' critical as an 'A' critical modified by-25 and an 'A' critical as an 'A' critical modified by -50).

sp-00269.description_en: As Mana Wall I, except it can take 200 concussion hits before collapsing.

sp-00270.description_en: Wraps a normal missile (arrow, bolt, sling stone, etc.) in a field ofmana that improves its flight. Any attack using this missile receive one quarter normal range penalties.

sp-00271.description_en: Renders a Mana Wall permeable to one specific type of thing (gasses, metal, stone, living organic material etc.; designated when this spell is cast). The designated material may pass through the Mana Wall as though it were not there. This spell may be cast multiple times on a single wall.

sp-00272.description_en: As Mana Wall/,exceptitcan withstand300 concussion hits damage before collapsing.

sp-00273.description_en: Encases a target in a mana barrier that completely immobilizes the target. It's position will not change in relation to it's surroundings (i.e., a flying bird caught in a stasis field will not fall to the ground). All attacks agains the target suffer a penalty of - I 00. All normal bodily functions of the target are halted while the spell is in effect (but the target suffers no ill effects from this). To the target, it will appear as though no time passed between when this spell took effect and when it ends.

sp-00274.description_en: As Personal Shield I, except that it can absorb 100 hits before collapsing.

sp-00275.description_en: As Slippery Barrier I, except an Absurd maneuver would be required to move while on the field (and movement on an incline becomes impossible with some assistance to lower the difficulty).

sp-00277.description_en: Creates a pot that can hold up to 5 gallons of liquid. It is not damaged by the effects of normal fire and cold. It should be treated as an iron cooking pot for all purposes.

sp-00278.description_en: Creates a rope up to 20 feet long +5 feet per level of the caster. Treat the rope as a superior hemp rope for all purposes.

sp-00280.description_en: The hammer created by this spell can be ofany size up to a I Opound sledge hammer, but cannot be changed after the spell is cast.

sp-00281.description_en: Creates a knife that must be smaller than a short sword. The knife can be of any kind (skinning knife, butter knife, cutpurse etc.), but cannot be changed after the spell is cast.

sp-00282.description_en: Creates a shovel that can be used as a regular shovel.

sp-00283.description_en: Creates an axe that can be of any type but cannot be changed after the spell is cast (i.e., a woodsman's axe, a throwing axe, etc.).

sp-00284.description_en: Creates a tub that can hold up to 50 gallons ofliquid. It is not damaged by normal fire and cold. It should be treated as an iron tub for all purposes. I 0. Ladder-Creates a ladder up to I' long per level of the caster. It should be treated as a ladder made of strong wood for all purposes.

sp-00286.description_en: Creates a saw that can be used as a regular saw would. The saw can be of any type (rip saw, bow saw, hack saw etc.), but cannot be changed after the spell is cast.

sp-00287.description_en: Creates a wheelbarrow that can be used as a normal wheelbarrow would.

sp-00288.description_en: Creates a canoe approximately 15 feet long. This spell also creates three paddles. Note: On average, such a canoe can comfortably fit 3 human sized passengers and normal gear.

sp-00289.description_en: Creates up to 5 square feet per level of the caster of one type of cloth. The cloth can be either linen or canvas or any other type of cloth that is common to the caster's culture. This cloth comes in one large piece.

sp-00290.description_en: Creates a wagon that should be treated as a small wagon in all respects. This wagon can be of any type specified by the caster (coach, covered wagon, hay-wain etc.), but may not be changed after the spell is cast.

sp-00291.description_en: Caster may seamlessly combine two items created from this list. This spell may be cast multiple times to combine more than two items. For example, the caster could put a pot on the end of his pole (combining the first and second level spells from this list). The two other spells must be cast within one minute of completing this spell.

sp-00292.description_en: Creates up to 5 caltrops per level of the caster. The caltrops will appear in a random spread on the group (all within I O' of the caster).

sp-00293.description_en: Creates a rowboat approximately I 5 feet long and 6 feet wide. It should be treated as a small row boat for all purposes. This spell also creates four oars. Note: On average, such a rowboat can comfortably fit 8 human sized passengers and their gear.

sp-00294.description_en: Creates a shelter approximately 20 feet square and 8 feet tall. It has walls and a door. The shelter is well suited for keeping out the elements and is well insulated, but does not withstand damage well. The structure can withstand only 200 concussion hits before being dispelled.

sp-00295.description_en: Creates a battering ram approximately 15 feet long. It can be used to batter down doors and walls. It requires at least 5 people to operate effectively.

sp-00296.description_en: Creates a bridge that is up to 5' long per level of the caster. This bridge requires no supports and does not need to be arched (although it may be if the caster desires). The bridge can be up to I' wide per level of the caster. Treat as a stone bridge for all purposes.

sp-00297.description_en: Creates a 20 foot diameter, 30 foot tall tower. It has a single door on the ground floor and a ladder inside that climbs to the second floor and roof. The tower may have windows in whatever numbers and locations he desires. Treat as a stone tower with a wooden door for all purposes.

sp-00298.description_en: Caster can observe all spell signatures in the area of effect.

sp-00299.description_en: Allows the caster to store a single signature for use with other spells on this list. The caster gains no information about the spell signature in question, but can recognize it as being distinctly different from other signatures. A given caster can only have one signature stored per level of experience.

sp-00300.description_en: The caster creates an area with a higher concentration of Essence. One of the following effects (roll d I 00, not open-ended) will occur for all spells cast from within this area for the duration of the spell. The caster may add or subtract I from this roll for every rank he has developed in this spell list. 1-25: spell targets suffer an RR penalty of -10 26-50: spell durations are l .5x normal 51-75: spell areas of effect are 1.5x normal 76-100: spell ranges are 1.5x normal

sp-00301.description_en: The caster creates an area with a lower concentration of Essence. One of the following effects (roll dl 00, not open-ended) will occur for all spells cast from within this area for the duration of the spell. The caster may add or subtract 1 from this roll for every rank he has in this spell list. 1-25 spell targets get an RR bonus of+ 10 26-50 spell durations are half normal 51-75 spell areas of effect are half normal 76-100 spell ranges are half normal

sp-00302.description_en: The caster creates an area in which the average amount of available Essence fluctuates wildly. All spells cast in the area of effect require a Spell Casting Static Maneuver with a special modification of -15 (even spells that do not normally need to make a Spell Casting Static Maneuver).

sp-00303.description_en: The caster creates an area in which the average amount of Essence is almost perfectly uniform. Anytime a Spell Casting Static Maneuvers made in the area ofeffect, that maneuver is made with a special modification of+ 15.

sp-00304.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster's spells leave no signatures.

sp-00305.description_en: As Concentrate Essence I, except that the random effects are as follows. 1-25 spell targets suffer an RR penalty of -20 26-50 spell durations are 2x normal spell areas of effect are 2x normal 51-75 76-100 spell ranges are 2x normal.

sp-00306.description_en: As Disperse Essence I, except that the random effects are as follows. 1-25 spell targets get an RR bonus of +20 26-50 spell durations are one quarter normal 51-75 spell areas of effect are one quarter normal 76-100 spell ranges are one quarter normal

sp-00307.description_en: Caster is able to determine what spell created the target spell signature.

sp-00309.description_en: As Stabilize Essence I, except the modification is +30.

sp-00311.description_en: As Concentrate Essence I, except that the random effects are as follows. 1-25 spell targets suffer an RR penalty of -30 26-50 spell durations are 3x normal 51-75 spell areas of effect are 3x normal 76-100 spell ranges are 3x normal.

sp-00312.description_en: As Disperse Essence I, except that the random effects are as follows.

sp-00313.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster's spells will leave a signature of his choosing from those he has stored. I 9. Destablize Essence III-As Destabilize Essence I, except the modification is -45.

sp-00315.description_en: As Stabilize Essence I, except the modification is +45.

sp-00316.description_en: Caster learns the name of the creator of the target signature and gains a mental picture of what he looked like at the time he cast the spell that left the signature.

sp-00318.description_en: For the duration, no spell casting is possible within the area of effect.

sp-00325.description_en: The Swimmer consists of two barrel-shaped air bladders and two feet shaped like flippers. It can swim on the surface of most liquids at a rate of20' per round (in a straight line). It can pull a weight of up to I 00 pounds behind it if a rope is attached, but this will half its rate.

sp-00326.description_en: Caster may combine two existing servants, created by lower level spells on this list, into one servant that will be suitable for both tasks. This spell will end when either of the servants is dispelled or when the first servant's duration runs out.

sp-00327.description_en: The Mover can pick up any single object (that weighs no more than JOO pounds) and move it up to JOO feet away. If the caster desires, the Mover will continue to do this with other similar objects until they are all moved to the new location. The Mover can stack the objects in any fashion they are normally stackable.

sp-00328.description_en: The Carrier is shaped like a big turtle with a flat back. It can carry up to I 00 pounds per level of the caster (moving at a rate of up to 40' per round).
