Casting of this spell does not ensure that the elemental is friendly, just that the caster can speak to them.

sp-00458.description_en: As Summon Whispling, except it summons Type II elementals. Roll on the following to determine what type of elemental is summoned: 01-90: Lesser elemental 9195: Elemental Steed; 96-100 Hybrid Elemental.

sp-00459.description_en: As Command Whispling, except it affects Type I Elementals.

sp-00460.description_en: As Master Whispling, except it affects Type I or Type II Elementals.

sp-00461.description_en: Target elemental is calmed down and will not attack anyone for the duration unless provoked.

sp-00462.description_en: As Control Whispling, except it affects Type I, II, or III Elementals.

sp-00463.description_en: As Summon Whispling, except it summons Type III Elementals. Roll on the following to determine what type of elemental is summoned. 01-20: Elemental Giant; 21-100: Elemental Guardian.

sp-00464.description_en: As Command Whispling, except it affects Type I or Type II Elementals.

sp-00465.description_en: As Control Whispling, except it affects Type I, II, III, or IV Elementals.

sp-00466.description_en: As Summon Whispling, except it summons Type IV Elementals. Roll on the following to determine what type of elemental is summoned. 01-90: Greater Elemental; 91-100 Elemental Riding Drake.

sp-00467.description_en: As Master Whispling, except it affects Type I, II or III Elementals.

sp-00468.description_en: As Summon Whispling, except it summons any one specific elemental of Types I - IV. Caster must specify elemental summoned at time of casting. Alternatively, caster can summon a Type V Elemental. Roll on the following to determine what type of elemental is summoned. Greater Elemental Riding Drake; Superior Elemental.

sp-00469.description_en: As Master Whispling, except it affects Type I - IV elementals. If cast on a Type V elemental, effect only lasts 1 hour per level.

sp-00470.description_en: With this spell the caster has a 50% chance of summoning a Dragon of the caster's elemental type. This spell informs the Dragon of the reason it is being summoned. If the Dragon comes it is friendly towards caster but is under no obligation to serve him. Rewards or pacts of mutual benefit can help convince the Drake to aid the caster. Dragon will not come if it senses some sort of trap or ambush in the intent of the spell caster, of which the spell will inform the Dragon.

sp-00381.description_en: Target is buffeted by focused strong winds. All actions made by target are at -30.

sp-00382.description_en: A dust devil forms in front of the caster and races towards target. Those in the path of the dust devil have a 50% chance of getting hit. Target and those who get in its path must resist or take a 'B' Unbalancing critical.

sp-00383.description_en: Strong winds flow from the caster's arm, striking target. Resolve attack on the Airbolt Table.

sp-00384.description_en: Caster envelops target with bands of force, which immobilizes target. Target can make a Very Hard Strength maneuver every round to act normally, otherwise they are at 20% activity. One man-sized target can be bound for every five levels of the caster. Caster must concentrate.

sp-00385.description_en: As Dust Devil I, except 'C' Unbalancing criticals are delivered.

sp-00386.description_en: Target can walk on air as if it was solid ground. This spell only allows for horizontal movement; vertical movement must be achieved by other means.

sp-00387.description_en: A bolt of force is shot from the caster's palm. Results are determined on the Force Bolt table.

sp-00388.description_en: Caster summons a 20 foot radius intense burst of air on target point. Results are determined on the Cold Ball table delivering Unbalancing criticals instead of Cold criticals.

sp-00389.description_en: Creates a clear wall of force. All attacks through the wall are at -100. No being can pass through the wall unless they make a Very Hard maneuver modified by strength. Wall is a manifestation of High Elemental Air. Air based beings, attacks and spells are only at -50 and it is only a Hard maneuver to go through the wall.

sp-00391.description_en: Caster creates a five-foot radius disk of force. Disk can move up to 100 feet per round in any direction, if the caster concentrates. When caster stops concentrating the disk stops moving.

sp-00392.description_en: A bolt of High Elemental Air is fired from the caster's palm, results are resolved on the Huge Bash Attack Table.

sp-00393.description_en: Creates a shimmering field of force 1' around the caster. If caster concentrates this spell increases his defensive bonus 100 versus all physical and elemental attacks. If caster ceases concentrating then the defensive bonus is only 20.

sp-00394.description_en: As Dust Devil I, except target takes a 'E' Unbalancing critical.

sp-00395.description_en: I— As Force Wall, except for duration.

sp-00396.description_en: Creates a clear dome of force. Dome has a ten-foot radius and completely encloses area. Treat the effects of the dome as a Force Wall.

sp-00397.description_en: As Force Wall, except for duration.

sp-00398.description_en: Target item is surrounded by a 1' radius sphere of force. Item can only be seen and not touched for the duration. Item must fit inside of the sphere or the spell fails.

sp-00399.description_en: As Force Binding, except targets that are constrained take an 'A' Krush critical each round.

sp-00400.description_en: As Air Walking, except it affects one target per level of the caster.

sp-00401.description_en: A cone of vibrating force erupts from the caster's palm. Cone is 100 feet long and 10 feet wide at its base. Resolve attack on the Fireball Table delivering Impact criticals instead of the normal Heat criticals.

sp-00402.description_en: Creates a shimmering field of force 1' around the target. If caster concentrates this spell increases target's defensive bonus 150 versus all physical and elemental attacks.. If caster ceases concentrating then the defensive bonus is only 50.

sp-00403.description_en: As Force Field II, except caster need not concentrate to get the full benefit of the spell.

sp-00471.description_en: Target's lungs do not need to breathe for the duration. Target is unaffected by gasses or liquids that might otherwise harm them (i.e. drowning etc.)

sp-00472.description_en: Allows target to move up and down vertically 10' per round. It does not confer the ability to move horizontally; that must be achieved through other means.

sp-00473.description_en: Caster forces the air in the area to move quickly in one direction. This will cause gasses to clear and will give a -20 to all missile attacks in the area.

sp-00474.description_en: Target can fly at a rate of 75' per round (approximately 5mph.) While Fly is active, normal movement (e.g. walking, running, etc.) is not allowed.

sp-00475.description_en: Target's personal effects are made resistant to the effects of wind. Attacks and maneuvers by target have the penalties caused by wind or wind based spells, reduced by 50.

sp-00476.description_en: Causes all missile attacks in the area to be blown off course, giving them a -50 attack modification.

sp-00477.description_en: As Stabilize, except it affects all within a 10' radius.

sp-00478.description_en: I — Caster causes severe winds to blow in a single direction (chosen at moment of casting). Movement is reduced in one direction by 50 ft per round by the sheer force of winds in the area. Movement is increased by 50 ft per round in opposite direction. An Easy Moving maneuver must be made each round or suffer those who fail suffer an 'A' Unbalancing critical. Missile attacks are impossible in the area of effect. Caster is not immune to the effects of the winds (it is centered on caster).

sp-00479.description_en: As Cross Winds I, except missile attacks have a -100 attack modifier.

sp-00480.description_en: I — Aerial target is forced down 20 ft per 10% failure. If target impacts with a solid object target takes a Fall Attack equal to the distance forced down. Otherwise they must make a Hard Flying maneuver or spin out of control, effects of which are up to the GM. If cast on a target on the ground, they must resist or take a 'C' Unbalancing critical.

sp-00481.description_en: As Fly I, except target moves at 300' per round.

sp-00483.description_en: Target must make a Resistance Roll or they are confined within a tunnel of wind. Any attempts to go through the tunnel gives target an 'A' Impact crit and an 'A' Unbalancing critical (roll separately). If either results in a stun result then target is pushed back into the center of the wind tunnel. Attacks through the tunnel are modified by -150.

sp-00484.description_en: Target's body turns into a gaseous state. While in this form no physical action may be accomplished other than movement (i.e. they can't attack, grasp objects, etc.). Target may still be targeted by spells and can be hit only by magic weapons. Target can move through any object that air can move through. Target can also cast spells in this form, except all Elemental (E) class spells automatically fail. If target is hit by a Vacuum spell, the attack delivers a Slaying critical.

sp-00485.description_en: Caster calls forth a wind storm with the maximum wind speeds equal to twice his level, and an intensity according to his desires. Effects will vary according to circumstance (and GM's discretion).

sp-00486.description_en: As Sheering Winds I, except target is forced down 30 ft per 10% failure.

sp-00487.description_en: As Fly I, except target moves 450' per round.

sp-00488.description_en: As Fly II, except it affects one target per level of the caster.

sp-00489.description_en: As Cross Winds I, except missile attacks have a -200 attack modifier.

sp-00490.description_en: As Fly III, except for duration.

sp-00491.description_en: As Repulsing Winds, except movement is enhanced/restricted by 100' per round. Those failing the Easy maneuver must take a 'B' Unbalancing critical.

sp-00492.description_en: As Sheering Winds I, except target is forced down 50' per 10% failure.

sp-00493.description_en: Caster summons a 100' tall tornado with a 30' radius base, which takes one round to form. Tornado is sent the following round in a single direction, traveling 50' in 3 seconds. Those in the path take a +75 Medium Bash attack from debris and must make a resistance roll or be thrown a number of feet equal to the amount by which they failed. Targets who are thrown take a Fall/Krush attack that has a bonus equal to half of the feet they are thrown. If cast over water, it becomes a water spout; bash attack is +50 and failing a resistance roll will only throw the target a number of feet equal to one quarter of their resistance roll failure. If this spell cannot achieve full height then it fails (e.g., a 30' ceiling will disrupt the spells energy causing the funnel cloud to fail).

sp-00494.description_en: Caster is aware of gravity and magnetic fields in the area of effect.

sp-00495.description_en: The target can levitate up to 10' per round in any direction up or down. This is caused by the nullification of gravity around the target.

sp-00496.description_en: Caster can magnetize or demagnetize up to 1 lb. per level of ferric material. Force of attraction/repulsion strength can be varied up to 1 point per 3 levels. This requires a strength bonus equal to the magnetic strength to force a ferric object away from the magnetized object or to push it in to the magnetized object. If a repulsive magnetic force is cast on a ferric shield, ferric weapons will be at -1 penalty per 3 levels of the caster, to attacks on the bearer of shield with a weapon. If cast on a weapon, it provides a +1 bonus per 3 levels when striking ferric targets.

sp-00497.description_en: Caster is surrounded with an aura of fluctuating magnetic energies. Ferric weapons are at -10 to hit the caster while the field is in effect.

sp-00498.description_en: Up to 1 cu ft/level of material is made immune to the effects of gravity. Object may be moved as if it has no weight. Inertia is constant for object; once force is applied in one direction it will keep moving that direction until an equal but opposing force is applied to the object (or they drift to a halt from wind resistance).

sp-00500.description_en: An intense magnetic field warps one ferric object. The penalty to use the item is equal to the amount by which it failed its resistance roll.

sp-00501.description_en: Target is struck with intense gravitational forces, receiving a 'C' Krush critical if they fail to resist.

sp-00502.description_en: All of those who are within 10' of a point specified by the caster are under the effect of a high gravitational field. All actions in area are reduced by 25%, exhaustion point expenditure is doubled and fumble ranges for physical activities are tripled.

sp-00503.description_en: As Zero G, except there is no inertia. Item will stop moving once force is no longer applied to it.

sp-00504.description_en: Can move one ferric object, up to 1 pound per level in mass, up to 1' per second (with no acceleration). If the caster stops concentration before the duration is up, the object remains stationary as if it had a Staying spell of equal weight limit cast upon it.

sp-00505.description_en: All who are within 10' of a point specified by caster take an 'A' unbalancing critical if they try to do any sudden movements like combat, running, etc. All Climbing maneuvers are at +25.

sp-00507.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] All in the area of effect are under the effect of intense Gravitational forces. All within area must resist or take an 'A' Krush critical and a 'C' Unbalancing critical each round. Targets will suffer from this 1 round per 10% failure.

sp-00508.description_en: All of those within 10' of a point specified by the caster must resist or begin falling upward for one round per 10% failure. At the end of the duration targets are under the effect of normal gravity and will begin falling if not prevented from doing so.

sp-00509.description_en: As Magnetic Shield I, except shield is more powerful giving a +30 DB against Melee weapons and +40 vs Missile weapons. This will also subtract 10 from any ferric weapons or earth based attacks trying to attack the caster no matter which angle they attack from.

sp-00510.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] A 100' long conical force of magnetism is released from the caster's palm, with an end 10' R in size. Those wearing ferric armor must make a Resistance Roll or get thrown back a number of feet equal to the percentage that they failed to resist by. Targets take an 'A' Impact crit for every 50' moved. Those with ferric weapons must resist or have them ripped violently out of their grip.

sp-00511.description_en: As Warp Metal, except if item fails to resist it is broken.

sp-00512.description_en: As Barrier II, except radius is 20'.

sp-00513.description_en: All within AOE is under the effect of an intense gravity field. All actions are reduced by 50%. Fumble ranges and exhaustion points expenditures are quadrupled while in this area.

sp-00514.description_en: As Reverse Gravity except radius is 20'.

sp-00515.description_en: Caster is surrounded by a globe of magnetism extending up to 10'R. All elemental attacks directed at those within the radius are at -50 unless the attack is made of air. All missiles are at -75 and melee weapons must resist or break as if they were under the effects of a Barrier I spell.

sp-00516.description_en: Caster directs intense gravitational forces at target causing target to either explode or implode. If resistance roll is made target takes a 'D' Krush critical. Explosion will spread the target's body over a 50' radius, Imploding turns them into a pool of jelly. Get some toast.

sp-00517.description_en: Caster is able to evaluate the structure/content of any earth or metal within the radius seeing through the layers giving his vision total access to all elements within. This enhances the caster's chance for any successful lore or knowledge skill to succeed by +50, (i.e, Stone Lore, Metal Lore, etc.)

sp-00518.description_en: Item must make a Resistance Roll or it rusts. Item's Breakage Factor is reduced by the amount of failure.

sp-00519.description_en: s — Fingers of earth erupt from the ground. These fingers attack as a +0 Medium Grapple every round that the caster concentrates on them. Caster may use his Targeting skill as his Offensive Bonus.

sp-00521.description_en: Target bladed weapon is given an unnaturally sharp edge for the duration of this spell. Offensive Bonus of weapon is increased by 5. This is in addition to any material or magical bonuses. Magic weapons will resist this spell. The weapon must fail its resistance roll for the effect to work.

sp-00522.description_en: Caster is able to open a passageway through stone that is 3 ft x 6 ft and 1 foot long per level. Passageway slowly seals at a rate of 1 foot per second at the end of the duration.

sp-00523.description_en: Target must make resistance roll or his body is sunk into earth or stone. It is an Easy Strength maneuver to break free. There is a penalty to remove themselves equal to the amount of RR failure. RR failure of 80 or more will encase all of target's limbs. RR failure of 100 will bury target up to his neck. RR failure of over 150 causes the target to be encased by the stone beneath them. Target is considered static for attack determination.

sp-00524.description_en: Target's skin is given the hardness of stone. AT is 15 for the duration. Air based attacks are unaffected by this spell.

sp-00525.description_en: A shard of metal is shot from caster's hand. Attack is resolved on the Heavy Crossbow Table.

sp-00526.description_en: Target merges with earth for the duration. Target cannot hear, say or perceive anything. Target may emerge before the duration is over if they wish, canceling the spell.

sp-00527.description_en: Target earth or stone has the consistency of clay for the purpose of the caster being able to mold it with his hands, for the duration.

sp-00528.description_en: Caster can move through stone, earth or metal at a rate of 2' per round.

sp-00529.description_en: Caster can see into or through 100' of Earth, Stone or Metal.

sp-00530.description_en: A large arm made of earth erupts from the ground. Once a round it can be made to deliver a +100 Huge Grapple. If the grapple is successful ('B' critical or higher) it will be followed by a +50 Large Crush the same round. Crushing will occur every round till target breaks free making a Medium Strength maneuver or until the arm is made to attack someone else. The arm can be attacked as though it were a Weak Earth Elemental (see section 7.0).

sp-00531.description_en: As Sharpen Blade, except bonus is +10.

sp-00532.description_en: Causes target earth, stone or metal item, construct, building or elemental have the amount of damage they are capable of taking increased by 50%. If the caster concentrates the target may be healed 1 hit per round for the duration. This spell is not cumulative and can be dispelled.

sp-00533.description_en: Caster causes a giant boulder to form in his hands. This can then be hurled with magical force and guidance to hit a target within range. Resolve attack on the Boulder Attack Table. Directed Spells may be developed.

sp-00534.description_en: Target's skin is the consistency of stone; AT is 16 for the duration and all critical hits have their severities reduced by one. Air based attacks are unaffected by this spell.

sp-00535.description_en: With this spell the caster can increase the value of a gem by 10%. This takes 10 minutes of concentration for each 1% increase. This spell can only be cast once on a gem. If a spell casting results in failure then the gem is destroyed.

sp-00536.description_en: Caster causes 10' radius area of stone to form jagged spikes and shoots them upward rapidly. All within the area take a Spear attack with an offensive bonus equal to the caster's level x 2. Spikes disappear into earth at the end of round.

sp-00537.description_en: This spell restructures stone or earth to make it more resistant to damage. Target earth or stone structure or object has its total hits increased by 2% each time this spell is cast, up to maximum of 25%, this effect is permanent. If the structure is damaged this spell can also repair damage at a rate of 4% of its total hits per casting. Once this spell has been cast on a stone structure it also confers a resistance roll against stone or earth destruction spells. For resistance roll purposes the level of the stone is equal to the % it has been increased. A 10% increase would confer a lvl 10 resistance to earth destruction attacks.

sp-00538.description_en: Target's skin is the consistency of metal; AT is 20 for the duration and all critical hits have their severities reduced by two. Air based attacks are unaffected by this spell.

sp-00539.description_en: As Restructure Stone, except the increase is 5% per casting and the total increase possible is equal to the caster's level. If used to repair damage to stone the amount healed is 10% of the target's total hits. At +50% the stone will appear to be seamless and flawless.

sp-00540.description_en: Caster's hand is enveloped by flame for the duration. If caster touches something, it will cause the flame to leap to the item touched. This ignites any combustibles and can deliver an 'A' Heat critical.

sp-00541.description_en: A small narrow flame erupts from the caster's hand. This can be used to cauterize a bleeding wound of up to 5 hits of bleeding per round. This is not painless, however, causing 2 hits per point of bleeding stopped by this spell. Target will have a bad scar where the wound is.

sp-00542.description_en: An arc of fire is shot from the caster's palm. Resolve attack on the Fire Bolt Table. Assign a -5 penalty per foot of range, instead of normal range penalties.

sp-00543.description_en: Caster causes the next fire spell that he casts to be a spell of heat, effectively becoming invisible. Stationary spells are hard to detect (-20) and may inadvertently be walked into. Additionally, a directed spell that is under the effect of this spell, negates up 20 of the target's defensive bonus from Quickness.

sp-00544.description_en: Caster causes a 10'x10' surface to be on fire. Those stepping on the surface take an 'A' heat critical. Surfaces need not be flat. Flames only reach 6 inches above the floor.

sp-00545.description_en: A sheet of fire is shot from the caster's hands spreading out in a fan shape. Fan is 1' at its base, 5' long, and 5' wide at its ending. All caught in the area of the fan take an attack on the Fireball table.

sp-00546.description_en: As Fire Arc except the energy is invisible heat, causing only a shimmering to be seen as it strikes. This negates up to 20 of the target's defensive bonus from Quickness.

sp-00547.description_en: A wall of invisible heat (up to 10' x 10' x 6"). Anyone passing through takes an 'A' Heat critical. This wall is Very Hard (-20) to notice.

sp-00548.description_en: Flames flare out from caster's body. All within 5' of caster take an attack on the Fireball Table.

sp-00549.description_en: Two 1' diameter balls are shot from palm of the caster. These can be targeted independently of each other (within range). When each ball strikes their target they explode in a 5' radius ball of fire. Results of each ball are determined on the Fireball Table.

sp-00550.description_en: A shimmering beam of heat hits target. Attack is resolved on the Fire Bolt Table. This negates up to 20 of the target's defensive bonus from Quickness.

sp-00551.description_en: A cone of fire is shot from the caster's palm. Cone is 50' long and has a 5' R width at its full extent. Attack is resolved on the Fire Ball Table.

sp-00552.description_en: As Wall of Heat, except it creates a cube of flame (up to 10' x 10' x 10'). The cube takes a complete round to form and be effective. Anyone passing through (or caught inside) the cube takes an 'A' Heat critical

sp-00553.description_en: A shimmering 1" nearly invisible globe shoots from the caster's hand exploding in a Heat Ball. Upon reaching its target, it explodes to affect a 10' R area. Resolve attack on the Fire Ball Table.

sp-00554.description_en: As Fire Strike I, except balls have a 10' radius.

sp-00555.description_en: All within 5' of caster take a 'B' Heat crit. Anyone touching gives a 'D' Heat critical. Caster must concentrate to maintain spell. Caster is also immune to flame (including Magical and High Elemental Material, but not True Elemental Material) while this spell is in effect.

sp-00556.description_en: As Cone of Fire I, except cone is effectively invisible.

sp-00557.description_en: As Wall of Heat, except “wall” is 10' high and forms a 10'R circle (6" thick) with the caster at the center (the wall will not move with the caster). Wall is not visible.

sp-00558.description_en: As Cone of Fire I, except cone is 100' long and has a 10' R width at its full extent.

sp-00559.description_en: As Fire Strike II, except three balls of fire are created.

sp-00560.description_en: As Heat Cone I, except cone is 100' long and has a 10'R width at it's full extent.

sp-00561.description_en: As Fire Strike II, except four balls of fire are created.

sp-00562.description_en: a 5'R ball of fire is created before the caster, this ball can be directed to move at 150'/round when the caster concentrates. Those struck by the ball take an attack on the Fireball table at +10.

sp-00563.description_en: Instantly lights a fire if sufficient fuel is available. Fire is limited to no more than 1' radius per level. Fire is as hard to put out as a fire that has been burning for an hour (i.e. a breeze or light rain will not put it out).

sp-00564.description_en: This spell protects fires in the radius from wind and rain, requiring 3 times the amount from either source to put out fire.

sp-00566.description_en: All natural fires within the 10' radius of this spell are extinguished.

sp-00567.description_en: Fires in the radius burn fuel more efficiently; fuel lasts five times as long. This spell must be centered on an immobile point.

sp-00568.description_en: As Shelter Flame, except the radius is 10'.

sp-00569.description_en: Causes target fire (of at least 2' R) to explode in a 10' R blast. All those in the area suffer an attack on the Fire Ball Table.

sp-00570.description_en: All fires in the radius are invisible, in addition, no smoke nor light can be seen. Fire will still give off heat, those that can see heat spectrums will still see it. Fire source will visibly char and be consumed and will still ignite combustibles.

sp-00571.description_en: Caster is able to see the difference in temperatures while concentrating and gains infravision.

sp-00572.description_en: Caster creates a 3' high column of fire. The column then starts moving outward to become a circle of fire with a 6 inch thickness. Flames move at a rate of 1 foot per round. All combustibles in contact with the flames are ignited. Any being who comes in contact with the flames suffers an 'A' Heat critical.

sp-00573.description_en: Caster causes a 3' wide corridor through a fire, clearing all flames, heat and smoke from the area. Anyone may walk through the corridor without being affected by the heat from the surrounding fire.

sp-00574.description_en: As Conceal Smoke, except it affects up to a 15' radius.

sp-00576.description_en: Causes target fire (up to 5' radius, but at least 1' radius) or less to stop burning for one round. The following round the fire explodes outward up to 3 times its original radius. Attack is resolved as a +25 Fireball.

sp-00577.description_en: As Create Fire I, except for area of effect and duration.

sp-00578.description_en: As Flare Up I, except radius of explosion is 20'.

sp-00579.description_en: As Shelter Flame, except radius is 30'.

sp-00580.description_en: Target's heat emanations blend with the environment; target cannot be seen by creatures with heat vision.

sp-00581.description_en: Wood and other combustibles in an enclosed building or structure, smolder for a round then burst into flame; flames are intense and deliver an attack on the Fireball Attack Table each round.

sp-00582.description_en: As Suppress Fire I, except area of effect

sp-00583.description_en: Caster causes a ball a fire to shoot from his palm. The ball then travels to a point designated by the caster, where it explodes with concussive force. Resolve attack on the Fireball Attack Table, delivering double damage and additional Impact criticals of equal severity. Fires in the area of effect are starved of oxygen and blown out.

sp-00584.description_en: Caster causes all damage/effects from natural fire in the radius (up to 5') to be reversed. All spells from this list qualify for being natural fire for the purposes of this spell. Wounds will be healed and wood repaired. However if someone dies, his soul will not be returned to him.

sp-00585.description_en: As Create Fire I, except for the radius and duration. Additionally the fire travels at 5' per round.

sp-00586.description_en: Caster knows the exact temperature of the area within 10 feet.

sp-00587.description_en: Targets limbs are numbed. Loss of feeling causes a penalty of -20 to all actions.

sp-00588.description_en: An arc of cold is shot from the caster's palm. Resolve attack on the Cold Bolt Table. Assign a -5 penalty per foot of range, instead of normal range penalties.

sp-00589.description_en: Temperature within the radius is reduced by up to one degree per level of the caster.

sp-00590.description_en: A bolt of cold is shot from the caster's palm. Resolve attack on the Icebolt table delivering Cold criticals.

sp-00591.description_en: Target object (within size limits) is freeze-dried. Target will stay well preserved if protected from the elements. Effects of this spell are up to the GM. This spell can be used to prevent further deterioration of dead bodies.

sp-00592.description_en: [RR Mod: +20] This awful spell attempts to completely freeze the target's body. If the target fails its RR by 1-10, they take an 'A' Cold critical; by 11-20, they take a 'B' Cold critical; by 21-30, they take a 'C' Cold critical; by 31-40, they take a 'D' Cold critical; by 41-74, they take a 'E' Cold critical. If they fail by more than 75 they are dead (frozen to a solid block).

sp-00593.description_en: Cold is summoned to the area of effect. All moisture in the area is turned to frost. Plants that are in the area for more than 10 rounds suffer the effects of natural frost . Fog cannot exist in the area of this spell (turned to frost). The ambient temperature is reduced to 0° Fahrenheit in the area of effect.

sp-00594.description_en: A cone of cold is shot from the caster's palm. Cone is 50' long and is 10' wide at its full extent. Attack is resolved on the Cold Ball Table.

sp-00595.description_en: As Cold Bolt I, except range is 300'.

sp-00596.description_en: As Freeze I except it affects two targets.

sp-00597.description_en: Target is placed into a stabilized hypothermic state. All injuries that occur over a period of time are reduced to a point where they happen at 10 times the normal duration (i.e. if someone is to die in 12 rounds and this spell is cast on them, they will die in 120 rounds). Target is at -90 to all actions while in this hypothermic state.

sp-00598.description_en: Target weapon is surrounded by an aura of cold. All attacks delivered by the weapon deliver a Cold critical of equal severity to the normal critical.

sp-00599.description_en: Multiple blasts of cold race from caster's palm towards target. First blast is resolved on the Firebolt Table delivering Cold criticals, the second is resolved on the Waterbolt Table delivering Cold criticals, and the third on the Shockbolt Table delivering Cold criticals. The caster's Directed Spells are used on all three attacks. All attacks occur in the same round.

sp-00600.description_en: As Cold Bolt I, except range is 500'.

sp-00601.description_en: As Numbing, except it affects one target per level.

sp-00602.description_en: As Cone of Cold I, except cone is 100' long by 10' wide at its full extent.

sp-00603.description_en: Target is surrounded by swirling frost and cold. All within 5' of the target take an 'A' Cold critical. Anyone touching the target takes a 'C' Cold critical.

sp-00604.description_en: As Freeze I, except it affects five targets.

sp-00605.description_en: Target's extremities are frostbitten if RR is failed. Target is at -5 and bleeds at 1 hit per round for every 5% failure.

sp-00606.description_en: As Cone of Cold I, except cone is 150' long and 15' wide at its full extent.

sp-00607.description_en: As Hypothermia, except this affects one target per level.

sp-00608.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] Target's body is completely frozen; all cells burst from the damage. When thawed target is a gelatinous pulp. Target must have every part of his body healed if there is any hope to raise him from the dead.

sp-00609.description_en: Target may run on ice or snow as if on level ground, and may wield ice-covered objects without an increased chance of fumbling.

sp-00610.description_en: As long as the caster concentrates he may sculpt ice as if it was the consistency of clay. Ice hardens to its natural state when the caster ceases concentrating. Ice will not melt from the heat of the caster's hands while this spell is in effect.

sp-00611.description_en: Creates a patch of thin ice on any solid or liquid surface. Ice will only support up to 5 pounds per caster level. Any attempts to move across the ice patch are a Sheer Folly maneuver (-50) due the slipperiness of the ice. Ice melts normally at the end of the spell's duration.

sp-00612.description_en: Target object is covered by a thin layer of ice. Effects of the ice vary, if cast on armor or clothes. The Defensive Bonus from Quickness is reduced by 20 due to the weight, however target would gain a +5 DB bonus from the ice. If cast on a weapon, the weapon becomes hard to wield and to grip. Anyone using the target weapon would do so at -15 and would fumble on rolls four higher than normal (i.e. a Broadsword would fumble on 01-07). Effects on other objects would be up to the GM.

sp-00613.description_en: Caster can sculpt an item of ice to duplicate something within sight. Ice Sculpture is an exact duplicate and can perform the same tasks the original was intended for, through the duration of this spell (GM discretion). Example: Byron has been thrown in prison and while sitting in his cell he sees the guard's keys hanging in the hallway. Byron creates an Ice Sculpture of the keys and lets himself out of the cell after determining which key to use.

sp-00614.description_en: I — Summons a weapon made up of ice. This weapon is considered to be +5 quality and has a fumble range 1 higher than listed. Weapon must be one that the caster has

sp-00615.description_en: Summons a bridge made of ice up to 10' long by 5' wide. Movement across the bridge must be done cautiously and attempts to move at faster than a walk will require an Easy manuever (+30) or the target will slide off the bridge. Modify the maneuver by -10 for every pace category over “walk” that the target is moving.

sp-00616.description_en: As Ice Patch I except for area of effect.

sp-00617.description_en: Target is encased in a block of ice for the duration. Ice is porous so target can breathe. Any attempts to break through the Ice Cage are considered to be a Sheer Folly (-50) Strength maneuver. Cage takes 200 hits before target can be freed.

sp-00618.description_en: As Ice Running except it affects one target per level.

sp-00619.description_en: Caster creates a 4" x 8" x 1' block of High Elemental Ice. Ice is a constant 25° Fahrenheit and radiates cold around it. The temperature around the block is 1° warmer per foot of distance from the block depending on surrounding temperatures. Extended stays near the block will cause damage; resolve an 'A' cold critical at -20 for every 5 minutes that someone is within 5 ft of the block without protective gear on. Contact with the block may cause elemental corruption, as with any exposure to High Elemental Material.

sp-00620.description_en: Caster causes a 15' wide section of snow packed mountain slope to crash down in an avalanche. Those in the path of the avalanche must make a Very Hard Quickness maneuver to escape the path of the avalanche. Those unlucky enough to be hit by it suffer a 'B' Impact critical and a 'C' Krush critical every round they are in the area of effect. Avalanche moves at 50ft/rnd gaining +5 ft/rnd of speed until it reaches 500 ft a round. The magical cause of the avalanche only lasts for 1 rnd per level of the caster. The after effects (i.e., a natural avalanche) are up to the GM.

sp-00621.description_en: As Ice Weapon I, except the weapon is +10.

sp-00622.description_en: Caster diverts the force of an avalanche around him. Area begins 1 foot in front of the caster extending as cone up to 10 feet behind the caster. The caster must face the downward force of the avalanche for this to take effect.

sp-00623.description_en: As Ice Cage except ice is not porous. Targets failing their RR by 50 will die in 10 rounds, due to suffocation.

sp-00624.description_en: Caster creates a up to a 5 foot tall dome of ice, up to 5 feet in radius. Walls are 1 foot thick and take 75 hits to break through. Temperatures within are a consistent 50°.

sp-00625.description_en: As Avalanche I, except for area of effect and the magical force imbued into the avalanche. Anyone unfortunate enough to be in its path takes a 'C' Impact critical and a 'D' Krush critical each round.

sp-00626.description_en: As Ice I, except for duration.

sp-00627.description_en: As Ice Patch I, except for area of effect and range.

sp-00628.description_en: As Ice Encasement I, except target is placed in suspended animation for the duration.

sp-00629.description_en: All avalanches, moving snow, or ice in the area are halted. Attack spells made from ice or snow are at -50 if cast within the area of effect.

sp-00630.description_en: As Avalanche I, except for area of effect and the magical force fed to the avalanche. Anyone unfortunate enough to be in the path of the avalanche suffers a 'D' Impact critical and an'E' Krush critical each round.

sp-00631.description_en: As Ice I, except for duration. Ever wonder how someone makes a fortress out of ice? This spell and Ice Wall combined make it an easy process.

sp-00632.description_en: Detects any magically occurring shadows or darkness.

sp-00633.description_en: Target can see 100' on a normal night as if it were daylight. See of Essence, section 15.12.

sp-00634.description_en: Creates a wall of absolute darkness (up to 10'x10'x1'). This wall prevents all light from passing through its surface; nothing can see through the wall and light-based attacks cannot penetrate.

sp-00635.description_en: Frequency and depth of shadows increase for the duration. All stalk and hide attempts in the area are at +20 for the duration.

sp-00636.description_en: Target's shadow is no longer visible. This helps prevent detection while invisible giving another -20 modifier to detect through normal means (spells always work). Target gains a special +10 bonus to Stalking and Ambush while this spell is in effect.

sp-00637.description_en: Everything within 1' radius of target is invisible as long as it stays within 1' of the original target and none of the termination conditions for the unseen spell occur.

sp-00638.description_en: Causes a 10' R burst of intense dark. All those in the area of effect are stunned 1 round per 5% failure.

sp-00639.description_en: As Wall of Darkness, except duration is 1 round per level.

sp-00640.description_en: As Nightvision, except any darkness can be seen through. Also, no light is needed for this spell to work.

sp-00641.description_en: Natural shadows vibrate and change hue for the duration. This will confuse any shadow-based sneaking spell causing any bonuses from the spell to be negated. Also, within this area all Stalking and Hiding attempts are at -20.

sp-00642.description_en: As Invisibility I, except the radius can vary up to 1' (chosen at the time of casting). This makes the invisible target harder to see.

sp-00643.description_en: As Nightvision, except it affects one target per level.

sp-00644.description_en: Caster can see the flow of light and discern its various colors and spectrums. By concentrating caster can sift through magical and non-magical light. Illusions can be perceived and invisible creatures are discernable. It also gives a +25 to locate hidden objects

sp-00646.description_en: As Sudden Dark I, except the radius is 50'.

sp-00647.description_en: Caster can transform his shadow into a shadow spy. A Shadow Spy will follow any moderately simple instructions the caster gives (e.g., follow that man, go to the center of town, look in the next room). It moves at a rate of 100' and cannot move through solid objects (though they can fit through small openings.) They cannot affect any solid object. If the Shadow Spy has not returned at the end of the spell's duration, it will begin traveling at the rate of 500' per round to return to the caster. When the Shadow Spy returns the caster sees everything that the Shadow Spy witnessed. While the caster is “reliving” what the spy saw, he is in a trance-like state. As long as the caster's shadow is spying, he will have no mundane shadow.

sp-00648.description_en: As Shadow Spy, except that shadow may interact with the environment and has the following combat statistics: AT4; DB [half the caster's], Hits [half the caster's], Melee Attack [half the caster's best OB]. The shadow warrior can only be affected by magical attacks. If destroyed, the caster takes 50% of his remaining hits and the caster's shadow will not return for 1 week.

sp-00649.description_en: As Shadow Servant, except the Shadow also has half of the caster's PP's (the PPs he has remaining after casting this spell). The Shadow can cast spells from any one list that the caster knows (the list is designated when the spell is cast.)

sp-00650.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] Target shadow (either a Shadow creature or Shadow Spy, Shadow Servant, or Shadow Mage ) is banished to the elemental plane of Light, painfully ripping it from the target's body (if from a spell caster.) Shadow creatures that are banished this way may not return and may be slain (GM discretion.) A shadow from one of the spells on this list will be gone for 1 day per 10% failure. During that time the caster does not have a shadow and may not cast the Shadow Spy, Shadow Servant, or Shadow Mage, spells. Additionally, target loses 25% of their remaining hits and 25% of their remaining power points in addition to other penalties provided by the Shadow spell's desciption.

sp-00651.description_en: Caster creates an area of absolute darkness; all existing light sources are immediately extinguished (even Utterlight.) Any light sources that are introduced after the first round of the spell will not function, except Utterlight, which will have half of its normal radius.

sp-00652.description_en: True— As Invisibility I, except if target attacks, they are visible for one round then they become invisible again.

sp-00653.description_en: A colored flare is shot from the caster's palm extending out 100'. Flare illuminates a 10' R surrounding itself. Flare falls at a rate of 10' per round. Color of light may be chosen by the caster at the time of casting.

sp-00654.description_en: Causes target to appear blurred to attackers. This subtracts 10 from all attacks.

sp-00656.description_en: Caster creates up to 1 globe per level of twinkling, dancing lights; those viewing the lights must resist at +20 or stare in fascination at dazzling patterns.

sp-00657.description_en: Creates a series of aerial light explosions (akin to fireworks) for up to 1 round per level of the caster.

sp-00658.description_en: An arc of lightning is shot from the caster's palm. Attack is resolved on the Lightning Bolt Table. Assign a -5 penalty per foot of range, instead of normal range penalties.

sp-00659.description_en: All within sight of caster are blinded for 1 rnd per 10% failure; caster is affected too but has a +25 to resist the effects of this spell.

sp-00661.description_en: A bolt of concentrated light is shot from caster's palm. Resolve attack on the Shock Bolt Table. If target takes at least a single concussion hit of damage then target must resist (no BAR) this spell or take an 'A' Electricity critical 1 round per 10% failure. Resistance rolls are modified by the critical attained on the Shock Bolt Table: no critical +50; 'A' critical +30; 'B' critical +10; 'C' critical +0.

sp-00662.description_en: As Optic Protection I, except target gains a +50 against visual attacks.

sp-00665.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] Causes a 10'R burst of “white” light. All those in the area of effect are stunned 1 round and operate at -25 per 5% failure.

sp-00666.description_en: As Photonic Orb I, except two orbs are created and are targeted separately.

sp-00667.description_en: Creates a blinding light from the caster with a radius of up to 20 feet. Light is blinding, making vision impossible unless protected (-90 to moving maneuvers). Optic protection spells use their bonus to counter the blinding effect.

sp-00669.description_en: Caster discharges lightning to all within 10' radius of caster. Resolve attack as a +50 Lightning Bolt with a special modifier of -5 for every foot they are distanced from the caster (ignore the normal range bonuses).

sp-00670.description_en: As Optic Protection I, except it provides a +75 against visual attacks.

sp-00672.description_en: As Fettered Arc, except attack is a bolt instead of an arc.

sp-00673.description_en: As Optic Protection II, except it affects 1 target per level of the caster.

sp-00674.description_en: Target is made immune to all visual attacks.

sp-00675.description_en: Caster can use one spell from this list per round for the duration.

sp-00676.description_en: Destroys any contaminants and dissolved material in target water making it drinkable. This does not prevent the water from being contaminated later.

sp-00677.description_en: Target can breathe water, but not air, for the duration of this spell.

sp-00678.description_en: Causes a wave of water to move away from the caster across the surface of a body of water. The wave is large enough to capsize small boats (i.e., a canoe or small row boat) and give swimmers a -50 to their Swimming maneuvers.

sp-00680.description_en: Target can see up to 100' even in murky water.

sp-00681.description_en: One small body of water has its water volume increased. The effective water level rises or decreases by three inches, one day per level of the caster. Medium bodies of water have their level increased by one inch. These spells are cumulative.

sp-00682.description_en: Target must resist or be constantly pulled under by surrounding water (humanoid.) Target must make a Very Hard Swimming maneuver to stay above water. Note: it will take all the swimmers effort to stay afloat. Movement in any direction other than up or down is incidental (GM discretion.)

sp-00683.description_en: Target can see up to 300' in heavy fog.

sp-00684.description_en: Caster opens a portal in a nearby stream (within 100' of caster) or current, and redirects its flow to any point within range. Generally used to put out fires however the caster may direct it at a target each round to deliver an 'A' unbalancing critical. A Very Hard Agility maneuver can avoid the stream of water.

sp-00685.description_en: Counters the pressures of deep water. Target does not suffer any ill effects from deep water for the duration (i.e. their body won't be crushed by the pressure).

sp-00686.description_en: The area of effect for this spell is the water immediately surrounding any vessel targeted by this spell. For the duration of this spell, the speed of small boats can be increased by 75' per round, medium boats by 50' per round, and large boats by 25' per round.

sp-00687.description_en: As Wave I, except it is large enough to upset large boats and gives swimmers a -100 to Swimming maneuvers.

sp-00688.description_en: Fog clings to target making them harder to see and attack if they are surrounded by fog or mist, giving opponents an additional -50 to attack and detect them.

sp-00689.description_en: Creates super-dense fog within up to 10'R per level of the caster; this modifies the effects/limitations provided by fog 50%.

sp-00690.description_en: Creates dense fog within up to 10'R per level of the caster each round for the duration of the spell. Fog that is blown away or destroyed is replaced the following round.

sp-00691.description_en: As Fog Vision, except it affects one target per level of the caster.

sp-00692.description_en: As Increase/Decrease Volume I, except a small body of water has its water level raised by one foot. A medium body of water by 4 inches and large body of water has its water level (volume) increased by an inch.

sp-00693.description_en: Caster causes water to bond together and form a dam of up to 25' square feet per level (in any combination of length

sp-00694.description_en: As Favorable Current I, except for duration.

sp-00695.description_en: Caster forms a portal in the palm of his hand to a water source that he is familiar with. The caster then forces water through the portal at a very high rate of speed. Resolve attack on the Water Bolt Table, delivering four times the normal damage. Also, the target is knocked back a number of feet equal to the amount of damage received. For every 10 feet moved roll an 'A' Unbalancing critical.

sp-00696.description_en: As Fog Form, except it affects one target per level of the caster.

sp-00697.description_en: Causes waves to swell in area of effect. Waves will generally capsize smaller vessels and will cause larger ones to pitch. Sailors on board must make a Medium MM each round or be swept off the deck. Sailors tied to deck or up in masts are unaffected (GM discretion), but must make a Medium Agility maneuver each round to stay on their feet.

sp-00698.description_en: Causes all water sources within area to raise up 3 ft; if this exceeds the “banks”of the water body, then there is a flood Effect should be determined by the GM.

sp-00699.description_en: Creates a small area of steam. Contact with steam will cause an 'A' heat critical. Generally used to cook crustaceans and sterilize goods.

sp-00700.description_en: Target in a body of water is transported up to 10' per level of the caster, within that body of water. Water must be at least 6" deep at both locations. This spell fails if the target is not in sufficient water. If destination isn't deep enough, target is transported to the closest point to the destination, within the body of water.

sp-00701.description_en: Caster can move his Hearing sense up and down one body of water, within range of the spell. Point of hearing is 6 inches above the water.

sp-00702.description_en: Caster is aware of all creatures/beings within one body of water as long as they are in range of this spell. Approximate location is known as well. (Fishermen pay handsomely for this spell).

sp-00703.description_en: One small wooden vessel (canoe, rowboat, etc.) and all of its contents/passengers are moved up to 10' per level of the caster, within the same body of water.

sp-00704.description_en: Allows caster to completely ignore sounds of natural water (e.g., like lapping waves, but not splashing by creatures or oars in the water). Very useful for the Listening spell.

sp-00705.description_en: A small portal is opened in the body of water (half of it is above water and half is below). When designated

sp-00706.description_en: Caster can move his point of visual perception to any point in one body of water that is in range. Point of vision is 6 inches above the water.

sp-00707.description_en: Caster summons a wall of super-heated water and vapor (up to 10' x 10'). Attacks through wall are reduced by 60% and movement through wall delivers an 'A' heat critical.

sp-00708.description_en: A bolt of super heated water and vapor is shot from the caster's palm. Attacks on Steam Bolt Table delivering Heat criticals and secondary Impact criticals.

sp-00710.description_en: As Wall of Steam, except it creates a cube of steam (up to 10' x 10' x 10'). The cube takes a complete round to form and be effective. Anyone passing through (or caught inside) the cube takes an 'A' Heat critical; attacks through the steam are at a -20.

sp-00711.description_en: As Water Gate I, except that a small vessel is transported (with all its contents.)

sp-00712.description_en: As Vessel Door I, except it can affect up to a medium sized vessel.

sp-00713.description_en: As Hold Craft I, except medium vessels are held and large vessels have their movement rate reduced by 50 ft per round.

sp-00714.description_en: Caster tries to remove water content from the target. If the target fails to resist, they are at -10 to all their actions and stunned 1 rnd per 10 failure. Penalties last until healed. Targets that reach a penalty of 150 become dried-out husks and are quite dead.

sp-00715.description_en: A cone of super-heated steam is shot from the caster' palm. The cone is 50' long and is 10' wide at its full extent. Attack is resolved on the Fire Ball Table.

sp-00716.description_en: Caster causes current beneath the target boat to surge upward, knocking the ship up and down. Attacks this round, from anyone on the ship, are at -50.

sp-00717.description_en: As Vessel Door I, except it can affect up to large sized vessels.

sp-00718.description_en: As Water Gate II, except that up to mediumsized vessels may be transported.

sp-00719.description_en: As Hold Craft I, except up to large vessels are held and cannot move.

sp-00720.description_en: As Water Gate I, except that up to large vessels may be transported.

sp-01581.description_en: Caster is aware of any active combat links within the area of effect.

sp-01582.description_en: Caster sends a mental message to the members of his Triad or Circle.

sp-01584.description_en: Members of the Triad share each other's perceptions in a non-distracting way. The Triad receives a +30 to Battle Awareness and +15 to general Awareness checks and Sense Ambush/Assassin checks.

sp-01585.description_en: Members of the Triad benefit from each other's intuition and foresight giving them all members a +15 to DB against all attacks.

sp-01586.description_en: Members of the Triad benefit from each other's strength giving them all a +15 to their Offensive Bonuses and Strength maneuvers.

sp-01587.description_en: Minor injuries done to a member of the Triad are shared with the members of the bond. Stunning, Hits, and Bleeding results are divided by three and assigned to all members of the Triad. All results are rounded down, so 2 rounds of stun will not affect the group and 5 rounds of stun will stun the entire group for 1 round.

sp-01588.description_en: The Power Points from each member of the Triad are added together to form a pool. Spells cast by any member are subtracted from this pool. Power Point multipliers therefore work differently for each member. Do not apply them to the pool; instead take the multiplier and divide the casting cost of the spell by the multiplier to determine the casting cost. When this spell ends, divide the Power Points left among each member of the Triad. Then those with Power Point multipliers can multiply these Power Points normally.

sp-01589.description_en: Members of the Triad can communicate mentally. When this spell is used, all members of the link can hear and participate as if having a conversation amongst themselves.

sp-01590.description_en: Allows the Elemental Champion to link to two other Elemental Champions of different elements within their Triad (Fire-Water-Ice or Air-Earth-Light). The link is completed when all three Champions successfully cast this spell. Once completed the link cannot be broken until the duration of this spell runs out. Spells 2-9 require that this Link be active for them to work.

sp-01591.description_en: Triad or Circle members can temporarily switch their main element for the duration of this spell. Members are restricted to elements represented by other members. (E.g., a Fire champion could temporarily switch his primary element to water, but could not switch to Air unless the Champion was a member of a Circle.)

sp-01593.description_en: Members of the Circle share each other's perceptions. The Circle receives a+50 to Battle Awareness and +30 to general Awareness checks and Sense Ambush/Assassin.

sp-01594.description_en: Members of the Circle benefit from the other's intuition and foresight, giving them a +30 to DB against all attacks. This bonus is cumulative with other bonuses.

sp-01595.description_en: Members of the Circle benefit from each other's strength, giving them a +30 to all of his offensive bonuses and Strength maneuvers.

sp-01596.description_en: II— As Shared Injuries I, except this spell only affects Circles and all injuries have their results divided by six rounded down. So an attack that delivered 5 rounds of stun would not affect any member of the group. An attack that did six rounds of stun would stun every member of the group for one round.

sp-01597.description_en: As Shared Power I, except this spell affects Circles.

sp-01599.description_en: Members of the Triad or Circle are hasted for the duration.

sp-01600.description_en: Allows an Elemental Champion to link to five other Elemental Champions of different Elements. The link is complete when all of the Champions successfully cast this spell. Once completed, the link cannot be broken until the duration of this spell runs out. Spells 12-19 require that this Link be complete for them to work. Once this linking has begun, members of the Circle have 5 minutes to successfully cast this spell or the link fails.

sp-01601.description_en: The Shared Power spell must be in effect for this spell to be cast. When this spell is successfully cast by all of the members of the Circle, it allows them to specify a single Elemental Champion as a Champion of Nether or Aether. The Aether or Nether Champion's spells work as if his primary element is Aether or Nether depending on which element was chosen. If the Champion's bonded weapon delivers additional criticals those criticals change to Aether or Nether. Whenever the Aether or Nether Champion casts a spell it draws power from every member of the Circle. Subtract 20 power points from the pool every time the champion casts a spell, in addition to the normal casting costs.

sp-01602.description_en: As Aether/Nether Champion, except when the champion casts spells it only draws 10 power points from the pool.

sp-01603.description_en: As Aether/Nether Champion, except the Champion may change what type of elemental force his spells are using at will from among all eight elements.

sp-01604.description_en: Caster prepares his personal armor to accept elemental material. This is required to cast the Infuse Armor spell.

sp-01605.description_en: Caster takes pooled elemental material and infuses it into his personal armor or clothes. This process bonds the armor to the caster's body. The bond is generally made to the breastplate (or his shirt if the champion is infusing clothes). When this spell is cast, this armor gains 2 corruption points from the caster's personal element. This corruption doesn't provide random factor points like other corruption; instead, all of the factor points are in Aura (see section 10.0). Armor infused by this spell is considered to have the Physical Memory spell already cast on it. Additionally, the corruption facilitates the use of spells on this list and acts as a catalyst to channel elemental energy; as such it reduces penalties for casting spells in armor equal to the number of corruption points. The caster may cast this spell multiple times into their armor as long as the number of corruption points do not exceed the caster's level times 2.

sp-01606.description_en: * — When the caster receives a critical hit that specifies different results based on the armor he is wearing, this spell will cause him to receive the least harmful result, regardless of what he is actually wearing. For example, if a critical hit specified that the caster would die without a helm, but only be knocked out with a helm, then he is merely knocked out. This spell can be cast after the critical result is known.

sp-01607.description_en: Causes the caster's armor to radiate with the essence of the caster's element. This provides a +10 to the caster's defensive bonus (DB).

sp-01608.description_en: Elemental material radiates out in a 3' R area. All who enter the area of effect take an 'A' critical of the appropriate type. This spell will not discriminate between friend and foe.

sp-01609.description_en: Caster's infused armor is softened to the flexibility of clothes for the duration of this spell. Softened armor provides the same flexibility as clothes and the same protection, AT1 but with a +10 DB (the armor still protects a

sp-01610.description_en: The first spell from this list that is cast after this spell is stored in the caster's armor. It may then be activated later as an instantaneous spell. Only a single spell may be stored in such a way.

sp-01612.description_en: As Protective Aura I except this spell provides a +20 to DB.

sp-01614.description_en: As Aura Burn I except 'B' criticals are delivered.

sp-01615.description_en: * — Elemental material flares from caster's hands, causing the attacker to be distracted, giving the caster an additional +25 to his DB. This will work against all attacks except base attack spells (generally Type F).

sp-01617.description_en: As Soften Armor except for the duration.

sp-01618.description_en: As Protective Aura II and Aura Burn II.

sp-01619.description_en: The next two spells from this list that are cast after this spell are stored in the caster's armor. Either spell may be activated later as an instantaneous spell. Only two spells can be stored in such a way and this spell is not cumulative with any other Armor Store spell.

sp-01620.description_en: As Protective Aura I, except this spell provides a +30 to DB.

sp-01621.description_en: As Staunch, except for duration and there are no maneuver penalties while it is in effect.

sp-01622.description_en: As Aura Burn I, except 'C' criticals are delivered.

sp-01623.description_en: As Protective Aura I, except this spell provides a +40 to DB.

sp-01624.description_en: As Protective Aura III and Aura Burn III.

sp-01625.description_en: With this spell the caster gains +40 to his DB and all within 3 ft of the caster take a 'D' critical from the appropriate table.

sp-01627.description_en: For the duration, the target hybrid elemental animal will believe the caster is a good friend. Attacking the creature will negate this spell. This spell lasts 1 round per 5% failure.

sp-01628.description_en: As Calm Hybrid I, except two animals are affected.

sp-01629.description_en: Caster summons a hybrid elemental animal of the same type as his chosen element. Animal is stationary for three rounds after summoning due to disorientation. If not controlled or mastered the animal will act according to its nature, if from this plane, or dissolve if an elemental spirit was called to animate a form.

sp-01630.description_en: Caster controls target hybrid elemental animal like it was a well-trained animal (note: this is not absolute control) while the caster concentrates. It can be commanded to attack, fetch, etc. If severely wounded it will retreat like a mundane animal. Concentration for this spell is not intense and only takes 20% of the caster's actions.

sp-01631.description_en: Sends a command to the caster's bonded animal that is inaudible to all but the animal. The animal must be within earshot.

sp-01632.description_en: Caster summons an Elemental Steed of the same type as his chosen element. The steed is stationary for three rounds after summoning due to disorientation. If not controlled or mastered the mount will act according to its nature, if from this plane, or dissolve, if an elemental spirit was called to animate the form.

sp-01633.description_en: As Control Hybrid, except for duration. The caster may only have one hybrid animal mastered at a time and it must be of the same element as the caster's chosen element.

sp-01634.description_en: Caster controls the target Elemental Steed like it was a well-trained horse. It can be ridden and understands the

sp-01635.description_en: Caster knows the location of all of his mastered animals if within the radius of this spell.

sp-01636.description_en: Caster sends a command to the animal that is out of caster's ear shot. Caster must know the location of the animal through the Locate Animal spell.

sp-01637.description_en: Caster gains +20 to Riding maneuvers and mounted combat while on an Elemental Steed (includes Elemental Riding Drakes) for the duration.

sp-01638.description_en: As Control Steed, except for the duration. The caster may only have a single mount mastered at a time and it must be of the same elemental type as the caster.

sp-01639.description_en: Caster specifies one animal bonded to them. If it is within range, it is transported instantly to the caster's left side.

sp-01640.description_en: As Silent Command, except it does not require the animal to be within earshot.

sp-01641.description_en: Calls the caster's mount (includes Elemental Riding Drakes) so it will come to where he is or as close as possible to where he is. This is a loud audible call.

sp-01642.description_en: Caster gains a +30 to Riding maneuver and Mounted Combat while on an elemental mount for the spell's duration (includes Elemental Riding Drakes).

sp-01643.description_en: As Summon Mount, except the mount is a Lesser Riding Drake.

sp-01644.description_en: As Control Mount, except it affects Lesser Riding Drakes of the same element as the caster's chosen element.

sp-01645.description_en: As Call Mount, except the call is silent.

sp-01646.description_en: As Control Lesser Riding Drake, except for the duration. The caster may only have a single mount (steed or riding drake) mastered at a time and it must be of the same elemental type as the caster.

sp-01647.description_en: Protects a vessel and causes elemental material of the caster's type to gather within it. This is used to forge the Elemental Weapon and to infuse the Elemental Armor.

sp-01648.description_en: Prepares weapon or material to accept the elemental material. This spell prevents the weapon from being destroyed by the corrupting process. It also allows the weapon to accept a larger amount of elemental corruption when it is reforged.

sp-01649.description_en: Caster attempts to infuse his weapon with High Elemental Material. Caster must first collect enough High Elemental Material in a prepared vessel. Caster may then attempt to forge a new weapon or reforge an existing weapon, using the elemental material as fuel. If the caster is forging a new weapon, the process takes the same amount of time it would take to forge an ordinary weapon, but the caster gets a +5 bonus to his Crafting maneuver. Newly forged weapons gain 20 corruption points. If the caster is reforging a weapon, he gains a +20 bonus to his maneuver, and the weapon gains 10 corruption points. A failed maneuver means that the weapon is consumed by the elemental material. The caster bonds with the weapon during the forging process. This bond allows the caster to modify any rolls to determine the weapon's powers by up to +/- 20 on a d100 roll or +/- 2 on a d10 roll. The Omniweapon ability may not be selected. Negative traits or curses affect only other wielders of the weapon, never the caster. All negative traits allow a free positive trait to be applied to the weapon. See section 10.0 for details.

sp-01650.description_en: * — For the next round the caster's Elemental Weapon delivers an additional Elemental critical of two severities less than the weapon's normal critical. If the caster's elemental weapon is a bow or crossbow, this spell can be cast on the arrows or bolts as long as they are fired from the caster's elemental weapon. The Elemental critical is based on the caster's element; see the notes for details.

sp-01651.description_en: Caster's sheath is immune to the effects

sp-01652.description_en: Caster infuses pooled elemental energy into a weapon. This spell must be cast once a day for a week for it to work. Each day the caster must cast Pool Element to pool the

sp-01653.description_en: As Elemental Whisp I, except critical is only one severity less.

sp-01654.description_en: Caster is aware of the location of his bonded weapon.

sp-01656.description_en: As Infuse Weapon I, except each week it gives 3 corruption points and the total corruption points may reach 30.

sp-01657.description_en: Surrounds weapon with a nimbus of the caster's primary elemental material. If someone other than the caster tries to grasp the weapon, they receive an 'A' critical of the appropriate type each round; this spell is dispelled when the caster touches the weapon.

sp-01658.description_en: As Elemental Whisp I, except critical is of equal severity.

sp-01659.description_en: Allows the caster to parry one melee or missile attack with an additional +75 to the caster's defensive bonus. At least 25% of the caster's offensive bonus must be used to parry to get the additional +75 bonus. This spell allows the weapon to block things that may otherwise be impossible to block with the caster's weapon. (E.g., parrying a two-handed sword with a long bow and having the long bow survive would be allowable by this spell).

sp-01660.description_en: Caster's bonded weapon is instantly teleported to his hand.

sp-01661.description_en: As Infuse Weapon I, except that each week it gives 4 corruption points and total corruption points may reach 30.

sp-01662.description_en: Allows the caster to use his bonded weapon to parry elemental bolts for this round.

sp-01663.description_en: As Block I, except it allows the caster to split his parry between 2 combatants with a +75 to the caster's defensive bonus against each of them.

sp-01664.description_en: Eliminates one Elemental Corruption Point from the caster's bonded weapon.

sp-01665.description_en: As Elemental Nimbus, except duration is one day per level.

sp-01666.description_en: As Infuse Weapon I, except that each week it gives 5 corruption points and the total corruption points may reach 60. 25 Burying the Blade — The round this spell is cast the caster selects a single target, that target will now deliver Slaying criticals against the caster instead of their normal criticals; in return, if the caster strikes the target and delivers a critical strike the attack will deliver a Slaying critical, in addition to the normal critical.

sp-01668.description_en: As Infuse Weapon I, except for each week it gives 6 corruption points and the total corruption points may reach 100 through this spell.

sp-01669.description_en: Caster opens a series of miniature gates to the elemental planes of their triad, filling the caster's bonded weapon with energy till it is ready to burst. In combat, the next 'E' critical automatically slays the target struck. The attack causes the weapon to erupt from within. The caster's weapon and physical body are used to fuel the explosion, destroying them both utterly. The caster can only be restored through divine intervention or if a gamemaster is nice, the Rebirth spell of the Elemental Priest. If the duration of the spell expires before the caster can slay a target, then the weapon explodes. Resolve attack as four separate Fireball attacks on all within 5' of the weapon. The first Fireball attack delivers Puncture criticals (Shrapnel) and the other three will deliver appropriate criticals for each member of the caster's triad. The weapon cannot be removed from the caster's hand for the duration.

sp-01674.description_en: Any unarmed attack this round delivers an additional 'B' critical of the appropriate elemental type.

Spell casting is not possible. All offensive bonuses are 0. This may be counteracted by the caster developing skill in the attacks. The Breath Weapon skill is a sub-skill of Directed Spells and the Bite is a sub-skill of Martial Arts: Strikes.

Spell casting is not possible in this form. All attacks have an Offensive Bonus of 0. Caster can develop skill in the attacks. The Bash attack(s) are a sub-skill of Martial Arts strikes and the Grapple is a sub-skill of Martial Arts: Sweeps.

sp-01678.description_en: Transforms the caster's hands into elemental material. Any unarmed attack delivered during the duration of this spell no longer delivers Martial Arts criticals. Instead they deliver Elemental Criticals of the appropriate type. Reduce critical severity from these attacks by one.

sp-01679.description_en: Any unarmed attack this round delivers an additional 'C' critical of the appropriate elemental type.

sp-01680.description_en: Caster takes the form of a Lesser Elemental of the caster's chosen element. The caster gains the abilities but not attacks of the Lesser Elemental. The caster retains hits, intelligence, weapons, armor and spell casting ability.

sp-01681.description_en: The next spell cast from this list has its' duration tripled. The spell must be cast within 3 rounds.

Caster may develop skills in the attacks; refer to the Zephyr Form and Lesser Elemental Form spells for details. Spell casting is not possible in this form.
